math-e1-geo1.title: Magacyada shaxyada iyo geesaha
math-e1-geo1.concept: **Seddex-geesoodku** wuxuu leeyahay 3 dhinac, **afar-geesoodku** wuxuu leeyahay 4 dhinac. **Goobadu** way wareegsan tahay mana laha gees.

math-e1-geo2.title: Ogaanshaha shaxyada saddex-cabbirka ah
math-e1-geo2.concept: Qaabka sanduuqa waa **sanduuq leydi**, qaabka tiirka goobada ah waa **silinder**, qaabka kubbadda waa **goob dhammaystiran**.

math-e1-l1.title: Tirinta
math-e1-l1.concept: Haddii aad shay kasta farta ku taabato oo aad tirisid, waad ogaan kartaa imisa ayaa jira. Haddii ay ka badan yihiin 10, isku xidh 5 ama 10 mid mid si ay u fududaato tirintu.

math-e1-l2.title: Isku-darka iyo isku-jarka
math-e1-l2.concept: **Isku-darka (+)** waa isku-darka laba tiro, **isku-jarku (-)** waa ka-saarka tiro yar tiro weyn.

math-e1-l3.title: Barbar-dhigga cabbirka tirooyinka
math-e1-l3.concept: Laba tiro ka mid ah, tan weyn waxaa lagu muujiyaa **>**, tan yar-na **<**. Calaamaddu waxay u furan tahay dhanka tirada weyn.

math-e1-l4.title: Qaabab kala duwan
math-e1-l4.concept: **Seddex-geesoodku** wuxuu leeyahay 3 dhinac, **afar-geesoodku** wuxuu leeyahay 4 dhinac. **Goobadu** way wareegsan tahay mana laha gees.

math-e1-l5.title: Dherer iyo saacad
math-e1-l5.concept: Dhererka waxaa lagu cabbiraa **cm**. Ushii gaaban ee saacadda waxay muujisaa 'saacadda', ushii dheer waxay muujisaa 'daqiiqadda'.

math-e2-dat1.title: Kala-saarid iyo ku muujin miis iyo garaaf
math-e2-dat1.concept: Haddii xogta lagu kala qaybiyo qaab-sooc, la tiriyo, lagana dhigo **miis** ama **garaaf**, hal mar ayaa la barbar dhigi karaa.
math-e2-dat1.example: A 3 qof, B 5 qof, C 2 qof → wadar ahaan 10 qof

math-e2-geo1.title: Seddex-geesood iyo afar-geesood
math-e2-geo1.concept: **Seddex-geesoodku** wuxuu leeyahay 3 dhinac oo toosan iyo 3 gees, **afar-geesoodku** wuxuu leeyahay 4 dhinac oo toosan iyo 4 gees. Xataa haddii qaabku kala duwan yahay, tirada dhinacyada iyo geesuhu waa isku mid.

math-e2-geo2.title: Dherer iyo wakhti
math-e2-geo2.concept: Haddii aad la jaanqaaddo calaamadda 0 ee xariiqda, calaamadda dhammaadka kale waa dhererka. $1\text{ m}=100\text{ cm}$. Tirada ay usha dheer ee saacaddu tilmaamayso ku dhufo 5 waa daqiiqadda.

math-e2-l1.title: Qiimaha meesha
math-e2-l1.concept: Tirada laba-lambar ah, lambarka bidix waa **meesha tobnaadka**, lambarka midig waa **meesha kelida**. Marka 10 ay isu yimaadaan 10 jeer waa 100.

math-e2-l2.title: Isku-darka iyo isku-jarka tirooyinka laba-lambar ah
math-e2-l2.concept: Meesha keliga iyo meesha tobnaadka mid mid u xisaabi. Haddii wadarku ka badan yahay 10, qaado; haddii aan la jari karin, amaaho.

math-e2-l3.title: Marka ugu horreysa ee la kulmo isku-dhufasho
math-e2-l3.concept: Isku-darka isla tiro marar badan waxaa lagu qori karaa si kooban **isku-dhufasho (×)**.

math-e2-l4.title: Dherer iyo wakhti
math-e2-l4.concept: **1m = 100cm**. Saacadda, mar kasta oo usha dheer ay hesho hal lambar, 5 daqiiqo ayaa ka dhaafay.

math-e2-l5.title: Helitaanka qaab
math-e2-l5.concept: Haddii aad hesho **qaabka** tirooyinku ku kordhayaan ama ku yaraanayaan, waad ogaan kartaa tirada xigta.

math-e3-ari1.title: Isku-darka iyo isku-jarka tirooyinka saddex-lambar ah
math-e3-ari1.concept: Ka bilow meesha keliga oo si isdaba-joog ah u xisaabi. Haddii wadarku ka badan yahay 10, meesha sare **u qaado**; haddii aan la jari karin, meesha sare **ka amaaho**.

math-e3-geo1.title: Xagal iyo xagal qumman
math-e3-geo1.concept: Shaxda ay sameeyaan laba falaad oo ka bilaabma hal bar waxaa loo yaqaan **xagal**. Xagal ah $90^\circ$ waa **xagal qumman**, haddii uu ka yar yahay waa **xagal af-fiiqan**, haddii uu ka weyn yahay waa **xagal balaadhan**.
math-e3-geo1.example: $30^\circ$ xagal af-fiiqan · $90^\circ$ xagal qumman · $120^\circ$ xagal balaadhan

math-e3-geo2.title: Bar-dhexroorka iyo dhexroorka goobada
math-e3-geo2.concept: Dhererka laga bilaabo bartamaha goobada ilaa bar ku taal goobada waa **bar-dhexroor**, qaybta xariiqda ee marta bartamaha waa **dhexroor**. Dhexroorku waa laba jeer bar-dhexroorka.

math-e3-l1.title: Isku-dhufasho iyo qaybin
math-e3-l1.concept: Isku-dhufashadu waa isku-darka isla tiro marar badan, **qaybintuna** waa u qaybinta si siman. Haddii aad taqaanid miiska isku-dhufashada, qaybintuna way fududaataa.

math-e3-l2.title: Ogaanshaha jajabyada
math-e3-l2.concept: Qayb ka mid ah wadarta si siman loo qaybiyey waxaa lagu muujiyaa **jajab**. Tirada hoose waa **hoosaha**, tirada sare waa **korka**.
math-e3-l2.example: $\frac{3}{8}$ : 3 qaybood oo ka mid ah 8 qaybood

math-e3-l3.title: Dherer · mug · culeys
math-e3-l3.concept: **1km = 1000m**, **1L = 1000mL**, **1kg = 1000g**. Marka cutubka la beddelayo, ku dhufo 1000.

math-e3-l4.title: Goobo iyo xagal
math-e3-l4.concept: **Xagal qumman** waa 90°. Goobada, **dhexroorku** waa laba jeer **bar-dhexroorka**.

math-e3-l5.title: Miis iyo garaaf
math-e3-l5.concept: Haddii natiijada sahanka lagu habeeyo miis, waxaa fudud in la ogaado wixii ugu badnaa, wixii ugu yaraa iyo wadarka.

math-e4-dat1.title: Akhrinta garaafka xariiqda jabtay
math-e4-dat1.concept: **Garaafka xariiqda jabtay** wuxuu muujiyaa qiimaha isbeddelaya wakhtiga barooyin iyo xariiqo. Haddii xariiqdu kor u socoto, waa kordhay; haddii hoos u socoto, waa yaraatay.

math-e4-geo1.title: Cabbirka xagallada shaxda
math-e4-geo1.concept: Wadarka saddexda xagal ee seddex-geesoodku waa $180^\circ$, wadarka afarta xagal ee afar-geesoodku waa $360^\circ$.

math-e4-geo2.title: Afar-geesood iyo shax-badan
math-e4-geo2.concept: Haddii hal lammaane oo dhinacyo is-hor yaal ah ay is-barbar socdaan waa **trapezoid**, haddii labada lammaane ay labaduba is-barbar socdaan waa **parallelogram**, haddii afarta dhinac ay dhammaantood isle'egyihiin waa **rhombus**. Xariiqda isku xidha geesaha aan is-dhinac ahayn waa **ulaha-dhex-mara**.

math-e4-l1.title: Tirooyin waaweyn
math-e4-l1.concept: Waxaan akhrinaa oo qornaa tirooyin waaweyn anagoo adeegsanayna cutubka 10000 (toban kun). Lambar meel kasta ku taal waxay muujisaa cabbir ay la mid tahay **qiimaha meeshiisa**.

math-e4-l2.title: Isku-dhufasho iyo qaybin tirooyin waaweyn
math-e4-l2.concept: Tirada la dhufanayo u kala qaybi, ku dhufo, kadibna isku dar. Qaybinta, qiyaas jajabka si aad u hubiso.

math-e4-l3.title: Isku-darka iyo isku-jarka jajabyada iyo jajabyada tobanlaha ah
math-e4-l3.concept: Jajabyada hoosaha isku mid ah, **koryaasha** isku dar oo isku jar. Jajabyada tobanlaha ah, meelaha dhibicda isku xidh kadibna xisaabi.

math-e4-l4.title: Cabbirka xagallada iyo shaxyada
math-e4-l4.concept: Wadarka saddexda xagal ee seddex-geesoodku waa **180°**, wadarka afarta xagal ee afar-geesoodku waa **360°**.

math-e4-l5.title: Garaafka tiirarka iyo celceliska
math-e4-l5.concept: Akhri xogta oo hel wadarka iyo farqiga. **Celceliska** waa wadarka oo dhan oo lagu qaybiyey tirada.

math-e5-dat1.title: Helitaanka celceliska
math-e5-dat1.concept: **Celceliska** waa wadarka xogta oo dhan oo lagu qaybiyey tirada xogta.

math-e5-dat2.title: Suurtagalnimo
math-e5-dat2.concept: **Suurtagalnimada** wax dhici karo waxaa lagu muujiyaa tiro u dhexeysa 0 (aan macquul ahayn) iyo 1 (hubaal). Suurtagalnimo=(tirada xaaladaha la rabo)÷(tirada xaaladaha oo dhan).
math-e5-dat2.example: 3 kubbadood oo A ah, 2 kubbadood oo B ah → suurtagalnimada A $\frac{3}{5}=0.6$

math-e5-geo1.title: Wareegga iyo cabbirka
math-e5-geo1.concept: Afar-xagal toosan: cabbir=dhererka×ballaadhka, saddex-xagal: salka×sarrayn÷2, afar-xagal is-barbar socda: salka×sarrayn, trapesoyid: (dhinaca sare+dhinaca hoose)×sarrayn÷2, rombus: ka-gudbaha×ka-gudbaha÷2.

math-e5-geo2.title: Isku-eg iyo isku-muuqaal
math-e5-geo2.concept: Laba shax oo isku muuqaal iyo cabbir ah oo is-dul dhici kara waxaa la yiraahdaa **isku-eg dhammaystiran**. Shaxda marka hal xariiq lagu laabo oo si buuxda isku dhaca waa **shax xariiq-isku-muuqaal ah** iyo xariiqdaas waa **dhidibka isku-muuqaalka**.

math-e5-l1.title: Isku-darka iyo kala-jarka jajabyada hooseeyayaal kala duwan leh
math-e5-l1.concept: Haddii hooseeyayaashu kala duwan yihiin, marka hore **hooseeyayaasha isku mid ka dhig**. Isticmaalka isku-dhufashada wadaagga ah ee ugu yar ee labada hooseeye ayaa fudud.

math-e5-l2.title: Isku-dhufashada tobanleyaasha
math-e5-l2.concept: Ka tirtir dhibicda tobanlaha oo sida tiro dabiici ah isku dhufo, kaddib dhibicda tobanlaha dib u dhig sida tirada lambarrada tobanlaha ee la isku dhuftay.

math-e5-l3.title: Kala-qaybiyayaasha iyo isku-dhufashooyinka
math-e5-l3.concept: **Kala-qaybiyaha** waa tirada tiro kale si sax ah u qaybisa, **isku-dhufashadu** waa tirada marka tirada lagu dhufto 1, 2, 3....

math-e5-l4.title: Cabbirka iyo mugga
math-e5-l4.concept: Afar-xagal toosan waa **dherer × ballaadh**, saddex-xagal waa **salka × sarrayn ÷ 2**, mugga sanduuqa waa **dherer × ballaadh × sarrayn**.

math-e5-l5.title: Saamiga iyo heerka
math-e5-l5.concept: **Heerku** waa qaddarka la barbar dhigayo oo lagu qaybiyey qaddarka aasaasiga ah. Marka heerka lagu dhufto 100 waa **boqolkiiba (%)**.

math-e6-ari1.title: Xisaabta isku-dhafan ee tirooyinka dabiiciga ah
math-e6-ari1.concept: Haddii isku-dar, kala-jar, isku-dhufasho, iyo qaybin isku qasan yihiin, marka hore xisaabi **gudaha qawsyada**, kaddib **isku-dhufashada iyo qaybinta**, ugu dambeyntana **isku-darka iyo kala-jarka** ka bilow bidixda.

math-e6-ari2.title: Kor-u-qaadis, hoos-u-dhigis, qiyaasid
math-e6-ari2.concept: **Kor-u-qaadistu** waxay kor u qaadaa dhammaan waxa ka hooseeya meesha la rabo, **hoos-u-dhigistu** dhammaan way tuurtaa. **Qiyaasidda** haddii meesha toos ah ka hooseysa tahay 5 ama ka badan kor u qaad, haddii ay tahay 4 ama ka yar tuur.

math-e6-dat1.title: Garaafka xarigga iyo garaafka goobaabinta
math-e6-dat1.concept: **Garaafka xarigga** iyo **garaafka goobaabinta** waxay u arkaan wadarta 100%, waxayna muujiyaan heerka qayb kasta. Tirada qaybta=wadarta×heerka.

math-e6-geo1.title: Wareegga goobaabinta iyo cabbirkeeda
math-e6-geo1.concept: Wareegga goobaabinta=dhexroor×pi, cabbirka goobaabinta=raadiyaha×raadiyaha×pi. Pi waa qiyaastii $3.14$.

math-e6-geo2.title: Sanduuqa iyo mukhaabka
math-e6-geo2.concept: Mugga=dherer×ballaadh×sarrayn, cabbirka dusha=(wadarta cabbirka saddex wejiyo)×2. Sanduuqu wuxuu leeyahay 6 weji, 12 geesood, 8 geeso-gees.

math-e6-l1.title: Isku-dhufashada iyo qaybinta jajabyada iyo tobanleyaasha
math-e6-l1.concept: Isku-dhufashada jajabyada, korreeyayaasha isku dhufo, hooseeyayaashana isku dhufo. Qaybinta jajabyada, **is-celiye** (reciprocal) ku dhufo.

math-e6-l2.title: Isla'egaha saamiga iyo qaybinta saamiga
math-e6-l2.concept: Isla'egta saamiga, **isku-dhufashada tirooyinka gudaha = isku-dhufashada tirooyinka dibadda**. Marka wadarta lagu qaybiyo saami waa **qaybinta saamiga**.

math-e6-l3.title: Boqolkiiba
math-e6-l3.concept: **Boqolkiiba (%)** waa heerka marka qaddarka aasaasiga ah loo arko 100. Marka tobanle lagu dhufto 100 waa %.

math-e6-l4.title: Goobaabinta iyo shaxanka saddex-cabbir
math-e6-l4.concept: Wareegga goobaabinta waa **dhexroor × 3.14**, cabbirka goobaabinta waa **raadiyaha × raadiyaha × 3.14**.

math-e6-l5.title: Celceliska iyo habaynta xogta
math-e6-l5.concept: **Celceliska** waa wadarta ÷ tirada, **dhexe** waa tirada bartamaha, **qaabka** waa tirada ugu badan ee soo muuqata.

math-el-ai1.title: Xogta qoraalka iyo sawirka
math-el-ai1.concept: Dukumeentiyada waxaa lagu muujiyaa vector-ka soo noqnoqoshada erayada, sawirrada-na matrix-ka qiimayaasha pixel-ka. Marka wax-dhaca vector-yadu weynaado, dukumeentiyadu way isku ekaadaan.

math-el-ai2.title: Saadaalinta iyo hagaajinta
math-el-ai2.concept: Jiidashada xariiqda isbeddelka, celceliska labajibbaarrada khaladka (khasaaraha), iyo hab-hoosaadka jiidashada $x_{\text{cusub}}=x-\eta f'(x)$ ayaa hagaajiya saadaalinta.

math-el-cul1.title: Xisaabta fanka iyo nolosha
math-el-cul1.concept: Saamiga dahabka waa qiyaastii 1.618, codka octave ka sarreeya wuxuu leeyahay soo noqnoqosho laba jeer ah, tirada xaaladaha lixda dhibic ee Braille waa $2^6-1=63$, aqlabiyaddu waa tiro ka badan kala-bar wadarta.

math-el-cul2.title: Xisaabta bulshada iyo deegaanka
math-el-cul2.concept: Celceliska xogta iyo heerka kordhka ayaa lagu falanqeeyaa dhibaatooyinka bulshada iyo deegaanka. Heerka kordhka=(qaddarka kordhay)÷(qiimaha hore)×100.

math-el-econ1.title: Dulsaar, sarrifka lacagta, canshuur
math-el-econ1.concept: Dulsaarka fudud=maalgelin×heer×muddo, dulsaarka isku-dhafan waa maalgelin×(1+heer)^muddo. Sarrifku waa qiimaha hal unug oo lacag shisheeye ah, canshuurtuna waa qiimaha lagu dhufto saamiga.
math-el-econ1.example: 10000 won, 10% sannadkii oo isku-dhafan 2 sano → 12100 won

math-el-econ2.title: Dalab, bixin iyo hagaajin
math-el-econ2.concept: Meesha ay isu gudbaan qalooca dalabka iyo bixintu waa dheelitirka. Qiimaha ugu weyn ee dakhliga R=pq iyo isu-qaadashada waxaa lagu helaa shaqooyin iyo kala-bixid.

math-el-job1.title: Beddelka cutubyada iyo saamiyada
math-el-job1.concept: 1 m=100 cm, 1 kg=1000 g, 1 saac=60 daqiiqo. Qiimaha dhimista=qiimaha×(1−heerka dhimista), marka lagu qasay saamiga a:b, A waa $\frac{a}{a+b}$ wadarta.

math-el-job2.title: Cabbir, tirada xaaladaha, heerka kordhka
math-el-job2.concept: Cabbirka ayaa lagu helaa qaddarka alaabta loo baahan yahay, sharciga isku-dhufashada ayaa lagu helaa tirada lammaanayaasha suurtagalka ah, heerka kordhkana waa (qaddarka kordhay)÷(qiimaha hore)×100.

math-el-res1.title: Hababka cilmi-baarista
math-el-res1.concept: Cilmi-baarista hawsha xisaabta waxaa lagu sameeyaa hababka sida baaritaanka suugaanta, baaritaanka tusaalooyinka, tijaabada xisaabta, iyo cilmi-baarista horumarinta.
math-el-res1.example: Laba-geeska dhagaxa si toos ah u tuur oo raadi qaabka → tijaabo xisaabeed

math-el-res2.title: Tallaabooyinka cilmi-baarista iyo anshaxa
math-el-res2.concept: Cilmi-baaristu waxay u socotaa sida: doorashada mawduuca → qorshe → fulin → soo bandhigid → milicsi. Anshaxa cilmi-baarista waa in la sheego il-ka-soo-qaadashada oo aan natiijada la been-abuurin.
math-el-res2.example: Ka dib doorashada mawduuca waa qorshaha cilmi-baarista

math-el-sta1.title: Dhibaatooyinka tirakoobka iyo muunadda
math-el-sta1.concept: Leexashada caadiga ahi waa xididka labajibbaarka celceliska labajibbaarrada leexashada (kala-duwanaanshaha). Muunadda waxaa lagu doortaa doorasho random ah, doorasho lakab-lakab ah, doorasho koox-koox ah, doorasho nidaamsan iwm.

math-el-sta2.title: Qiyaasid iyo tijaabinta male-awaalka
math-el-sta2.concept: Xadka khaladka ee kala-duwanaanshaha kalsoonida 95% waa $1.96\times\frac{σ}{\sqrt{n} }$. Haddii qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee tirakoobka tijaabada $z=\frac{\bar{x}-\mu}{σ/\sqrt{n} }$ uu ka weyn yahay 1.96, male-awaalka eber waa la diidayaa heerka muhiimadda 5%.

math-h1-fnc1.title: Shaqada isku-dhafka ah iyo shaqada lidka ah
math-h1-fnc1.concept: Shaqada isku-dhafka ah $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$ waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa shaqada gudaha marka hore. Shaqada lidka ahi waa shaqada marka $f(x)=y$ uu $f^{-1}(y)=x$.

math-h1-geo1.title: Shaxanno ku yaal heyska isku-duwaha
math-h1-geo1.concept: Fogaanta labada bar waa $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2}$, bartamuhu waa celceliska isku-duwayaasha, jiidashaduna waa $\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$.

math-h1-geo2.title: Isla'egta goobada
math-h1-geo2.concept: Isla'egta goobada bartamihiisu yahay $(a, b)$ iyo raadiyaskeedu yahay $r$ waa $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$. Masaafada u dhexeysa barta $(x_0,y_0)$ iyo xariiqda $ax+by+c=0$ waa $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$.

math-h1-l1.title: Qaybinta tiro-badan iyo aragtida inta harta
math-h1-l1.concept: Inta harta marka $P(x)$ lagu qaybiyo $x-a$ waa $P(a)$, haddii $P(a)=0$ na $x-a$ waa qodob.

math-h1-l2.title: Tirooyinka isku-dhafan iyo kala-saaridda isla'egta laba-jibaaran
math-h1-l2.concept: $i^2=-1$, haddii kala-saaraha $D=b^2-4ac<0$ waxay leedahay xalal male-awaal ah. Xalalka male-awaalka ah ee isla'egta laba-jibaaran ee isku-xigaalo dhabta ah waxay yimaadaan lammaane isku-xidhan.

math-h1-l3.title: Sinnaan-la'aanta laba-jibaaran
math-h1-l3.concept: Xalka waxaa laga akhriyaa meesha garaafka howsha laba-jibaaran uu u dhigan yahay dhidibka $x$. $(x-a)(x-b)<0$ waa inta u dhexeysa labada xal, $>0$ na waa inta ka baxsan labada xal.

math-h1-l4.title: Isku-xigxigaal iyo isku-dhafka doorashada
math-h1-l4.concept: Haddii kala-horeyntu muhiim tahay waa isku-xigxigaal $_nP_r$, haddii kale waa isku-dhafka doorashada $_nC_r$. 'Ugu yaraan hal' waxaa la helaa adigoo wadarta ka jara dhacdada ka soo horjeedda.

math-h1-l5.title: Isla'egta xariiqda iyo goobada
math-h1-l5.concept: Masaafada u dhexeysa barta iyo xariiqda $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2} }$, goobada $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$, xariiqda taabanaysa waxay si toos ah u taagan tahay raadiyaska.
math-h1-l5.example: Dhalmada xariiqda taabanaysa ee goobada $x^2+y^2=25$ barta $(3,\ 4)$ $=-\frac34$

math-h1-mat1.title: Macnaha iyo falalka matrixka
math-h1-mat1.concept: **Matrixku** waa tirooyin loo habeeyay qaab afargeesle ah. Isku-darka, ka-jarista iyo isku-dhufashada tiro dhabta ah waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa qaybaha isla meel ku jira, qaybta (i, j) ee isku-dhufashada $AB$ waa wadarta isku-dhufashada qaybaha safka i ee $A$ iyo tiirka j ee $B$ si isku xigta.

math-h1-pol1.title: Qaybinta qodobbada iyo isla'egaha darajada saddexaad iyo afraad
math-h1-pol1.concept: Isla'egaha darajada saddexaad iyo afraad waxaa lagu xaliyaa **qaybinta qodobbada** adigoo isticmaalaya qaybinta isku-darka ama beddelaadda, kadibna hel qiimayaasha qodob kasta ka dhigaya 0. Qodobbada laba-jibaaran, kala-saaraha ayaa lagu hubiyaa in ay leeyihiin xal dhab ah.

math-h1-set1.title: Kooxaha iyo hadalada
math-h1-set1.concept: $n(A\cup B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cap B)$, koox leh n xubnood waxay leedahay $2^n$ kooxo-hoose. Ka soo horjeedka hadalka 'haddii p markaas q' wuxuu leeyahay run iyo been la mid ah kan asalka ah, laakiin rogiddiisu ma ahan mid sidaas ah.

math-h2-geo1.title: Saddex-geesyada iyo howlaha saddex-geeska
math-h2-geo1.concept: Sharciga sine $\frac{a}{\sin A}=2R$, sharciga cosine $c^2=a^2+b^2-2ab\cos C$, aagga saddex-geeska $\frac12ab\sin C$.

math-h2-geo2.title: Radiyaan iyo qaybaha goobada
math-h2-geo2.concept: $180^\circ=\pi$ radiyaan. Qaybta goobada oo raadiyaskeedu yahay $r$ iyo xagalka dhexe $\theta$ (radiyaan), dhererka qaansadu waa $r\theta$, aaggu na waa $\frac12r^2\theta$.

math-h2-l1.title: Tilmaamayaasha iyo logarithm-yada
math-h2-l1.concept: $\log_a b=x \iff a^x=b$. Wadarta logarithm-yada waa isku-dhufashada qaybaha gudaha, farqiguna waa qaybinta. Koritaanka tilmaame waxaa lagu muujiyaa $a\cdot r^t$.

math-h2-l2.title: Howlaha saddex-geeska
math-h2-l2.concept: $\pi$ radiyaan $=180^\circ$. Rubuc kasta calaamadaha $\sin,\ \cos,\ \tan$ way ku kala duwan yihiin. $y=a\sin bx+c$ qiimaha ugu weyn waa $|a|+c$, wareegguna waa $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$.

math-h2-l4.title: Xadka howlaha iyo joogtaynta
math-h2-l4.concept: Qaabka $\frac00$ u qaybi qodobbo oo fududee, marka $x\to\infty$ u qaybi qodobka ugu sarreeya. Haddii ay joogto tahay, xadka bidix, xadka midig iyo qiimaha howshu dhammaantood waa isku mid.

math-h2-l5.title: Kala-duwidda iyo isticmaalkeeda
math-h2-l5.concept: $(x^n)'=nx^{n-1}$. $f'(a)$ waa dhalmada xariiqda taabanaysa, calaamadda $f'$ ayaana muujisa korodh, hoos u dhac iyo qiimayaasha ugu weyn/yar. Xawaaruhu waa dhalmada booska.

math-h2-seq1.title: Wadarta taxanaha iyo ∑
math-h2-seq1.concept: $\sum_{k=1}^{n} a_k$ micnaheedu waa $a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_n$. $\sum k=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}$, $\sum c=cn$, $\sum(a_k+b_k)=\sum a_k+\sum b_k$.

math-h3-cal1.title: Kala-duwidda howlo kala duwan
math-h3-cal1.concept: Howsha isku-dhafan waxaa la kala duwaa (dhalmada howsha dibadda)×(dhalmada howsha gudaha), qaybinta na $\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^2}$. $(e^x)'=e^x$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$, $(\sin x)'=\cos x$, $(\cos x)'=-\sin x$.

math-h3-cnt1.title: Isku-xigxigaal ku celcelin, isku-dhafka ku celcelin iyo aragtida laba-god
math-h3-cnt1.concept: Tirada **isku-xigxigaalka ku celcelinta** ee safka iyadoo la oggol yahay ku celcelinta waa (tirada doorashooyinka) oo lagu dhufto tirada meelaha. Isku-xigxigaalka leh walxo isku mid ah waa factorial-ka guud oo lagu qaybiyo factorial-ka walxaha isku midka ah, **isku-dhafka ku celcelinta** na waa $_nH_r={}_{n+r-1}C_r$. Isku-xigaalka $x^k$ ee $(x+1)^n$ waa $_nC_k$.
math-h3-cnt1.example: Habka loo safeeyo aabbc waa $5!\div(2!\times2!)=30$ habab

math-h3-geo1.title: Qalooca darajada labaad
math-h3-geo1.concept: Xudunta parabola $y^2=4px$ waa $(p,0)$, ellipse $\frac{x^2}{a^2}+\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ waxay leedahay $c^2=a^2-b^2$, hyperbola na waa $c^2=a^2+b^2$.

math-h3-geo2.title: Vektarrada dhidibka
math-h3-geo2.concept: Cabbirka vektarka $(x,y)$ waa $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$, isku-dhufashada dhibcuhu waa $x_1x_2+y_1y_2$, haddii labada vektar ay si toos ah isu taagan yihiin isku-dhufashadu waa 0.

math-h3-l1.title: Isku-dhafka aan xadidnayn iyo kan cayiman
math-h3-l1.concept: $\int x^n dx=\frac{x^{n+1} }{n+1}+C$, $\int_a^b f(x)dx=F(b)-F(a)$. Haddii xadka sare iyo hoose la beddelo calaamaddu way isbeddelaysaa, inta waa la kala qaybin karaa.

math-h3-l2.title: Isticmaalka isku-dhafka cayiman
math-h3-l2.concept: Aagga waxaa lagu helaa isku-dhafka $|f(x)|$. Qaybta garaafku ka hoosayso dhidibka $x$ si gaar ah u kala qaybi, labada qalooc dhexdooda isku-dhaf (sare)−(hoose). Isku-dhafka xawaaruhu waa masaafada la socdey.

math-h3-l3.title: Taxanaha juqraafiga ee aan dhammaanayn
math-h3-l3.concept: Haddii $|r|<1$, $\sum ar^{n-1}=\frac{a}{1-r}$ wuu isu uruuriyaa, haddii $|r|\ge 1$ na wuu kala firdhiyaa. Waxaa loo isticmaalaa tobanleyaasha soo noqnoqda iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa soo noqnoqda.

math-h3-l4.title: Suurtagalnimada shuruudaysan iyo madaxbannaanida
math-h3-l4.concept: $P(B\mid A)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(A)}$. Haddii ay madaxbannaan yihiin $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, tijaabooyinka madaxbannaanna waa $_nC_k\,p^k(1-p)^{n-k}$.

math-h3-l5.title: Qaybinta laba-magacoodka iyo qaybinta caadiga ah
math-h3-l5.concept: Celceliska $B(n,p)$ waa $np$, kala-duwanaanshuhuna waa $np(1-p)$. Qaybinta caadiga ah waxaa lagu heeriyaa $Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$, waxayna isku mid tahay dhinac kasta oo celceliska ah.

math-h3-pro1.title: Sharciga isku-darka suurtagalnimada iyo dhacdada ka soo horjeedda
math-h3-pro1.concept: $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Suurtagalnimada dhacdada ka soo horjeedda waa $P(A^c)=1-P(A)$.

math-l1.title: Helitaanka qiimaha tibaaxaha
math-l1.concept: Ku beddelidda xaraf tiro waxaa la yiraahdaa **beddelid**. Natiijada la helo marka la beddelo waa **qiimaha tibaaxaha**. Marka tiro taban la geliyo, isticmaal qaansooyin si aad u yarayso khaladaadka.

math-l2.title: Sifooyinka isle'egta
math-l2.concept: Isle'egtu waa sida **miisaan**. Haddii labada dhinac aad ugu darto ama ka jarto, ku dhufato ama (tiro aan 0 ahayn) ku qaybiso isla tiro, miisaanku waa isku dheelitiran yahay.
math-l2.example: Haddii labada dhinac ee $x+5=9$ laga jaro $5$, $x=4$.

math-l3.title: Xallinta isle'egga heerka koowaad
math-l3.concept: Erayada $x$ leh dhinac ka dhig, tirooyinkana dhinaca kale, **u wareeji** oo isku soo wad. Marka la wareejiyo calaamaddu way beddelmaysaa. Ugu dambayn ku qaybi tirada $x$ ka hor taal, waa dhammaatay!

math-l4.title: Xallinta dhibaatooyin isle'egyo adigoo isticmaalaya
math-l4.concept: Dhibaatooyinka erayada, waxaa loo xalliyaa sida soo socota: **wixii la raadinayo u dhig $x$** → weedhaha u beddel isle'eg → xalli → hubi in jawaabtu ku habboon tahay shuruudaha.
math-l4.example: Tiro $3$ jeer ah oo lagu daray $2$ waa $14$ → $3x+2=14$ → $x=4$

math-m1-crd1.title: Dusha isku-xidhka
math-m1-crd1.concept: Goobta barta waxaa lagu muujiyaa (isku-xidhka x, isku-xidhka y). Calaamadaha ayaa go'aamiya rubucyada 1 ilaa 4, hawlgalka ka-tarjumidda dhidibka x-na wuxuu beddelaa calaamadda isku-xidhka y.

math-m1-fac1.title: Qaybinta arrimaha koowaad iyo isku-qaybiyaha ugu weyn iyo isku-dhufta ugu yar
math-m1-fac1.concept: U muujinta tiro dabiici ah wax-isku-dhufka tirooyinka koowaad waa **qaybinta arrimaha koowaad**. Qaybiyaha guud ee ugu weyn waa **isku-qaybiyaha ugu weyn**, isku-dhufashada guud ee ugu yar waa **isku-dhufta ugu yar**.

math-m1-geo1.title: Sifooyinka xagallada iyo shax-badan
math-m1-geo1.concept: Xagallada is-hor yaal waa isku mid, xariiqyada is-barbar socda xagallada u dhigma iyo kuwa is-beddelka ah waa isku mid. Wadarka xagallada gudaha ee $n$-geesood waa $180^\circ\times(n-2)$.

math-m1-geo2.title: Cabbirka qaybta goobada iyo shaxyada saddex-cabbirka ah
math-m1-geo2.concept: Dhererka qaanso $=2\pi r\times\frac{a}{360}$, aagga qaybta goobada $=\pi r^2\times\frac{a}{360}$, mugga goob dhammaystiran $=\frac43\pi r^3$, mugga koon $=\frac13\pi r^2h$.

math-m1-neg1.title: Xisaabinta tirooyinka buuxda iyo jajabyada
math-m1-neg1.concept: Marka laba tiro oo calaamad isku mid ah la isku daro, qiimaha buuxa isku dar; haddii calaamadaha kala duwan yihiin, farqiga qiimayaasha buuxa ka qaado calaamadda midka weyn. Isku-dhufashada iyo qaybinta, haddii calaamadaha isku mid yihiin waa +, haddii kala duwan yihiin waa −.

math-m1-prp1.title: Saamiga toosan iyo saamiga rogan
math-m1-prp1.concept: **Saamiga toosan** waa qaabka y=ax, **saamiga rogan** waa qaabka $y=\frac{a}{x}$. Saamiga toosan, y÷x waa joogto; saamiga rogan, x×y waa joogto.
math-m1-prp1.example: Saamiga toosan marka x=2 y=6 yahay: y=3x

math-m1-sta1.title: Qiimaha wakiilka iyo soo noqnoqoshada qaraabada
math-m1-sta1.concept: **Dhexe** waa qiimaha dhexe marka loo kala horreeyo cabbirka, **qaabka** waa qiimaha ugu badan ee soo muuqda. **Soo noqnoqoshada qaraabada**=(soo noqnoqosho)÷(wadarta soo noqnoqoshada).

math-m2-geo1.title: Sifooyinka saddex-xagalka iyo afar-xagalka
math-m2-geo1.concept: Laba xagal-salka saddex-xagalka laba-dhinac-lihi waa isku mid. Xagal-afar is-barbar socda, wadarta laba xagal oo ku xigta waa $180^\circ$, qaybta isku xidha bartamaha labada dhinac ee saddex-xagalna waa $\frac12$ dhinaca kale.

math-m2-geo2.title: Isku-eg-nimada iyo aragtida Pythagoras
math-m2-geo2.concept: Shaxanka isku-egga ah, saamiga dhinacyada is-waafaqsan waa isku mid, saamiga cabbirkuna waa labajibbaarka saamiga isku-eg-nimada. Saddex-xagal xagal-toosan, $a^2+b^2=c^2$.

math-m2-l1.title: Sharciyada tilmaameed iyo kala-badan
math-m2-l1.concept: Isku-dhufashada isla salka leh, tilmaamayaasha isku dar; awoodda awoodda, tilmaamayaasha isku dhufo. Kala-badnaanta, isku soo wada xubnaha isla xarafka leh.

math-m2-l2.title: Nidaamka isla'egaha toosan
math-m2-l2.concept: Laba isla'eg ka tirtir hal xaraf si aad u hesho xalka. Dooro habka isku-darka iyo kala-jarka ama habka beddelka iyadoo ku xiran xaaladda.

math-m2-l3.title: Isla'eg-la'aanta toosan
math-m2-l3.concept: Waxaa loo xalliyaa sida sifooyinka isla'egta, laakiin marka tiro taban lagu dhufto ama lagu qaybiyo, jihada calaamadda isla'eg-la'aanta way rogmataa.

math-m2-l4.title: Shaqada toosan iyo garaafka
math-m2-l4.concept: Gudaha $y=ax+b$, $a$ waa jiidashada, $b$-na waa $y$-gooyaha. Xariiqaha is-barbar socda jiidashadooda waa isku mid.

math-m2-l5.title: Tirada xaaladaha iyo suurtagalnimada
math-m2-l5.concept: Suurtagalnimadu waa (tirada xaaladaha dhici kara)÷(tirada dhammaan xaaladaha). Dhacdooyinka madaxbannaan ee isku mar dhaca isku dhufo, 'ugu yaraan' waxaa loo isticmaalaa dhacdada dheeraadka ah.

math-m2-lfn1.title: Shaqada toosan iyo isla'egta toosan
math-m2-lfn1.concept: Shaqada toosan y=ax+b, a waa jiidashada, b-na waa y-gooyaha. Barta isu gudbinta labada garaaf waa xalka nidaamka labada isla'eg.

math-m2-rec1.title: Tobanlaha soo noqnoqda
math-m2-rec1.concept: Tobanlaha ay lambarrada isku mid ah ay si joogto ah ugu soo noqnoqdaan dhibicda ka dambeysa waxaa la yiraahdaa **tobanle soo noqnoqda**, qaybta soo noqnoqdana waa **xiddigga soo noqnoqda**. Haddii hooseeyaha jajabka aan la gaabin karin uu yahay 2 ama 5 oo keliya, waa tobanle xadaysan.

math-m3-geo1.title: Saamiyada saddex-xagalka
math-m3-geo1.concept: Saddex-xagal xagal-toosan, $\sin A$ waa (sarraynta)÷(hypotenuse), $\cos A$ waa (salka)÷(hypotenuse), $\tan A$ waa (sarraynta)÷(salka).

math-m3-geo2.title: Sifooyinka goobaabinta
math-m3-geo2.concept: Xagalka wareegga ee qaanso keliya waa $\frac12$ xagalka dhexe. Taabashadu waxay ku toosan tahay raadiyaha, wadarta xagallada is-hortaagan ee afar-xagalka goobaabinta ku dhex jira-na waa $180^\circ$.

math-m3-l1.title: Xididka labajibbaarka iyo tirooyinka dhabta ah
math-m3-l1.concept: $\sqrt{a}$ waa tirada aan taban ee labajibbaarkeedu yahay $a$. Labajibbaarrada xididka gudaha waxaa lagu soo saaraa dibadda, xididka hooseeyahana waa la rationalize-gareeyaa.

math-m3-l2.title: Sharciyada isku-dhufashada iyo qodista
math-m3-l2.concept: $(a+b)^2=a^2+2ab+b^2$, $(a+b)(a-b)=a^2-b^2$. Qodistu waa isticmaalka sharciyada isku-dhufashada dib u noqosho.

math-m3-l3.title: Isla'egaha labaad-darajada
math-m3-l3.concept: Qod si aad u samayso qaabka $AB=0$ oo xalli. Kala-soocaha $D=b^2-4ac$ wuxuu muujiyaa tirada xididdada, xidhiidhka xididdada iyo isku-dhufashooyinkana waa la isticmaali karaa.

math-m3-l4.title: Shaqada labaad-darajada iyo garaafka
math-m3-l4.concept: Kor-geeska $y=a(x-p)^2+q$ waa $(p,\ q)$, calaamadda $a$-na waxay go'aamisaa jihada garaafka. Marka loo beddelo labajibbaar dhamaystiran, kor-geeska ayaa la heli karaa.

math-m3-l5.title: Saamiyada saddex-geesoodka (trigonometric ratios)
math-m3-l5.concept: Saddex-geesood qaabaysan xagal toosan, $\sin A=\frac{\text{dhinaca ka soo horjeeda} }{\text{hypotenuse} }$, $\cos A=\frac{\text{dhinaca ku dhow} }{\text{hypotenuse} }$, $\tan A=\frac{\text{dhinaca ka soo horjeeda} }{\text{dhinaca ku dhow} }$.

math-m3-sta1.title: Variance iyo standard deviation

alg_arithFirstExceeds.prompt: Taxanaha xisaabeed ee eraygiisa kowaad yahay ${a}$ kala duwanaanshuhuna yahay ${d}$, wadarka laga bilaabo eraygii 1aad ilaa eraygii $n$aad waxaa loo yaqaan $S_n$. Marka $S_n>{N}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar ee tirada dabiiciga ah $n$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Qor $S_n=\frac{n(2a+(n-1)d)}{2}$ sidii isle'eg laba-jibbaaran oo ku saabsan $n$.
Xalli sinnaan-la'aanta laba-jibbaaran ama gelin $n=1,2,3,\dots$ si isdaba-joog ah oo raadi meesha ugu horreysa ee ay dhaafto.
alg_arithFirstExceeds.explanation: $S_n=\frac{n(2\times{ab}+(n-1)\times{d})}{2}$, marka $n=1,2,\dots,{m1}$ $S_n$ dhammaantood waa ${N}$ ama ka yar (qiimaha ugu weyn ${s1}$), $S_{{ans}}={s2}>{N}$, sidaa darteed $n$ la rabaa waa ${ans}$.

alg_arithGeoMix.prompt: Saddexda tiro $x$, $y$, $z$ ayaa u samaysan taxane xisaabeed oo farqigiisu togan yahay sida u kala horreeya, wuxuuna yahay $x+y+z={S}$. Saddexda tiro ee u samaysan taxane juqraafi ah sida u kala horreeya waa $x$, $y$, $z+{k}$. Waa maxay farqiga guud? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Haddii farqiga guud la yiraahdo $d$, $x=y-d$, $z=y+d$, $3y=S$.
Ku beddel shuruudda taxanaha juqraafiga $y^{2}=x(z+k)$ si aad u hesho isla'eg labajibaaran oo $d$ ah.
alg_arithGeoMix.explanation: $y=\frac{{S}}{3}={y}$, $x={y}-d$, $z={y}+d$, sidaa darteed ${y}^{2}=({y}-d)({y}+d+{k})$, taasoo ah $d^{2}+{k}d-{yk}=0$. Maadaama farqigu yahay mid togan, $d={ans}$.

alg_arithSumMax.prompt: Taxanaha xisaabeed $\{a_n\}$ marka $a_{{p}}={u}$, $a_{{q}}={v}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee wadarta $S_n$ ee eraygii ugu horreeyay ilaa eraygii $n$-aad? ($n$ waa tiro dabiici ah) (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Eeg calaamadda farqiga guud; wadartu way weynaataa kaliya inta ay erayadu yihiin kuwo togan.
Hel eraygii ugu horreeyay iyo farqiga guud, kadibna hel wadarta ilaa eraygii ka hor kii ugu horreeyay ee noqda $0$ ama ka yar.
alg_arithSumMax.explanation: Eraygii ugu horreeyay waa ${a1}$, farqiga guud waa ${d}$, sidaa darteed $a_n>0$ marka $n\le{nm}$, $a_{{nm1}}\le0$. Sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu weyn waa $S_{{nm}}=\frac{{nm}(2\times{a1}+({nm}-1)\times({d}))}{2}={ans}$.
