$a_3$ wuxuu noqdaa tiro-badan darajo labaad oo $p$ ah. Dooro xalka togan.

alg_rootEval.prompt: Hel qiimaha soo socda. ${expr}$ (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: U qor tirada xididka gudaheeda sida awood tiro kale.
Isticmaal sifada ku habboon ee ka mid ah $\sqrt[n]{a}\sqrt[n]{b}=\sqrt[n]{a\times b}$, $\frac{\sqrt[n]{a}}{\sqrt[n]{b}}=\sqrt[n]{\frac{a}{b}}$, $\sqrt[m]{\sqrt[n]{a}}=\sqrt[mn]{a}$.

alg_sectorForward.prompt: Marka qaybta goobo ah oo raadiyaskeedu yahay ${r}$ cm, xagalka dhexena yahay ${th}$, dhererka qaansadu yahay $a\pi$ cm, aaggeeduna yahay $b\pi$ cm$^{2}$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b$? (Ku qor jajab aan la dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, ku qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka xagalka dhexe loo beddelo radiyaan, dhererka qaansada waa $l=r\theta$, aaggu waa $S=\frac{1}{2}r^{2}\theta$.
Marka hore hel imisa jeer ayuu $\theta$ yahay $\pi$.

alg_sectorPerimArea.prompt: Waxaa jira laba qaybood oo goobo ah oo wareeggoodu yahay ${P}$ cm, aaggooduna yahay ${S}$ cm$^{2}$ (xagalka dhexe wuu ka yar yahay $2\pi$). Kuwaas, waa imisa cm raadiyaska qaybta raadiyaskeedu weyn yahay? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Haddii raadiyaska uu yahay $r$ iyo dhererka qaansada $l$, wareegga waa $2r+l$, aaggu waa $\frac{1}{2}rl$.
Marka $l$ la baabi'iyo, waxay noqotaa isla'eg labajibaaran oo $r$ ah.
alg_sectorPerimArea.explanation: $2r+l={P}$, $\frac{1}{2}rl={S}$, marka $l$ la baabi'iyo ${work}$, sidaa darteed raadiyaska weyn waa ${ans}$ cm.

alg_seqIntTerms.prompt: Marka eraygii guud ee taxanaha $\{a_n\}$ uu yahay $a_n=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$, imisa eray ayaa tiro dhan ah? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: U qaybi jajabka sare hooseeyaha si aad ugu beddesho qaabka $a_n=k+\frac{c}{n+r}$ ($k$ waa tiro dhan, $c$ waa joogto).
Tiri qaybiyayaasha joogtada ee hooseeyaha $n+r$ noqon karo (tirada dabiiciga ah $n$ ee $n+r\ge{r1}$).
alg_seqIntTerms.explanation: ${work}$, sidaa darteed tirada erayada tirada dhan ah waa ${ans}$.

alg_seriesPattern.prompt: Hel qiimaha wadarta soo socota. ${expr}$ (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Raadi qaanuunka oo erayga guud $a_k$ u muuji $k$.
Ku xisaabi qaabab sida $\sum k$, $\sum k^{2}$ (haddii calaamadaha is beddelaan, laba-laba isku xidh).

alg_sigmaSquare.prompt: Labada isku-xigsi $\{a_n\}$, $\{b_n\}$, marka $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_k^{2}={A}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}a_kb_k={B}$, $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}b_k^{2}={C}$, waa maxay qiimaha $\sum_{k=1}^{{n}}({comb})^{2}$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Labajibbaar qawsyada gudahooda oo fidi.
Isticmaal toosnaanta $\sum$ ($\sum(pa_k+qb_k)=p\sum a_k+q\sum b_k$) si aad ugu muujiso saddexda wadar ee la bixiyey.

alg_sigmaSubseq.prompt: Marka eraygii guud ee isku-xigsiga $\{a_n\}$ uu yahay $a_n={an}$, waa maxay qiimaha $\sum_{k=1}^{{m}}a_{{idx}}$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Meesha $n$ ee $a_n$ geli odhaahda ${idx}$. Ku beddel si aad u hesho odhaah ku saabsan $k$.
Isticmaal $\sum k=\frac{m(m+1)}{2}$, $\sum k^{2}=\frac{m(m+1)(2m+1)}{6}$, $\sum c=cm$.

alg_sigmaTelescope.prompt: Hel qiimaha wadarta soo socota. ${expr}$ (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Mid walba u kala qaybi jajabyo qayb ah. Tusaale: $\frac{1}{k(k+1)}=\frac{1}{k}-\frac{1}{k+1}$
Marka la isku daro, xubnaha hore iyo kuwa dambe si isku xigta ayaa isu gaabsada, kaliya dhowr xubnood oo hore iyo dhowr oo dambe ayaa hadha.

alg_sumToTerm.prompt: Wadarta xubinta koowaad ilaa xubinta $n$aad ee isku-xigsiga $\{a_n\}$ waa $S_n={expr}$, waa maxay qiimaha $a_{1}+a_{{k}}$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: $a_1=S_1$, marka $n\ge2$ $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$.
Ha qaadan in qiimaha marka $n=1$ lagu geliyo isla'egta $a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}$ uu la mid yahay $S_1$.

alg_survey.prompt: Fogaanta labada goob A, B waa ${d}$ m. Goob kale C marka laga eego, $\angle CAB=\alpha$, $\angle CBA=\beta$ iyo $\sin\alpha={sa}$, $\sin\beta={sb}$ ($\alpha$, $\beta$ waa xagallo fiiqan). Waa intee m fogaanta A ilaa C? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: $\angle C=180^\circ-\alpha-\beta$, sidaa darteed $\sin C=\sin(\alpha+\beta)$.

$\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta$, cosine-ka waxaa lagu helaa $\cos=\sqrt{1-\sin^{2}}$. Kaddib isticmaal sharciga sine-ka $\frac{\overline{A C}}{\sin\beta}=\frac{\overline{A B}}{\sin C}$.
alg_survey.explanation: ${work}$, sidaa darteed fogaanta A ilaa C waa ${ans}$ m.

alg_trigGraphParam.prompt: Qiimaha ugu weyn ee shaqada $y=a{fn}\,bx+c$ ($a>0$, $b>0$) waa ${M}$, qiimaha ugu yar waa ${m}$, wareegtiduna waa ${per}$, waa maxay qiimaha isku-dhufashada saddexda joogto $abc$? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Qiimaha ugu weyn waa $a+c$, qiimaha ugu yar-na waa $-a+c$.
Isticmaal in wareegtidu tahay $\frac{2\pi}{b}$ si aad u hesho $b$.

alg_trigIdentity.prompt: Tiro dhab ah $\theta$, marka ${given}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${E}$? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: $\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$. Marka labada dhinac ee isla'egta la bixiyey la labajibbaaro, $\sin\theta\cos\theta$ ayaa soo muuqda.
Isla'egta la bixiyey labajibbaar si aad u hesho qiimaha $\sin\theta\cos\theta$. Haddii isla'egta la doonayaa tahay labajibbaar kale, si isku mid ah ugu muuji $\sin\theta\cos\theta$.

alg_trigPeriod.prompt: Haddii wakhtiga togan ee ugu yar ee shaqada ${f}$ uu yahay $k\pi$, waa maxay qiimaha $k$? (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Wakhtiga $y=\sin bx$, $y=\cos bx$ waa $\frac{2\pi}{|b|}$, wakhtiga $y=\tan bx$ waa $\frac{\pi}{|b|}$.
Marka qiimaha buuxa la saaro, qaybta taban ee garaafka kor ayaa loo laabaa, wakhtiguna wuxuu noqdaa kala badh. Labajibaaraha u beddel $\sin^{2}x=\frac{1-\cos2x}{2}$, $\cos^{2}x=\frac{1+\cos2x}{2}$.

alg_trigPoint.prompt: Marka xariiqda bilowga ahi tahay jihada togan ee dhidibka $x$, iyo bar ku taal xariiqda dhamaadka ay tahay P$({xp}, {yp})$, oo cabbirka xagalku yahay $\theta$, waa maxay qiimaha ${E}$? (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore hel masaafada $r=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}$ ee asalka O ilaa barta P (marka isku-xidhka barta P uu yahay $(x, y)$).
$\sin\theta=\frac{y}{r}$, $\cos\theta=\frac{x}{r}$, $\tan\theta=\frac{y}{x}$.

alg_trigRootCount.prompt: Marka $0\le\theta<2\pi$, imisa xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan ayay leedahay isle'egga ${eq}$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Haddii aad dhigto $k\theta=\phi$, kala-duwanaanshaha $\phi$ waa $0\le\phi<2k\pi$.
Tiri tirada isgoysyada garaafka sida $y=\sin\phi$ iyo xariiqda $y=$ (joogto) wakhti kasta.

alg_trigSpecial.prompt: Hel qiimaha soo socda. ${expr}$ (Waxaad ku qori kartaa jajab tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: Xagalka u beddel xagal ka weyn ama le'eg $0^\circ$ oo ka yar $360^\circ$ (xagal leh xariiq dhamaad isku mid ah).
Isticmaal $\sin30^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\cos60^\circ=\frac{1}{2}$, $\tan45^\circ=1$ iyo calaamadaha rubuc kasta.

bm_absIneq.prompt: Xalka sinnaan-la'aanta ${ineq}$ dhexdiisa, imisa tiro oo buuxda $x$ ayaa buuxisa $-{N}\le x\le {N}$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Marka hore kala sooc in qiimaha buuxu ka yar yahay ama ka weyn yahay tiro gaar ah.

Haddii uu ka yar yahay, u beddel qaab $-c<A<c$, haddii uu ka weyn yahay, u beddel $A<-c$ ama $A>c$, kadibna hel kala-duwanaanshaha $x$ oo tiri tirooyinka buuxda ee ku jira kala-duwanaanshaha la bixiyey.
bm_absIneq.explanation: Marka calaamadda qiimaha buuxa la saaro, xalka ${ineq}$ waa ${sol}$. Kuwan ka mid ah tirooyinka buuxda ee ka weyn ama le'eg $-{N}$ oo ka yar ama le'eg ${N}$ waa ${ans}$ guud ahaan.

bm_circleLine.prompt: Goobada: ${circ}$, xariiqda: ${line}$ waxay isku goyn karaan laba bar oo kala duwan. Imisa tiro oo buuxda $m$ ayaa taas keenaya? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Haddii isle'egga xariiqda lagu beddelo isle'egga goobada, waxay noqotaa isle'eg laba-jibbaaran oo ku saabsan $x$.

Si ay laba bar oo kala duwan isugu goyso, isle'eggan laba-jibbaaran waa inuu leeyahay laba xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan. Ka hel kala-duwanaanshaha $m$ kala-soocaha $D>0$, kadibna tiri tirooyinka buuxda.
bm_circleLine.explanation: Haddii isle'egga xariiqda lagu beddelo isle'egga goobada, ${sub}=0$. Haddii kala-soocaha loo yaqaan $D$, $\frac{D}{4}={d4}$, sidaa darteed $D>0$ waxay siinaysaa ${cond}$. Maadaama ${chk}$, tirooyinka buuxda $m$ waa dhammaan tirooyinka buuxda ee ka weyn ama le'eg $-{hi}$ oo ka yar ama le'eg ${hi}$, sidaa darteed waa ${ans}$ guud ahaan.

bm_compUnknown.prompt: Laba shaqo $f(x)={f}$, $g$, marka shaqada isku-dhafan $(g\circ f)(x)={h}$, waa maxay qiimaha $g({k})$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Si aad u hesho qiimaha $g({k})$, hel $x$ marka $f(x)={k}$.
Ku geli $x$ kaas shaqada isku-dhafan $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$.
bm_compUnknown.explanation: Laga bilaabo $f(x)={k}$, $x={x0}$. $(g\circ f)({x0})=g(f({x0}))=g({k})$, sidaa darteed $g({k})={h}$ marka $x={x0}$, qiimaha waa ${ans}$.

bm_countDigits.prompt: Waxaa jira ${n}$ kaar oo mid walba ka mid ah leeyahay lambar kala duwan, lambarrada kaararka waa ${ds}$. Haddii 3 kaar la doorto oo hal safka la isku xiro si loo sameeyo lambar dabiici ah oo saddex god ah, immisa ka mid ah ayaa lambar labajibaaran (even)? (0 ma noqon karto godka hore. Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Godka keliga waa inuu noqdaa lambar labajibaaran. Marka hore dooro godka keliga, kadibna buuxi kuwa kale.

U kala qaybi xaaladaha godka keliga uu yahay 0 iyo marka uu yahay lambar labajibaaran oo aan ahayn 0, oo ku tiri permutation. Haddii lambar labajibaaran oo aan 0 ahayn uu godka keliga ku jiro, 0 ma noqon karto godka hore.
bm_countDigits.explanation: Haddii godka keliga uu yahay 0: labada god ee soo hartay waxaa laga doortaa ${n1}$ kaar ee hartay oo la isku xiraa safka, sidaa darteed ${zex}$. Haddii godka keliga uu yahay lambar labajibaaran oo aan 0 ahayn: godka keliga waxaa laga doortaa ${nz}$ kaar ee lambarrada labajibaaran ee aan 0 ahayn, godka hore waxaa laga doortaa ${n2}$ kaar ee soo hartay ee aan 0 ahayn, godka dhexe waxaa laga doortaa ${n2}$ kaar ee soo hartay, sidaa darteed ${oex}$. Sharciga isku-darka, ${z}+{o}={ans}$.

bm_discK.prompt: Lambarrada dhan ee $k$ ee ka dhigaya garaafka shaqada quadratic $y={f}$ inuu xaglinta $x$ ka gooyo laba dhibcood oo kala duwan, immisa ayaa ku jira $-{N}\le k\le {N}$? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Garaafku inuu xaglinta $x$ ka gooyo laba dhibcood oo kala duwan waa la mid ah isla'egta quadratic $y=0$ oo laba xidid oo run ah oo kala duwan leh.
Hel tirada $k$ ee ka dhigaysa discriminant $D$ inuu ka weyn yahay 0, kadibna tiri lambarrada dhan ee ku jira xadka la bixiyay.
bm_discK.explanation: Si loo helo laba xidid oo run ah oo kala duwan, discriminant $D={D}>0$ waa inuu ahaadaa, sidaa darteed ${cond}$. Lambarrada dhan ee $k$ ee tan buuxiya ee ku jira $-{N}\le k\le {N}$ dhammaantood waa ${ans}$.

bm_funcCount.prompt: Set-ka $X$ waa set-ka dhammaan lambarrada dabiiciga ah ee ${m}$ ama ka yar, set-ka $Y$ waa set-ka dhammaan lambarrada dabiiciga ah ee ${n}$ ama ka yar. Shaqooyinka $f$ ee $X$ ilaa $Y$, immisa ayaa leh $f(1)=1$ oo aan ahayn one-to-one? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Haddii $f(1)=1$, qiimaha shaqada ee curiye kasta oo haray si xor ah ayaa looga dooran karaa curiyeyaasha $Y$.
Ku hel (dhammaan shaqooyinka shuruudda buuxiya) $-$ (kuwa one-to-one ah). Shaqada one-to-one, curiyeyaasha kala duwan qiimayaashoodu way kala duwan yihiin.
bm_funcCount.explanation: Shaqooyinka $f(1)=1$ leh waa ${tot}$, maxaa yeelay ${m1}$ curiye ee soo hartay mid walba wuxuu yeelan karaa ${n}$ qiime; ka mid ahaan, kuwa one-to-one waa ${inj}$ maxaa yeelay curiyeyaasha soo hartay waa inay yeeshaan qiimayaal kala duwan oo aan ahayn 1. Sidaa darteed ${tot}-{inj}={ans}$.

bm_ineqSystem.prompt: Xalka guud ee labada inequality ee toosan ${i1}$, ${i2}$, immisa lambar oo dhan $x$ ayaa ku jira? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Mid kasta oo inequality ah si gaar ah u xal si aad marka hore u hesho tirada $x$.

Ku muuji qaybta ay labada tiro is-dhaafaan khadka lambarrada, kadibna tiri lambarrada dhan ee ku jira. Marka lagu qaybiyo ama lagu dhufto lambar taban (negative), jihada calaamadda inequality way is beddelaysaa.
bm_ineqSystem.explanation: Xalka inequality-ga koowaad wuxuu bixiyaa ${s1}$, midka labaad wuxuu bixiyaa ${s2}$. Lambarrada dhan ee ku jira tirada guud waa ${ints}$, sidaa darteed isku-darka waa ${ans}$.

bm_lineParPerp.prompt: Waxaa jira xariiq $L:{L}$ iyo dhibic $\mathrm{P}$ oo isku-duwaha ay yihiin $({x0},{y0})$. Haddii $y$-intercept ee xariiqda dhibicda $\mathrm{P}$ ka dhex gudubta oo la mid ah $L$ uu yahay $s$, $y$-intercept ee xariiqda dhibicda $\mathrm{P}$ ka dhex gudubta oo $L$ ku taagan (perpendicular) uu yahay $t$, qiimaha $s+t$ waa maxay? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Slope-ka xariiqda qaabka $ax+by+c=0$ waa $-\frac{a}{b}$, wax-isku-dhufashada slope-yada laba xariiq oo perpendicular ah waa $-1$.
Xariiqda la mid ah waxay leedahay isku-lambarro $x$ iyo $y$, xariiqda perpendicular-ka ahna waxay leedahay qaabka $bx-ay=k$ ($k$ waa constant). Geli isku-duwaha dhibicda P si aad u hesho $k$.
bm_lineParPerp.explanation: Xariiqda la mid ah waa ${par}$ marka $x=0$ la geliyo $s={s}$. Xariiqda perpendicular ah waa ${perp}$ marka $x=0$ la geliyo $t={t}$. Sidaa darteed $s+t={ans}$.

bm_matUnknown.prompt: Matrix-yada $A={A}$, $B={B}$, $C={C}$ iyo ${ex}=C$ haddii ay buuxiyaan, qiimaha isku-darka $x+y$ ee lambarrada run ah $x$, $y$ waa maxay? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Laba matrix waa isku mid marka curiyeyaasha isla meel ku jira ay isle'eg yihiin.
Ka samee isla'eg toosan curiyaha $x$ ku jira si aad u hesho $x$, kadibna si la mid ah u hel $y$.
bm_matUnknown.explanation: Isbarbardhigga curiyeyaasha $x$ leh wuxuu bixiyaa ${eqx}$, sidaa darteed $x={xv}$; isbarbardhigga curiyeyaasha $y$ leh wuxuu bixiyaa ${eqy}$, sidaa darteed $y={yv}$. Sidaa darteed $x+y={ans}$.

bm_polyExpand.prompt: Marka ballaarinta isle'egga ${expr}$ loo habeeyo si hoos-u-dhac ah ee $x$, waa maxay wadarka isku-dhufta $x^2$ iyo tirada joogtada ah? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Mid walba si gooni ah u ballaari, kadibna isku soo wad erayada isku nooca ah.
Isticmaal qaaciddada $(ax+b)^2=a^2x^2+2abx+b^2$ si ay u fududaato. Ha hilmaamin calaamadaha iyo isku-dhufyada hore.
bm_polyExpand.explanation: $({e1}){op}({e2})$, marka la habeeyo waa ${total}$. Isku-dhufta $x^2$ waa ${c2}$, tirada joogtadu waa ${c0}$, sidaa darteed wadarku waa ${ans}$.

bm_polyFactor.prompt: Natiijada qaybinta isle'egga laba-jibbaaran ${Pex}$ waa $(ax+b)(cx+d)$. $a$, $b$, $c$, $d$ waa tirooyin buuxda, $a>0$, $c>0$, $a\le c$, haddii $a=c$ markaas $b\le d$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b+c+d$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Ka fikir lammaanayaasha tirooyinka buuxda ee abuuri kara tirada joogtada ah $bd$ iyo isku-dhufta $x^2$ $ac$.
Dooro mid musharax ah oo ballaari, kadibna hubi in isku-dhufta $x$ ay la mid tahay $ad+bc$.
bm_polyFactor.explanation: ${Pex}=({f1})({f2})$ ayaa loo qaybiyaa, sidaa darteed $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$, $d={d}$ iyo $a+b+c+d={ans}$.

bm_propRange.prompt: Laba shuruudood oo ku saabsan tiro dhab ah $x$: $p:{pc}$, $q: m\le x\le {n}$. Waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee tirada buuxda $m$ si hadalka $p\to q$ uu run u noqdo? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Haddii hadalka $p\to q$ uu run yahay, kooxda runta ee $p$ waxay ku jirtaa kooxda runta ee $q$.
Marka hore hel kala-duwanaanshaha $x$ ee buuxiya $p$, kadibna ka dhig dhammaadka bidix ee kala-duwanaanshahaas ka weyn ama le'eg $m$.
bm_propRange.explanation: Kooxda runta ee $p$ waa $\{x\mid {lo}{rl}x{rl}{hi}\}$. Si ay ugu jirto kooxda runta ee $q$, $\{x\mid m\le x\le {n}\}$, waa inay noqotaa $m\le {lo}$ iyo ${hi}\le {n}$. Sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu weyn ee tirada buuxda $m$ waa ${ans}$.

bm_quadRange.prompt: Shaqada laba-jibbaaran $f(x)={f}$ marka ${s}\le x\le {t}$, haddii qiimaha ugu weyn ee $f(x)$ uu yahay $M$, ugu yarna $m$, waa maxay qiimaha $M+m$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: U beddel qaab $f(x)=a(x-p)^2+q$ si aad u hesho dhaafka.
Maadaama isku-xidhka $x$ ee dhaafku ku jiro kala-duwanaanshaha la bixiyey, barbar dhig qiimayaasha shaqada ee dhaafka iyo labada dhammaad ee kala-duwanaanshaha.
bm_quadRange.explanation: $f(x)={vf}$, sidaa darteed dhaafku waa $({h},{k})$ wuxuuna ku jiraa kala-duwanaanshaha. Qiimayaasha shaqada ee labada dhammaad waa $f({s})={fs}$, $f({t})={ft}$, sidaa darteed ugu weyn $M={M}$, ugu yar $m={m}$ iyo $M+m={ans}$.

bm_quadRoots.prompt: Laba xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan ee isle'egga ${eq}$ ee ku saabsan $x$, laga bilaabo kan yar, haddii loo yaqaan $\alpha$, $\beta$, waa maxay qiimaha $\beta-2\alpha$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Dhammaan erayada dhanka midig u wareeji dhanka bidix si aad u hesho qaab (laba-jibbaaran)$=0$.
Qaybi si aad u hesho labada xidid, kadibna xididka yar ka dhig $\alpha$, kan weyn $\beta$.
bm_quadRoots.explanation: Marka la habeeyo ${std}=0$ marka la qaybiyana ${fac}=0$, sidaa darteed $\alpha={al}$, $\beta={be}$. Sidaa darteed $\beta-2\alpha={ans}$.

bm_setOps.prompt: Kooxda guud $U$ waa kooxda dhammaan tirooyinka dabiiciga ah ee ka yar ama le'eg ${n}$, laba hoos-koox oo $U$ ah: $A$ waa kooxda dhammaan qaybiyayaasha ${a}$, $B$ waa kooxda dhammaan isku-dhufashooyinka ${b}$. Waa maxay wadarka dhammaan curiyeyaasha kooxda $A\cap B^{c}$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Ku qor $A$ iyo $B$ iyadoo la qorayo curiyeyaasha. $B$ waxaa laga fikiraa gudaha $U$ oo keliya.
$B^{c}$ waa inta hadhay marka curiyeyaasha $B$ laga saaro $U$. Ka dooro curiyeyaasha $A$ ee aan ku jirin $B$ oo keliya.
bm_setOps.explanation: $A=\{{As}\}$, $B=\{{Bs}\}$, sidaa darteed $A\cap B^{c}=\{{Rs}\}$, wadarka curiyeyaashuna waa ${ans}$.

bm_transform.prompt: Isku-duwaha barta $\mathrm{P}$ waa $({a},{b})$. Barta $\mathrm{P}$ waxaa lagu rarey ${p}$ jihada dhidibka $x$ iyo ${q}$ jihada dhidibka $y$ si loo helo barta $\mathrm{Q}$; $\mathrm{Q}$ waxaa loo muuqaal-rogay dhidibka $x$ si loo helo $\mathrm{R}$; $\mathrm{R}$ waxaa loo muuqaal-rogay xariiqda $y=x$ si loo helo $\mathrm{S}(m,n)$. Waa maxay qiimaha $2m+n$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Rarid: $(x,y)\to(x+p,\,y+q)$, muuqaal-rogid dhidibka $x$: $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$, muuqaal-rogid xariiqda $y=x$: $(x,y)\to(y,x)$.
Hal bar mar keliya u hel si isku xigta.

ca1_absNotDiff.prompt: Shaqada $f(x)={fx}$, waa immisa tiro dhab ah oo $k$ ah oo $f$ aanay ku lahayn kala-bixid $x=k$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: $|g(x)|$ waxay leedahay geesi meesha uu calaamadda $g(x)$ isbeddelo. Eeg in xididku calaamadda ka beddelo (ma xidid labalaab baa).
Haddii kala-badnaanta xidid kastaa tahay ker, ma lahan kala-bixid halkaas; haddii ay tahay lakab, waa lahaan kartaa kala-bixid.
ca1_absNotDiff.explanation: Xididdada odhaahda qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee ay kala-badnaantoodu tahay ker waa ${oddr}$, kuwa lakabka ah-na waa ${evenr}$. Xididka kala-badnaantiisu ker tahay, calaamaddu way isbeddeshaa, kala-bixidda bidix iyo midig way kala duwan yihiin, sidaa darteed kala-bixid ma jirto; xididka lakabka ahna kala-bixid way leedahay. Sidaa darteed tirada barooyinka la doonayaa waa ${ans}$.

ca1_areaCubicAxis.prompt: Waa maxay wadarta cabbirka labada qaybood ee ay ku xidhan yihiin qalooca $y={f}$ iyo dhidibka $x$? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Hel isku-duwaha $x$ ee barooyinka isu gudbinta qalooca iyo dhidibka $x$ (saddexda xidid ee saddex-darajada).
Qayb kasta eeg in qaloocu ka sarreeyo mise ka hooseeyo dhidibka $x$; haddii hoose yahay, calaamadda beddel marka la isku-dhafayo.
ca1_areaCubicAxis.explanation: Barooyinka isu gudbinta qalooca iyo dhidibka $x$ waa $x={rs}$. Kala-duwanaanshaha $[{r1},{r2}]$, $\int y\,dx={i1}$, kala-duwanaanshaha $[{r2},{r3}]$, $\int y\,dx={i2}$, sidaa darteed wadarta cabbirku waa $\left|{i1}\right|+\left|{i2}\right|={ansf}$.

ca1_areaLineParam.prompt: Haddii cabbirka shaxanka ay ku xidhan yihiin qalooca $y={cur}$ iyo xariiqda $y=mx$ ($0<m<{a}$) uu yahay ${S}$, waa maxay qiimaha joogtada $m$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Isku-duwaha $x$ ee barooyinka isu gudbinta qalooca iyo xariiqda waa $0$ iyo ${a}-m$.
Isku-dhaf (qalooca)−(xariiqda) inta u dhexeysa labada bar, ku muuji $m$, kaddib xalli isla'egta ay qiimahaasi la mid tahay ${S}$.
ca1_areaLineParam.explanation: Isku-duwaha $x$ ee barooyinka waa $0$ iyo ${a}-m$, cabbirkuna waa $\int_0^{{a}-m}\{({a}-m)x-x^2\}dx=\frac{({a}-m)^3}{6}$. Taasi waa ${S}$, sidaa darteed ${a}-m={d}$, taas oo ah $m={ans}$.

ca1_areaParabolaLine.prompt: Waa maxay cabbirka shaxanka ay ku xidhan yihiin barakaha $y={f}$ iyo xariiqda $y={g}$? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isla'egaha isku xidh si aad u hesho isku-duwaha $x$ ee barooyinka isu gudbinta $\alpha<\beta$.
Isku-dhaf (isla'egta sare)−(isla'egta hoose) ka bilow $\alpha$ ilaa $\beta$.
ca1_areaParabolaLine.explanation: Marka labada isla'eg la isku xidho, isku-duwaha $x$ ee barooyinka waa ${al}$, ${be}$, farqiga labada isla'egna waa ${dif}$. Marka (garaafka sare)−(garaafka hoose) lagu isku-dhafo kala-duwanaanshahan, cabbirku waa ${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_areaTangentParabola.prompt: Waa maxay cabbirka shaxanka ay ku xidhan yihiin taabashada barta ku taal barakaha $y={f}$ ee isku-duwaha $x$ uu yahay ${a}$, barakaha, iyo dhidibka $y$? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore hel isla'egta taabashada. Taabashadu waxay ku jirtaa hal dhinac oo barakaha ah (sare ama hoose).
Isku-dhaf qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee (barakaha)−(taabashada) ka bilow $x=0$ ilaa $x={a}$.
ca1_areaTangentParabola.explanation: Isla'egta taabashadu waa $y={tl}$, farqiga barakaha iyo taabashaduna waa ${dif}$. Marka qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee farqigaas lagu isku-dhafo ka bilow $x=0$ ilaa $x={a}$, cabbirku waa ${calc}={ansf}$.

ca1_contProduct.prompt: Marka loo eego shaqada ${pw}$ iyo $g(x)={gd}$ (dhammaan jaadadka ku jira $g$ waa joogto), haddii $f(x)g(x)$ ay joogto tahay dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah $x$, waa maxay qiimaha $g({kq})$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Si $f(x)g(x)$ ay u joogto tahay xitaa meesha $f$ ay ka go'an tahay, waa maxay qiimaha $g$ ee meeshaas?
Shuruudda $g=0$ ee meeshaas, ka hel jaadadka joogtada ah ee ku jira $g$.
ca1_contProduct.explanation: $f$ waxay ku booddaa ${ptxt}$, sidaa darteed si $f(x)g(x)$ u noqoto joogto, $g=0$ meelahaas. Shuruuddan ka hel joogtooyinka, $g(x)={gfull}$ iyo $g({kq})={ans}$.

ca1_contRadical.prompt: Haddii shaqada ${pw}$ ay joogto tahay $x={c}$, waa maxay qiimaha joogtada $k$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Si ay u joogto u noqoto $x={c}$, xadka marka $x\to {c}$ waa inuu noqdaa $k$.
Baabi'i xididka lambarka sare ama hoose, kadibna ka tirtir wax-soo-saarka guud.
ca1_contRadical.explanation: Si ay u joogto u noqoto, $k=\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$. Marka $x\ne {c}$, xididka la baabi'iyo oo la dhimo, $f(x)={rat}$, sidaa darteed xadka marka $x\to {c}$ waa $k={ansf}$.

ca1_contTwoJoint.prompt: Haddii shaqada ${pw}$ ay joogto tahay dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah $x$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b$ ee joogtooyinka $a$, $b$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Meelaha ay joogtanimadu go'i karto waa meesha ereygu is-beddelo, $x={p1}$, $x={p2}$.
Meel kasta samee isle'eg ah in qiimaha ereyga bidix iyo midigtu isle'eg yihiin.
ca1_contTwoJoint.explanation: Maadaama qiimaha labada dhinac uu isle'eg yahay $x={p1}$, $x={p2}$, waxaan helnaa laba isle'eg, marka la xalliyo $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Sidaa darteed $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_defIntAbs.prompt: Waa maxay qiimaha $\int_{{p}}^{{q}}|{g}|\,dx$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Raadi meesha calaamadda ereyga gudaha qiimaha saxda ah ay is beddesho, taas oo ah qiimaha $x$ ee xididka ku jira inta.
Kala qaybi inta meeshaas, ka saar qiimaha saxda ah qayb kasta, kadibna isugeyn.
ca1_defIntAbs.explanation: Ereyga gudaha qiimaha saxda ah wuxuu beddelaa calaamadda marka $x={zs}$, sidaa darteed inta waa la kala qaybiyaa. Qayb kasta calaamaddu waa joogto, sidaa darteed ku dar qiimaha saxda ah ee isugeynta qayb kasta: ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_defIntFindBound.prompt: Tirada togan $a$, haddii $\int_{{lo}}^{a}\left({g}\right)dx={V}$, waa maxay qiimaha $a$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Hel isugeynta aan xadka lahayn oo $\int_{{lo}}^{a}$ ku muuji sida polynomial-ka $a$.
Isle'egta la helay ka raadi xalka $a>{lo}$. Maadaama ereygu kordhayo, xal keliya ayaa jira.
ca1_defIntFindBound.explanation: Isugeyn aan xad lahayn waa $G(x)={G}$, sidaa darteed $G(a)-G({lo})={V}$, oo marka $a>{lo}$ qiimahani wuu kordhayaa $a$, sidaa darteed xal keliya ayaa jira. Marka la xalliyo, $a={ans}$.

ca1_defIntSplit.prompt: Shaqada joogtada ah $f(x)$, haddii $\int_{{a0}}^{{p}}f(x)\,dx={A}$, $\int_{{a0}}^{{q}}f(x)\,dx={B}$, waa maxay qiimaha $\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({mf}\right)dx$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Isticmaal sifooyinka isugeynta cayiman $\int_a^b f\,dx+\int_b^c f\,dx=\int_a^c f\,dx$ iyo $\int_b^a f\,dx=-\int_a^b f\,dx$.
Ku muuji isugeynta $f$ ee la raadinayo labada qiime ee la siiyay, qaybta joogtada ahna si gooni ah u isugeyn.
ca1_defIntSplit.explanation: Inta la raadinayo, $\int f(x)\,dx={I}$. Ereyga joogtada ah waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa $\int c\,dx=c\times(\text{dhererka jihaysan ee inta})$ oo lagu daraa. Sidaa darteed qiimuhu waa ${ans}$.

ca1_defIntSymm.prompt: Waa maxay qiimaha $\int_{-{a}}^{{a}}\left({g}\right)dx$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Inta waa isku-miisaan ku saabsan isha. Isugeynta ereyada awoodda aan lammaanayn ee $x$ waa $0$.
Balaadhi ereyga oo kaliya ereyada awoodda lammaanaha ah ka tag, kadibna xisaabi $2\int_0^{a}$.
ca1_defIntSymm.explanation: Marka ereygu habaysan yahay, isugeynta cayiman ee ereyada awoodda aan lammaanayn waa $0$, kuwa lammaanaha ahna waa ${evp}$. Sidaa darteed $2\int_0^{a}\left({evp}\right)dx={ansf}$.

ca1_derivSignMin.prompt: Marka loo eego shaqada polynomial-ka $f$, haddii ${given}$, waa maxay isugeynta dhammaan qiimayaasha $x$ ee $f$ ay ku yeelato qiime ugu yar oo deegaan ah? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Qiimaha xad-dhaafka ah wuxuu ka dhashaa meesha calaamadda $f'(x)$ is beddesho. Xididka laba-jibbaaran (u-wajaha labajibbaaran) calaamaddu isma beddesho.
Hubi calaamadda $f'(x)$ ee ka hor iyo ka dambaysa xidid kasta, oo raadi meelaha ay ka beddesho $-$ una beddesho $+$.
ca1_derivSignMin.explanation: Meesha calaamadda $f'(x)$ ka beddesho $-$ una beddesho $+$ waa meel ugu yar oo deegaan ah. Marka la sameeyo shaxda calaamadaha, meelahaasi waa marka $x$ yahay ${mins}$, isugeyntuna waa ${ans}$.

ca1_diffLimitPoly.prompt: Marka $f(x)={f}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${lim}$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Waxaad ereyga u beddeli kartaa qaabka qeexidda derivative-ka $f$, $\lim\frac{f(a+\Delta)-f(a)}{\Delta}$. Ku dar oo ka jar si ay ugu muuqato qaabka $f(x)-f({a})$ lambarka sare.
Marka hore hel qiimaha $f({a})$ ama $f'({a})$, kadibna ku kala saar si ay ugu habboonaato ereyga.
ca1_diffLimitPoly.explanation: Marka hore hel $f'(x)$: $f'({a})={d1}$ iyo $f({a})={d0}$. Marka xadka loo muujiyo derivative, ${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_diffParam.prompt: Marka shaqada ${pw}$ ay ku kala duwanaan karto $x={c}$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b$ ee tirooyinka joogtada ah $a$ iyo $b$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Haddii ay kala duwanaan karto, waa joogto $x={c}$ marka, derivative-ka bidixda iyo midigtuna waa isle'eg yihiin.
Samee laba isle'eg: qiimaha labada ereyba $x={c}$ waa isku mid, derivative-ka labada ereyna waa isku mid.
ca1_diffParam.explanation: Maadaama ay joogto tahay $x={c}$, qiimaha labada erey waa isle'eg yihiin; maadaama ay kala duwanaan karto, derivative-yada labada erey waa isle'eg yihiin. Marka la xalliyo labada isle'eg, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$, sidaa darteed $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_extremaCoef.prompt: Shaqada saddex-jibbaaran $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$, $c$ waa tirooyin joogto ah) waxay leedahay qiime ugu weyn oo deegaan ah marka $x={m}$, ugu yar oo deegaan ah marka $x={n}$, iyo $f({z})={w}$. Waa maxay isugeynta qiimaha ugu weyn iyo kan ugu yar ee deegaanka? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Meelaha ugu weyn iyo ugu yar ee deegaanka, $f'(x)=0$, sidaa darteed $f'({m})=f'({n})=0$ waxay kuu ogolaanaysaa inaad hesho $a$ iyo $b$.
Kadib markaad hesho $a$ iyo $b$, ka hel $c$ shuruudda $f({z})={w}$. Ugu dambayn xisaabi qiimaha ugu weyn $f({m})$ iyo ugu yar $f({n})$ oo isku dar.
ca1_extremaCoef.explanation: Laga bilaabo $f'({m})=f'({n})=0$, $a={av}$ iyo $b={bv}$; laga bilaabo $f({z})={w}$, $c={cv}$. Qiimaha ugu weyn ee deegaanka waa $f({m})={fm}$, ugu yarna waa $f({n})={fn}$, sidaa darteed isugeyntu waa ${ans}$.

ca1_indefInitial.prompt: Derivative-ka shaqada $f(x)$ waa $f'(x)={d}$ iyo $f({p})={q}$. Waa maxay qiimaha $f({r})$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: $f(x)$ waa isugeyn aan xad lahayn ee $f'(x)$. Hel $f(x)$ adigoo ku darsanaya joogtada isugeynta $C$.
Shuruudda $f({p})={q}$ ka hel joogtada $C$, kadibna hel qiimaha $f({r})$.
ca1_indefInitial.explanation: $f(x)=\int f'(x)\,dx={F}+C$, iyo $f({p})={q}$ waxay siinaysaa $C={C}$. Sidaa darteed $f({r})={ans}$.

ca1_indefSecond.prompt: Shaqada $f(x)$ waxay leedahay $f''(x)={d}$, $f'({p})={s}$ iyo $f({q})={w}$. Waa maxay qiimaha $f({r})$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Hal mar ku isugeyn $f''$ waxay ku siinaysaa $f'$, mar kale ku isugeyn waxay ku siinaysaa $f$. Isugeyn kasta waxay keenaysaa hal joogto.
Joogtada koowaad ka hel shuruudda $f'({p})={s}$, tan labaadna ka hel shuruudda $f({q})={w}$.
ca1_indefSecond.explanation: Marka $f''$ la isugeyn oo joogtada laga helo shuruudda $f'({p})={s}$, $f'(x)={g1}$; marka mar kale la isugeyn oo joogtada laga helo shuruudda $f({q})={w}$, $f(x)={g0}$. Sidaa darteed $f({r})={ans}$.

ca1_ineqParam.prompt: Shaqada $f(x)={f}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar ee tirada dhabta ah $a$ si aan sinnaanta la'aanta $f(x)+a\ge 0$ had iyo jeer ugu run noqoto inta u dhexaysa ${dom}$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Si $f(x)+a\ge0$ had iyo jeer u run noqoto, qiimaha ugu yar ee $f(x)$ ee inta u dhexaysa waa inuu ahaado ugu yaraan $-a$.
Hel qiimaha ugu yar ee $f(x)$ inta u dhexaysa adigoo isbarbar dhigaya qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ah iyo qiimayaasha dhammaadka.
ca1_ineqParam.explanation: Qiimaha ugu yar ee $f(x)$ inta u dhexaysa waa ${mn}$. Si $f(x)+a\ge0$ had iyo jeer u run noqoto, $a\ge {mn2}$, sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu yar ee $a$ waa ${ans}$.

ca1_integralEq.prompt: Marka shaqada kala-badan $f(x)$ ay u run tahay $f(x)={rhs}$ tiro dhab ah $x$ kasta, waa maxay qiimaha $f({k})$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt$ waa joogto aan ku xidhnayn $x$. Ka dhig $c$, kaddib $f(x)$ ku muuji $c$.
$f(x)$ kaas ku geli $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ si aad u hesho $c$.
ca1_integralEq.explanation: Haddii $\int_0^1 f(t)\,dt=c$ (joogto), $f(x)$ waa odhaah labaad-darajo ah oo ka kooban $c$. Isla'egta ah in isku-dhafka laga bilaabo $0$ ilaa $1$ uu la mid yahay $c$ waxay siinaysaa $c={c}$, $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralFuncExtremum.prompt: Marka $f(t)={f}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar ee deegaanka ee shaqada $G(x)=\int_{{s}}^{x}f(t)\,dt$? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: $G'(x)=f(x)$, sidaa darteed kordhka iyo dhimista $G$ waxaa go'aamisa calaamadda $f(x)$.
Qiimaha ugu yar ee deegaanka waa meesha $x$ ee calaamadda $f(x)$ ay ka beddesho $-$ ilaa $+$, qiimihiisuna waa $\int_{s}^{x}f(t)\,dt$.
ca1_integralFuncExtremum.explanation: Barta calaamadda $G'(x)=f(x)$ ay ka beddesho $-$ ilaa $+$ waa $x={z}$. Qiimaha ugu yar ee deegaanku waa $G({z})=\int_{{s}}^{{z}}f(t)\,dt={ansf}$.

ca1_integralFuncFind.prompt: Marka shaqada kala-badan $f(x)$ ay buuxiso $\int_{{c}}^{x}f(t)\,dt={F}$ ($a$ waa joogto) tiro dhab ah $x$ kasta, waa maxay qiimaha $f({k})$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka $x={c}$, isku-dhafka dhinaca bidix waa $0$, sidaa darteed waxaad heli kartaa $a$.
Kaddib labada dhinac ka kala-bixi $x$ si aad u hesho $f(x)$.
ca1_integralFuncFind.explanation: Marka $x={c}$ dhinaca bidix waa $0$, sidaa darteed $a={av}$. Marka labada dhinac la kala-bixiyo, $f(x)={fx}$, sidaa darteed $f({k})={ans}$.

ca1_integralLimit.prompt: Shaqada kala-badan $f(x)={f}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${lim}$? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Hooseeyaha iyo korreeyuhu labaduba waxay u dhowaadaan $0$. Isticmaal xidhiidhka u dhexeeya isku-dhafka cayiman iyo kan aan xadka lahayn $\frac{d}{d x}\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=f(x)$.
Isticmaal $F$ oo $F'(x)=f(x)$, qor $\int_a^x f(t)\,dt=F(x)-F(a)$, markaas waxay noqotaa qaabka qeexidda kala-bixiyaha.
ca1_integralLimit.explanation: Marka $F$ ay tahay $F'(x)=f(x)$ oo isku-dhafka loo qoro $F(\text{xadka sare})-F(\text{xadka hoose})$, xadku wuxuu noqdaa qaabka kala-bixiyaha $F$, qiimihiisuna waa ${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_ivtCount.prompt: Waa immisa tiro dhammaystiran oo $a$ ah oo isla'egta ${fx}=0$ ka dhigaya inay leedahay xidid dhab ah kala-duwanaanshaha furan $({m},{n})$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Shaqadani waxay kordhaysaa kala-duwanaanshaha oo dhan. Sidaa darteed calaamadaha qiimaha shaqada labada dhammaad waa inay kala duwan yihiin.
Qor shuruudda ah in calaamadaha $f({m})$, $f({n})$ ay is-lid yihiin, taas oo ah $f({m})f({n})<0$, sida isla'eg-la'aan ku saabsan $a$.
ca1_ivtCount.explanation: $f(x)={fx}$ waxay kordhaysaa maadaama $f'(x)>0$, sidaa darteed shuruudda lagama maarmaanka ah oo ku filan ee xidid dhab ah kala-duwanaanshaha ku jira waa $f({m})f({n})<0$. Tirooyinka dhammaystiran $a$ ee buuxiya waa ${alo}<a<{ahi}$, sidaa darteed waa ${ans}$.

ca1_kinCoefFind.prompt: Barta P ee ku dhaqaaqda xariiqda tirooyinka, meesheeda waqtiga $t$ waa $x(t)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ waa joogtooyin). Marka waqtiga $t={p}$ xawaaraha barta P uu yahay $0$ oo kordhinta xawaaruhu tahay ${q}$, waa maxay meesha barta P waqtiga $t={k}$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Xawaaruhu waa $v(t)=x'(t)$, kordhinta xawaaruhuna waa $a(t)=v'(t)$. Labada shuruudood qor sida isla'eg: $v({p})=0$, $a({p})={q}$.
Labada isla'eg isku xidh si aad u hesho $a$, $b$, kaddib xisaabi qiimaha $x({k})$.
ca1_kinCoefFind.explanation: $v(t)=x'(t)$, $a(t)=x''(t)$, sidaa darteed $v({p})=0$, $a({p})={q}$ waxay siinayaan $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Sidaa darteed $x({k})={ans}$.

ca1_limCoefPoly.prompt: Shaqada $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ waa joogtooyin), marka ${lim}={L}$, waa maxay qiimaha $f(1)$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Maadaama xadku jiro oo hooseeyuhu noqonayo $0$, korreeyuhuna waa inuu noqdaa $0$ marka $x={c}$.
Markaas xadku waa ${rel}$, sidaa darteed isla'egta ah in qiimahani yahay ${L}$ iyo shuruudda korreeyaha ku samee nidaam isla'eg oo ku saabsan $a$, $b$.
ca1_limCoefPoly.explanation: Korreeyuhu waa inuu noqdaa $0$ marka $x={c}$, sidaa darteed $f({c})={m0}$. Xadku waa ${rel}$ oo waa ${L}$, marka labada isla'eg la isku xidho, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$ iyo $f(1)={ans}$.

ca1_limCoefRational.prompt: Marka $\lim_{x\to {c}}\frac{{num}}{{den}}={L}$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b$ ee joogtooyinka $a$, $b$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Si xadku u jiro marka $x={c}$ ee hooseeyuhu noqdo $0$, korreeyuhuna waa inuu noqdaa $0$ marka $x={c}$.
$b$ ku muuji $a$ si korreeyuhu u yeesho qodobka ${xc}$, kaddib samee isla'egta ah in xadka odhaahda la gaabiyey uu la mid yahay qiimaha la bixiyey (${L}$).
ca1_limCoefRational.explanation: Maadaama xadku jiro oo hooseeyuhu noqdo $0$ marka $x={c}$, korreeyuhuna waa inuu noqdaa $0$ marka $x={c}$. Kaddib marka qodobka wadaagga ah ee korreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha la gaabiyo, shuruudda ah in xadku la mid yahay qiimaha la bixiyey (${L}$) waxay siinaysaa $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Sidaa darteed $a+b={ans}$.

ca1_limDerivForm.prompt: Shaqada kala-bixidda leh $f(x)$, haddii $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${lim}$ ? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Korreeyaha ku dar oo ka jar ama qodob ahaan u kala qaad si uu u muuqdo qaabka $f(x)-f({a})$ (ama $f(a+h)-f(a)$).
Qeexidda kala-bixiyaha waa $\lim_{x\to {a}}\frac{f(x)-f({a})}{{xa}}=f'({a})$.
ca1_limDerivForm.explanation: Marka korreeyaha laga sameeyo qaabka $f(x)-f({a})$ oo la isticmaalo qeexidda kala-bixiyaha, maadaama $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, xadku waa ${step}={ansf}$.

ca1_limExistence.prompt: Shaqada ${pw}$, marka $\lim_{x\to {c}}f(x)$ uu jiro, waa maxay qiimaha joogtada $a$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Si xadku u jiro, xadka bidix iyo xadka midig marka $x\to {c}$ waa inay isle'eg yihiin.
Odhaahda marka $x<{c}$ iyo marka $x>{c}$ ku geli qiimayaasha ku dhow $x={c}$, kaddib labada xad ku muuji $a$.
ca1_limExistence.explanation: Xadka bidix waa qiimaha odhaahda $x<{c}$ marka $x\to {c}$, xadka midig-na waa qiimaha odhaahda $x>{c}$. Labada qiime waa inay isle'eg yihiin, sidaa darteed $a={ans}$.

ca1_limInfRatio.prompt: Waa maxay qiimaha $\lim_{x\to\infty}\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ ? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore barbar dhig darajada xubnaha ugu sarreeya ee korreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha. Haddii darajada korreeyuhu ka yar tahay tan hooseeyaha, xadku waa $0$.
Hooseeyaha iyo korreeyaha ku qaybi awoodda ugu weyn ee $x$.
ca1_limInfRatio.explanation: Marka $x\to\infty$, korreeyaha waxaa go'aamiya qaabka ${nl}$, hooseeyaha-na ${dl}$, sidaa darteed xadku wuxuu la mid yahay xadka saamiga labada xubnood $\frac{{nl}}{{dl}}$, qiimihiisuna waa ${ansf}$.

ca1_limPiecewise.prompt: Shaqada ${pw}$, waa maxay qiimaha {ask} ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Odhaahda shaqada $f$ way isbeddeshaa marka $x={k}$. Marka hore go'aami in qiimaha $f$ gudaheeda uu ku dhowaanayo ${k}$ dhinaca ka yar mise dhinaca ka weyn.
Odhaahda dhinaca la go'aamiyey ka hel qiimaha marka $x={k}$. Qiimaha shaqada $f({k})$ lafteedu xadka xidhiidh la ma leh.
ca1_limPiecewise.explanation: Xadka marka $x\to {k}^{-}$ waa ${lv}$, xadka marka $x\to {k}^{+}$ waa ${rv}$ (qiimaha shaqada marka $x={k}$ waa ${e}$, laakiin xadka xidhiidh la ma leh). Marka la eego dhinaca ay qiimaha gudaha odhaahda la doonayo ku dhowaanayso ${k}$ oo qiimayaashan si ku habboon loo isticmaalo, jawaabtu waa ${ans}$.

ca1_limRadical.prompt: Waa maxay qiimaha $\lim_{x\to\infty}\left({expr}\right)$? (Waxaad u qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: Haddii ay tahay farqiga laba erey oo xidid leh, ama erey xidid leh iyo erey heerka koowaad ah, ku dhufo kor iyo hoosba (erey xidid leh)+(ereyga kale) si aad xididka u baabi'iso.
Kadib markaad xididka baabi'iso, ku qaybi kor iyo hoosba $x$, kadibna u aad $x\to\infty$.
ca1_limRadical.explanation: Marka lambarka sare la baabi'iyo xididka, ereygu wuxuu noqonayaa qaabka $\frac{{numr}}{{den2}}$. Marka kor iyo hoosba lagu qaybiyo $x$, lambarka sare wuxuu u dhowaanayaa ${nc}$, hoosena ${dc}$, sidaa darteed xaddigu waa ${ans}$.

ca1_maxMinFind.prompt: Qiimaha ugu weyn ee shaqada $f(x)={f}$ ($a$ waa joogto) inta u dhexaysa $[{s},{t}]$ waa ${M}$. Waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar inta u dhexaysa? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Qiimaha ugu weyn iyo ugu yar ee inta xiran waxaa laga helaa isbarbar dhigidda qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ah ee gudaha iyo qiimaha shaqada labada dhammaad.
Hel qiimaha ugu weyn adigoo ku hayo $a$, kadibna ka hel $a$, oo si la mid ah u hel qiimaha ugu yar.
ca1_maxMinFind.explanation: Marka la barbar dhigo qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ah ee gudaha iyo kuwa labada dhammaad, qiimaha ugu weyn waa ${mx0}+a$, kaasoo ah ${M}$, sidaa darteed $a={av}$. Qiimaha ugu yar waa ${mn0}+a={ans}$.

ca1_monoGiven.prompt: Shaqada saddex-jibbaaran $f(x)={f}$ ($a$, $b$ waa joogto) way hoos u dhacaysaa inta u dhexaysa $[{m},{n}]$, kor u kacdaana $(-\infty,{m}]$ iyo $[{n},\infty)$ mid walba. Waa maxay farqiga u dhexeeya qiimaha ugu weyn iyo ugu yar ee $f(x)$ inta u dhexaysa $[{m},{n}]$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Meelaha $x={m}$, $x={n}$ ee $f$ ay ka beddesho kor u kac iyo hoos u dhac, $f'(x)=0$.

$f'(x)$ waa laba-jibbaaran oo xididdadiisu yihiin $x={m}$, $x={n}$, sidaa darteed u qor sida $f'(x)=($isku-dhufashada ereyga labaad$)\times{fm}{fn}$ oo hel $a$, $b$. Meeshee dhammaad ayaa qiimaha ugu weyn iyo ugu yar ka imaanaya inta hoos u dhacaysa?
ca1_monoGiven.explanation: Maadaama $f'(x)=0$ meelaha $x={m}$, $x={n}$ ee kor u kac iyo hoos u dhac ay is beddelaan, $f'(x)={d3}{fm}{fn}$. Marka isku-dhufashooyinka la barbar dhigo, $a={av}$, $b={bv}$. Maadaama ay inta u dhexaysa hoos u dhacayso, qiimaha ugu weyn waa $f({m})={fmv}$, ugu yarna waa $f({n})={fnv}$, farqigooduna waa ${ans}$.

ca1_mvtBound.prompt: Shaqada la kala duwanaan karo $f(x)$ waxay leedahay ${lo}\le f'(x)\le {hi}$ dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah $x$, iyo ${cond}$. Waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee $f({b})$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Marka loo eego Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe, waxaa jira $c$ oo $f(b)-f(a)=f'(c)(b-a)$. Isticmaal qiimaha ugu weyn ee $f'(c)$.
Haddii ay jiraan laba meelood oo la yaqaan, tixgeli tan u dhow meesha aad raadinayso.
ca1_mvtBound.explanation: Meesha la yaqaan ee ugu dhow $f({b})$ waa $x={na}$ ($f({na})={nm}$) oo farqigu yahay ${gap}$. Marka loo eego Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe, $f({b})-({nm})=f'(c)\times{gap}\le {hi}\times{gap}$, sidaa darteed $f({b})\le {ans}$. Qiimahaas waa la gaari karaa shaqo jiif ah oo xaglihiisu had iyo jeer yahay ${hi}$, sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu weyn waa ${ans}$.

ca1_mvtC.prompt: Shaqada $f(x)={f}$, waa maxay qiimaha tirada dhabta ah $c$ ($c$ waa ka weyn ${a}$ ka yarna ${b}$) ee buuxinaysa Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe inta u dhexaysa $[{a},{b}]$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: $c$ ee Aragtida Qiimaha Dhexe waxay buuxisaa $\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}=f'(c)$.
Marka hore hel celceliska heerka isbeddelka, kadibna ka dooro xalalka $f'(c)=($celceliska heerka isbeddelka$)$ kan ku jira inta furan.
ca1_mvtC.explanation: Celceliska heerka isbeddelku waa $\frac{f({b})-f({a})}{{b}-({a})}={sl}$, xalka $f'(c)={sl}$ ee inta $({a},{b})$ ku jira waa kaliya $c={ans}$.

ca1_noExtremum.prompt: Shaqada saddex-jibbaaran $f(x)={f}$, imisa tiro dhan oo $a$ ah ayaa ka dhigaya inaysan $f$ lahayn qiime xad-dhaaf ah? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Shaqada saddex-jibbaaran oo aan lahayn qiime xad-dhaaf ah macnaheedu waa in calaamadda $f'(x)$ aysan is beddelin.
U qor sinnaan-la'aanta kala-sooca $D\le 0$ ee isle'egta labajibbaaran $f'(x)=0$ iyadoo la raacayo $a$, kadibna tiri xalalka tirada dhan.
ca1_noExtremum.explanation: Maadaama $f'(x)$ aysan beddelin calaamadda, kala-soocidda isle'egta $f'(x)=0$ waa $D\le 0$. Tirooyinka dhan ee $a$ ee tan buuxiya waa ${lo}\le a\le {hi}$, sidaa darteed waa ${ans}$ tiro.

ca1_optimBox.prompt: Warqad leydi ah oo dhererkeedu yahay ${W}$ cm iyo ballaadhkeedu yahay ${H}$ cm, afarta geeska ayaa laga jaray afar-geesle siman oo isku dherer ah, qaybta hadhayna waa la laablaaban yahay si loo sameeyo sanduuq aan daboolka lahayn. Waa imisa cm³ mugga ugu weyn ee sanduuqa? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U qaado dhererka dhinaca afar-geeslaha la jarayo $x$ oo mugga sanduuqa ku muuji shaqada $V(x)$ ee $x$.
Mugga ugu weyn wuxuu yimaadaa qiimaha xalka $V'(x)=0$ ee ku jira xadka $0<x<(\text{dhinaca gaaban})\div 2$.
ca1_optimBox.explanation: Haddii dhinaca afar-geeslaha la jarayo yahay $x$ cm, $V(x)=x({W}-2x)({H}-2x)$ ($0<x<{hh}$), marka la xalliyo $V'(x)=0$, ugu weynnaanta waxay ka timaaddaa $x={x}$ halka uu kordhiddu u beddelmayo hoos u dhac. Mugga ugu weyn waa ${ans}$ cm³.

ca1_optimProfit.prompt: Marka maalintii la soo saaro $x$ cutub ($0\le x\le {X}$) oo alaab ah oo dhammaantood la iibiyo, kharashka guud waa $C(x)={cost}$ (10,000 won), qiimaha iibka cutub kasta-na waa ${price}$ (10,000 won). Waa imisa (10,000 won) faa'iidada ugu badan maalintii (iibka ka jar kharashka guud)? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U qaado faa'iidada $P(x)={price}x-C(x)$ oo xalli $P'(x)=0$.
Ma aha oo keliya qiimaha $x$ ee ugu weyn ee deegaanka, ee barbar dhig qiimayaasha labada dhammaad $x=0$, $x={X}$.
ca1_optimProfit.explanation: $P(x)={price}x-C(x)$, laga bilaabo $P'(x)=0$, meesha ugu weyn ee deegaanka ee inta ku jirta waa $x={xs}$. Meeshan iyo labada dhammaad, $P({xs})={ans}$, $P(0)={p0}$, $P({X})={pX}$, sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu weyn waa ${ans}$ (10,000 won).

ca1_powerFindN.prompt: Tirada dabiiciga ah $n$, $f(x)={f}$. Haddii $f'({a})={V}$, waa maxay qiimaha $n$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Derivative-ka $x^n$ waa $nx^{n-1}$.
Ku muuji $f'(x)$ sida ereyga $n$, kadibna ka fikir sida qiimuhu isu beddelo marka $n$ weynaado.
ca1_powerFindN.explanation: $f'(x)={cc}\cdot n\cdot x^{n-1}-{kk}$, sidaa darteed $f'({a})={cc}\cdot n\cdot{a}^{n-1}-{kk}$. Qiimahani wuu weynaadaa marka $n$ weynaado, sidaa darteed tirada dabiiciga ah $n$ ee qiimuhu yahay ${V}$ waa mid keliya, $n={ans}$.

ca1_powerTangentN.prompt: Gooynta $y$ ee xariiqda taabanaysa qalooca $y={fx}$ ($n$ waa tiro dabiici ah oo $2$ ama ka weyn) ee meesha isku-xidhka $x$ yahay ${a}$ waa ${V}$. Waa maxay qiimaha $n$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Maadaama derivative-ka $x^n$ uu yahay $nx^{n-1}$, jiifnaanta xariiqda taabanaysa waxay ku jirtaa ereyga $n$.
Marka gooynta $y$ ee xariiqda taabanaysa loo qoro sida ereyga $n$, qiimaha saxda ahi wuu weynaadaa marka $n$ weynaado.
ca1_powerTangentN.explanation: Maadaama $f(x)={fx}$, $f'(x)={cc}nx^{n-1}$, gooynta $y$ ee xariiqda taabanaysa waa $f({a})-{a}f'({a})=(1-n)\cdot{ccp}\cdot{a}^n$. Qiimaha saxda ah ee tan wuu weynaadaa marka $n$ weynaado, sidaa darteed $n$ ee qiimuhu yahay ${V}$ waa mid keliya, $n={ans}$.

ca1_prodAbstract.prompt: Laba shaqo oo la kala duwanaan karo $f(x)$, $g(x)$ waxay leeyihiin $f({a})={s}$, $f'({a})={t}$, $g({a})={u}$, $g'({a})={w}$. Haddii $h(x)={hx}$, waa maxay qiimaha $h'({a})$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Xeerka kala-duwanaanshaha wax-soo-saarka waa $\{f(x)g(x)\}'=f'(x)g(x)+f(x)g'(x)$.
Haddii wax-soo-saarku leeyahay saddex ama in ka badan, isku dar ereyada la kala duwo mid mid.

ca1_returnTime.prompt: Meesha P ee ku socota xariiqda tirooyinka waxay ka bilaabatay isha waqtiga $t=0$, xawaarahana waqtiga $t$ ($t\ge0$) waa $v(t)={v}$. Waa maxay xawaaraha P waqtiga ugu horreeya ee ay dib ugu soo laabato isha ka dib bilowga? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Booska waa isugeynta aan xadka lahayn ee xawaaraha, maadaama booska bilowgu yahay $0$, $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds$.
Raadi $t$ ugu yar ee togan ee buuxinaya $x(t)=0$ oo ku beddel $v(t)$.
ca1_returnTime.explanation: $x(t)=\int_0^t v(s)\,ds={xt}$ iyo $t$ ee togan ee $x(t)=0$ waa ${rs}$. Qiimaha ugu yar $t={t0}$, $v({t0})={ans}$.

ca1_rootCountK.prompt: Shaqada $f(x)={f}$ ee, isla'egta $f(x)=k$ marka ay leedahay si sax ah ${nr}$ xal dhab ah oo kala duwan, imisa tiro oo dhan $k$ ayaa jira? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Ka fikir tirada isgoysyada u dhexeeya garaafka $y=f(x)$ iyo xariiqda toosan $y=k$.
Hel qiimaha ugu sarreeya iyo ugu hooseeya ee gudaha, si aad u go'aamiso marka $k$ ay ku jirto xadkee ayay isgoysyadu noqdaan ${nr}$.
ca1_rootCountK.explanation: Marka $f'(x)=0$, qiimaha xad-gudubka waa ${ext}$. Si ay u jiraan ${nr}$ xal dhab ah oo kala duwan, waa in ${rng}$, sidaas darteed tirada tirooyinka dhan ee $k$ waa ${ans}$.

ca1_tangentFromPoint.prompt: Laba xariiq oo taabanaya qalooca $y={f}$ oo laga soo jiray barta $({p},{q})$, isku dhufashada jaangooyooyinkooda waa imisa? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Haddii $x$-ka barta taabashada uu yahay $t$, xariiqda taabanaysa waa $y=f'(t)(x-t)+f(t)$, xariiqdani waa in marka $x={p}$ ay $y={q}$ noqotaa.
Shuruudda ka soo hel isla'eg-labaad oo ku saabsan $t$, hel labada xal, ka dibna xisaabi jaangooyaha $f'(t)$.
ca1_tangentFromPoint.explanation: Haddii $x$-ka barta taabashada uu yahay $t$, shuruudda ah marka $x={p}$ in $y={q}$ waxay siinaysaa isla'eg-labaad, xalalkuna waa $t={t1}, {t2}$. Jaangooyooyinku waa $f'({t1})$, $f'({t2})$ siday u kala horreeyaan, isku dhufashadooduna waa ${ans}$.

ca1_tangentIntercept.prompt: Qalooca $y={f}$ ee barta $x$-keeda yahay ${a}$, xariiqda taabanaysa halka ay ku kulanto dhidibka $y$, $y$-gu waa imisa? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Jaangooyaha xariiqda taabanaysa waa derivative-ka barta taabashada $f'({a})$.
Isla'egta xariiqda taabanaysa $y-f({a})=f'({a})\{x-({a})\}$ marka $x=0$, hel qiimaha $y$.
ca1_tangentIntercept.explanation: $f'({a})={d1}$, $f({a})={d0}$, sidaas darteed xariiqda taabanaysa waa $y-({d0})=({d1})\{x-({a})\}$. Marka $x=0$, $y={ans}$.

ca1_tangentIntersect.prompt: Xariiqda taabanaysa qalooca $y={f}$ ee barta $x$-keeda yahay ${a}$ waxay mar kale la kulantaa qalooca barta aan ahayn bartii taabashada. $y$-ga barta ay wada kulmaan waa imisa? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: $x$-ga isgoyska xariiqda taabanaysa iyo qalooca waa xalka (isla'egta qalooca)−(isla'egta xariiqda taabanaysa)$=0$, isla'egtanna waxay leedahay xal laba-laab ah marka $x={a}$.
Wadarta saddexda xal ee isla'eg-saddexaadka waxaa lagu ogaan karaa isku-dhufashada $x^2$, sidaas darteed hel xalka haray oo ku beddel isla'egta qalooca.
ca1_tangentIntersect.explanation: (qalooca)−(xariiqda taabanaysa)$=0$ waa isla'eg-saddexaad leh xal laba-laab ah marka $x={a}$, wadarta saddexda xalna waxaa go'aamiya xiriirka xalalka iyo isku-dhufashooyinka. Xalka harayna waa $x={s}$, ku beddelida isla'egta qalooca $y$ waa ${ans}$.

ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.prompt: Waxaa jira laba xariiq oo taabanaya qalooca $y={f}$ oo jaangooyahoodu yahay ${m}$. Wadarta goynta dhidibka $y$ ee labadan xariiq waa imisa? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Haddii jaangooyuhu yahay ${m}$, $x$-ka barta taabashada waa xalka $f'(x)={m}$.
Barta taabashada kasta $(s, f(s))$ goynta dhidibka $y$ waa $f(s)-s\cdot{m}$.
ca1_tangentSlopeTwo.explanation: Xalka isla'egta $f'(x)={m}$ waxay siinaysaa $x$-ka barta taabashada ${s1}$, ${s2}$. Marka la helo goynta dhidibka $y$ ee xariiq kasta oo la isku daro, waa ${ans}$.

ca1_throwImpact.prompt: Kubbad ayaa kor loo tuuray meel dhererkeedu yahay ${h0}$ m dhulka ka sarreysa, dhererka kubbaddu $t$ ilbiriqsi ka dib waa $h(t)={h}$ (m). Xawaaraha kubbaddu marka ay dhulka ku dhacayso waa imisa m/s? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Wakhtiga ay dhulka taabato waa qiimaha togan ee $t$ marka $h(t)=0$. Dhaqdhaqaaqa (xawaaraha) waa $h'(t)$.
Xalli $h(t)=0$ si aad u hesho xalka togan, ka dibna xisaabi qiimaha dhammaystiran ee xawaaraha wakhtigaas.
ca1_throwImpact.explanation: Xalka togan ee $h(t)=0$ waa $t={T}$ ilbiriqsi, $h'(t)={v0}-10t$, sidaas darteed $h'({T})={vv}$. Xawaaruhu waa qiimaha dhammaystiran ee dhaqdhaqaaqa, sidaas darteed ${ans}$ m/s.

ca1_totalDistPos.prompt: Barta P oo ku socota xariiq tirooyin, booskeeda wakhtiga $t$ ($t\ge0$) waa $x(t)={f}$. Masaafada barta P ay socotay laga bilaabo wakhtiga $t=0$ ilaa $t={T}$ waa imisa? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Masaafada la socday maaha isbeddelka boosaska; waa wadarta masaafada qayb kasta oo la kala qaybiyey wakhtiga jihadu ku beddesho.
Marka hore hubi in wakhtiga $v(t)=x'(t)=0$ uu ku jiro dhexda $(0,{T})$.
ca1_totalDistPos.explanation: Hel wakhtiga $v(t)=x'(t)=0$, wakhtiyada jihadu isku beddesho ee xadkan waa ${turns}$. Wakhtiyadaas ku kala qaybi xadka, oo isku dar qiimaha dhammaystiran ee isbeddelka booska; masaafada la socday waa ${ans}$.

ca1_totalDistVel.prompt: Xawaaraha meesha P ee ku socota xariiqda tirooyinka waqtiga $t$ ($t\ge0$) waa $v(t)={v}$. Waa maxay masaafada ay P socotay laga bilaabo waqtiga $t=0$ ilaa $t={T}$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Masaafada la socdey waa isugeynta xawaaraha dhabta ah $|v(t)|$.
Kala qaybi inta waqtiyada $v(t)=0$, kadibna isugeyn adigoo la jaanqaadaya calaamadda.
ca1_totalDistVel.explanation: Waqtiga calaamadda xawaaruhu is beddelo ee inta ku jira waa ${zs}$. Marka inta waqtigaas lagu kala qaybiyo, calaamaddu qayb kasta waa joogto, sidaa darteed ku dar qiimaha saxda ah ee $\int v(t)\,dt$: ${parts}={ansf}$.

ca1_twoRootsK.prompt: Marka loo eego shaqada $f(x)={f}$, waa maxay isugeynta dhammaan qiimayaasha tirada dhabta ah $k$ ee ka dhigaya in isle'egta $f(x)=k$ ay leedahay si sax ah ${nr}$ xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Ka fikir xadka halka tirada xididdada dhabta ah ee kala duwan ay is beddesho, taas oo ah marka xariiqda siman $y=k$ ay taabato graph-ka qiimaha xad-dhaafka ah.
Ka mid ah qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ah ee taabashada, kee ayaa siinaya si sax ah ${nr}$ xidid, ku go'aami qaabka graph-ka.
ca1_twoRootsK.explanation: Qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ahi waa ${ext}$. Marka la eego tirada isgoysyada marka xariiqda siman ay taabato graph-ka qiimaha xad-dhaafka ah iyo marka kale, $k$ ee buuxinaya shuruudda waa ${kk}$, isugeyntooduna waa ${ans}$.

ca1_velZeroAccel.prompt: Booska meesha P ee ku socota xariiqda tirooyinka waqtiga $t$ ($t\ge0$) waa $x(t)={f}$. Labada waqti ee xawaaraha P uu noqdo $0$, waa maxay xawaaraha kordhaya ee waqtiga dambe? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Xawaaruhu waa derivative-ka booska ee $t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$, xawaaraha kordhayana waa derivative-ka xawaaraha, $a(t)=v'(t)$.
Hel labada xidid ee $v(t)=0$, kadibna ku beddel xididka dambe $a(t)$.
ca1_velZeroAccel.explanation: $v(t)=x'(t)$ iyo labada xidid ee $v(t)=0$ waa $t={t1}$, $t={t2}$. Qiimaha $a(t)=v'(t)$ ee waqtiga dambe $t={t2}$ waa ${ans}$.

ca2_addTheorem.prompt: Marka ${ga}$, ${gb}$ iyo ${ra}$, ${rb}$, hel qiimaha ${ask}$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Qiimayaasha la siiyay iyo $\sin^{2}\theta+\cos^{2}\theta=1$ ka hel qiimayaasha trigonometry-ga ee kale ee loo baahan yahay. Calaamaddu waxay ku xiran tahay rubuca ay xagalku ku jiro.
Ku beddel qiimayaasha la helay aragtida isku-darka.

ca2_areaCurves.prompt: Ha ahaato $S$ aagga ay ku wareegsan yihiin labada graph $y={f}$, $y={g}$ iyo labada xariiq $x={a}$, $x={b}$. Hel qiimaha ${ask}$. (Xusuusin: dhidibka $x$ waa $y=0$.) (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isugeyn farqiga ereyga graph-ka sare iyo ereyga graph-ka hoose ee inta.

Isticmaal $(\tan x)'=\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ si aad u hesho isugeynta shaqooyinka exponential, trigonometry iyo rational; haddii ay yihiin shaqooyin isku-dhafan, isticmaal isugeynta beddelka.
ca2_areaCurves.explanation: Inta $[{a},{b}]$, $y={f}$ waa kan sare, sidaa darteed $S=\int_{{a}}^{{b}}({f}-{gg})\,dx={wk}$. Sidaa darteed qiimaha ${ask}$ waa ${res}$.

ca2_ballDistance.prompt: Kubbad ayaa laga tuuraa dhererka ${h}$ m. Marka ay dhulka taabato mar kasta, waxay u boodaa ${ratio}$ jibbaar dhererka ay hore uga dhacday, kadibna mar kale way dhacdaa, tan waxaa la sii wadaa dhammaad la'aan. Waa imisa m isugeynta masaafada ay kubbaddu socotay? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Ka fikir masaafada hore ee dhaca ${h}$ m, iyo masaafada kor iyo hoos ee mar kasta ka dambeysa (laba jibbaar dhererka kor u kacay).
Dhererrada kor u kacay waxay samaysaan isku-xigga joomatari oo ereyga koowaad yahay (dhererka bilowga)×(nisbadda boodka).
ca2_ballDistance.explanation: Isugeynta dhererrada kor u kacay waa ${up}$ m, masaafada kor iyo hoos-na waa laba jibbaarkeeda, sidaa darteed masaafada guud waa ${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_ballReverse.prompt: Kubad ayaa laga dhigay dhererka qaar, mar kasta oo ay dhulka taabato waxay soo kacdaa ilaa ${ratio}$ jeer dhererkii hore ee ay ka dhacday, kadibna mar kale way dhacdaa, taasna waa lagu celceliyaa dhammaad la'aan. Haddii dhererka soo kicinta ${nb}$-aad uu yahay ${H}$ m, waa imisa m wadarta masaafada kubaddu socotay? (Ku qor jajab aan la dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, ku qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Haddii dhererka bilowga loo qaato $h$ m, mar kasta dhererka soo kicinta waa ${ratio}$ jeer kii hore, sidaa darteed dhererka soo kicinta $n$-aad waa $h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{n}$.
Marka hore hel $h$, kadibna wadarta masaafada hel adigoo isku daraya masaafada ugu horreysa ee dhicitaanka $h$ iyo masaafada kor iyo hoos u socodka (laba jeer dhererka kor u kacay).
ca2_ballReverse.explanation: Haddii dhererka bilowga loo qaato $h$ m, ${H}=h\times \left({ratio}\right)^{{nb}}$, sidaa darteed $h={h}$. Wadarta dhererrada kor u kaca waa ${up}$ m, sidaa darteed masaafada guud waa ${h}+2\times {up}={res}$ m.

ca2_chainTable.prompt: Laba howlood oo la kala duwi karo $f$ iyo $g$ waxay leeyihiin ${tbl}$. Marka $h(x)={hx}$, hel qiimaha $h'({a})$. (Waxaad ku qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: Eeg in $h$ ay tahay isku-dhufasho, qaybin ama isku-dhafan, kadibna isticmaal sharciga kala duwidda ee ku haboon.

Marka $x={a}$, ka raadi miiska qiimaha howlaha iyo dhalmooyinka loo baahan yahay, kadibna ku beddel. Haddii ay tahay howl isku-dhafan, qiimaha howsha gudaha ayaa noqda barta lagu geliyo howsha dibadda.

ca2_commonTangent.prompt: Laba qalooc $y={f}$, $y={g}$ way kulmaan barta $x={x0}$, waxayna leeyihiin xariiq taabanaysa oo ka wada dhex jirta barta taas. Marka $a$, $b$ yihiin joogto, hel qiimaha $ab$. (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Haddii labada qalooc ay ku kulmaan $x={x0}$, qiimaha howlahoodu waa isku mid; haddii xariiqda taabanaysa ay isku mid tahay, dhalmooyinku waa isku mid.
Isla'egaha $a$, $b$ isku xal si aad u hesho $a$, $b$.
ca2_commonTangent.explanation: $y={f}$ marka $x={x0}$ wuxuu leeyahay qiimaha howsha ${F}$ iyo dhalmada ${D}$, sidaa darteed ${wk}$. Sidaas awgeed $ab={ans}$.

ca2_derivExpLog.prompt: Marka howsha $f(x)={fx}$, hel qiimaha $f'({x0})$. (Ku qor jajab aan la dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, ku qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isticmaal $(e^{x})'=e^{x}$, $(\ln x)'=\frac{1}{x}$ iyo sharciga howlaha isku-dhafan si aad marka hore u hesho $f'(x)$.
Haddii qiimaha la geliyo uu yahay qaabka $\ln m$, isticmaal $e^{\ln m}=m$.

ca2_doubleAngle.prompt: Marka ${cd}$, hel qiimaha ${ask}$. (Ku qor jajab aan la dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, ku qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isticmaal $\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$, $\cos2\alpha=\cos^{2}\alpha-\sin^{2}\alpha$ iyo $\sin^{2}\alpha+\cos^{2}\alpha=1$.

Haddii la siiyo $\sin\alpha\pm\cos\alpha$, labajibaaree labada dhinac. Haddii $\tan\alpha=t$, $\sin2\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos2\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$, haddii $\tan\frac{\alpha}{2}=t$ na, $\sin\alpha=\frac{2t}{1+t^{2}}$, $\cos\alpha=\frac{1-t^{2}}{1+t^{2}}$.

ca2_eExponent.prompt: Marka $\lim_{{to}}{ex}=e^{k}$, hel qiimaha $k$. (Waxaad ku qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: U beddel qaabka $\lim_{h\to0}(1+h)^{\frac{1}{h}}=e$.
Qaybi oo ku dhufo tilmaamaha si salka $h$ iyo tilmaamuhu u noqdaan isbarbar-gadood.
ca2_eExponent.explanation: Adigoo isticmaalaya $(1+h)^{\frac{1}{h}}\to e$ oo tilmaamaha nidaaminaya, $k={wk}={res}$.

ca2_expLogLimit.prompt: Hel xadka soo socda. $\lim_{{to}}{ex}$ (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: U beddel ereyga si aad u isticmaali karto $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{e^{x}-1}{x}=1$, $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\ln(1+x)}{x}=1$.
Ku dhufo oo ku qaybi isku-dhufashooyinka si lambarka sare iyo madaxu u helaan isla qaabka.
ca2_expLogLimit.explanation: Marka loo beddelo si loo isticmaalo xadadka aasaasiga ah, ${wk}$, sidaa darteed xadku waa ${res}$.

ca2_extremaPair.prompt: Shaqada $f(x)={fx}$ waxay leedahay hal qiime ugu weyn oo deegaan ah iyo hal ugu yar oo deegaan ah. Haddii ugu weyn yahay marka $x=\alpha$ iyo ugu yar marka $x=\beta$, hel qiimaha $\alpha-\beta$. (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Hel $x$ ee $f'(x)=0$, kadibna fiiri sida calaamadda $f'(x)$ u beddesho ka hor iyo ka dambaysa.
Haddii calaamadda $f'(x)$ ka beddesho togan una beddesho taban, waa ugu weyn; haddii ka beddesho taban una beddesho togan, waa ugu yar.
ca2_extremaPair.explanation: Maadaama $f'(x)={fp}$, waa ugu weyn marka $x={mx}$ iyo ugu yar marka $x={mn}$. Sidaa darteed $\alpha-\beta=({mx})-({mn})={ans}$.

ca2_geoConvCount.prompt: Hel isugeynta dhammaan tirooyinka dhan ee $x$ ee ka dhigaya kan soo socda inuu isu geeyo. ${obj}$ (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Isku-xigga $\{r^{n}\}$ wuu isu geeyaa marka $-1<r\le 1$, taxanaha joomatari ee aan dhammaad lahayn $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}r^{n}$-na wuu isu geeyaa marka $-1<r<1$.
U qor shuruudda isu-geynta sida sinnaan-la'aan $x$ ah, kadibna hel dhammaan tirooyinka dhan ee buuxinaya oo isku dar.
ca2_geoConvCount.explanation: Laga bilaabo shuruudda isu-geynta, ${rg}$. Tirooyinka dhan ee $x$ ee tan buuxinaya waa ${lst}$, sidaa darteed isugeyntooduna waa ${ans}$.

ca2_geoSeriesParam.prompt: Marka taxanaha aan dhammaad lahayn $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{term}$ uu isu geeyo oo isugeyntiisu tahay ${S}$, waa maxay qiimaha joogtada $r$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isugeynta taxanaha joomatari ee aan dhammaad lahayn waa (ereyga koowaad)÷(1-isku-dhufashada guud).
Marka hore ka hel ereyga koowaad iyo isku-dhufashada guud ee ereyga guud ee taxanaha.
ca2_geoSeriesParam.explanation: Maadaama ereyga koowaad yahay ${fa}$ iyo isku-dhufashada guud ${ratio}$, isugeyntu waa ${sumf}={S}$. Marka la xalliyo, $r={res}$.

ca2_implicitDeriv.prompt: Marka $y$ ay tahay shaqo ee $x$, meesha $ {pt} $ ee ku taal qalooca ${eq}$, hel qiimaha ${what}$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Labada dhinac ee isle'egta ka duwan $x$, ereyada ka kooban $y$ ku dhufo $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$.
Ku beddel isku-xidhka meesha isle'egta la kala duwanaay oo xalli $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$. Haddii ay tahay derivative-ka labaad, isle'egta la kala duwanaay mar kale ka duwan $x$.
ca2_implicitDeriv.explanation: Marka labada dhinac ka duwan $x$ oo la dhigo $y'=\frac{ dy }{ dx }$, ${wk}$, sidaa darteed qiimuhu waa ${res}$.

ca2_integralBasic.prompt: Marka $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}\left({fx}\right)dx$, hel qiimaha ${ask}$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isticmaal $\int e^{x}dx=e^{x}$, $\int\sin x\,dx=-\cos x$, $\int\cos x\,dx=\sin x$, $\int\frac{1}{x}dx=\ln|x|$, $\int\frac{1}{\cos^{2}x}dx=\tan x$.
Ogow in $\int f(kx)\,dx=\frac{1}{k}F(kx)$, kadibna ku beddel xadka sare iyo hoose oo ka jar.

ca2_inverseDeriv.prompt: Ha ahaato $g(x)$ shaqada beddelka ee shaqada kordhaysa ee $f(x)={fx}$ ee dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah. Hel qiimaha $g'({b})$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore hel $a$ ee buuxinaya $f(a)={b}$.
Kala-duwanaanshaha shaqada beddelka: $g'({b})=\frac{1}{f'(a)}$.
ca2_inverseDeriv.explanation: Maadaama $f({xa})={b}$, $g({b})={xa}$, iyo laga bilaabo $f'(x)={fp}$, $f'({xa})={fd}$. Sidaa darteed $g'({b})=\frac{1}{f'({xa})}={res}$.

ca2_limitPair.prompt: Marka loo eego tirooyinka joogtada ah $a$, $b$, haddii ${eq}$, hel qiimaha $ab$. (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Haddii xadku jiro oo hooseeyuhu xadka ku noqdo $0$, lambarka sare sidoo kale waa inuu noqdaa $0$. Shuruuddan ka hel xiriirka u dhexeeya $a$ iyo $b$ marka hore.

Kadib markaad ku beddesho xiriirkaas, ka hel xadka adigoo lambarka sare ka dhigaya isku-dhufasho, baabi'in xidid, ama u beddelaya $1-\cos x=\frac{\sin^{2}x}{1+\cos x}$, kadibna u dhig inuu la mid yahay qiimaha la siiyay.

ca2_lineAngle.prompt: Ha ahaato $\theta$ cabbirka xagalka af-yar ee ay sameeyaan labada xariiq $ {l1} $, $ {l2} $. Hel qiimaha $\tan\theta$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Xagalka $\alpha$ ee xariiq jiifnaantiisu tahay $m$ ay la samayso jihada togan ee dhidibka $x$ wuxuu buuxiyaa $\tan\alpha=m$. U beddel isle'egta qaabka $y=mx+k$ si aad u aragto jiifnaanta.
Isticmaal xeerka isku-darka tangent ee farqiga labada xagal, oo maadaama uu yahay xagal af-yar, qaado qiime togan.
ca2_lineAngle.explanation: Jiifnaanta labada xariiq waa $m_1={m1}$, $m_2={m2}$, sidaa darteed $\tan\theta=\left|\frac{m_1-m_2}{1+m_1m_2}\right|=\left|\frac{({m1})-({m2})}{1+({m1})({m2})}\right|={res}$.

ca2_monotoneParam.prompt: Hel tirada tirooyinka dhan ee $a$ ee ka dhigaya shaqada $f(x)={fx}$ inay kor u kacdo dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah. (Haddii $f'(x)\ge 0$ dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah $x$, waxaa la yiraahdaa way kor u kacaysaa.) (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Si shaqo la kala duwanaan karo ay u kor u kacdo dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah, waa in $f'(x)\ge0$ dhammaan $x$.
Hel xadka $a$ ee qiimaha ugu yar ee $f'(x)$ (ama kala-soocidda) uu noqdo $0$ ama ka weyn, kadibna tiri tirooyinka dhan.
ca2_monotoneParam.explanation: ${wk}$. Sidaa darteed tirooyinka dhan ee $a$ ee buuxinaya shuruudda waa ${lst}$, isku-geyn ahaan waa ${ans}$.

ca2_motionReverse.prompt: Meesha P ee ku socota xariiqda tirooyinka, booskeeda waqtiga $t$ ($t>0$) waa $x(t)={xt}$. Hel xawaaraha kordhaya ee waqtiga ugu horreeya ee xawaaraha P uu noqdo $0$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Xawaaruhu waa derivative-ka booska ee $t$, $v(t)=x'(t)$, xawaaraha kordhayana waa $a(t)=v'(t)$.
Hel $t$ ugu yar ee togan ee buuxiya $v(t)=0$, kadibna ku beddel $a(t)$.
ca2_motionReverse.explanation: Maadaama ${wk}$, xawaaraha kordhaya ee waqtiga ugu horreeya ee xawaaruhu noqdo $0$ waa ${res}$.

ca2_paramDeriv.prompt: Qalooca $x={xt}$, $y={yt}$, marka $t={t0}$, hel qiimaha ${what}$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Kala-duwanaanshaha shaqada halbeegga: $\frac{ dy }{ dx }=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}$.
Derivative-ka labaad, $\frac{ dy }{ dx }$ ku muuji $t$, kadibna ka duwan $t$, kadibna ku qaybi $\frac{ dx }{ dt }$.

ca2_partialSumSeries.prompt: Haddii isugeynta ereyga koowaad ilaa ereyga $n$-aad ee isku-xigga $\{a_n\}$ ay tahay $S_n=\frac{{sa}}{{sb}}$, hel qiimaha ${ask}$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore kala saar in qiimaha la raadinayo yahay erey iyo in uu yahay isugeynta taxane. Isugeynta taxane aan dhammaad lahayn waa xadka isugeynta qayb ahaan $S_n$, ereyguna waa $S_n-S_{n-1}$.

ca2_partsEval.prompt: Marka $I=\int_{{lo}}^{{hi}}{fx}\,dx$, hel qiimaha ${ask}$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isku-dhufashada gudaha isugeynta, dhinaca la fududaynayo marka la kala duwo ka dhig $u$, dhinaca fudud ee isugeynta ka dhig $v'$, kadibna ku dabaq isugeynta qaybo $\int uv'dx=uv-\int u'v\,dx$.
Haddii loo baahdo, mar kale ku dabaq isugeynta qaybo. Qiimaha shaqooyinka trigonometry-ga ka xisaabi dhammaadyada inta u dhexaysa.
ca2_partsEval.explanation: Marka isugeynta qaybo la sameeyo, ${wk}$, sidaa darteed qiimaha ${ask}$ waa ${res}$.

ca2_partsFormula.prompt: Shaqada $f$ waa la kala duwanaan karaa $f'$-na waa joogto ah. Marka ${given}$, hel qiimaha ${tg}$. (Waxaad u qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: Isugeynta qaybo: $\int_{a}^{b}u\,v'\,dx=\left[uv\right]_{a}^{b}-\int_{a}^{b}u'\,v\,dx$.
U qaado $f'(x)$ sida $v'$, ereyga lagu dhufanayna sida $u$.

ca2_quotientDeriv.prompt: Marka loo eego shaqada $f(x)={fx}$, hel qiimaha $f'({x0})$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isticmaal xeerka kala-duwanaanshaha qaybta $\left(\frac{u}{v}\right)'=\frac{u'v-uv'}{v^{2}}$.
Hel qiimayaasha $u$, $v$ iyo $u'$, $v'$ marka $x={x0}$ oo ku beddel.

ca2_riemann.prompt: Marka $L=\lim_{n\to\infty}{pre}\sum_{k=1}^{n}{body}$, hel qiimaha ${ask}$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Ka fikir inta oo loo qaybiyay $n$ qaybood siman sida isugeynta aagagga leydiyada, kadibna $\frac{k}{n}$ ku beddel $x$ oo u qor qaabka isugeynta cayiman.
Xadka isugeynta cayiman waxaa lagu go'aamiyaa xadka qiimayaasha $\frac{k}{n}$ marka $k=1$ iyo marka $k=n$.
ca2_riemann.explanation: Marka taxanaha loo beddelo isugeyn cayiman, $L={wk}$. Sidaa darteed qiimaha ${ask}$ waa ${res}$.

ca2_rootCount.prompt: Hel tirada xididdada dhabta ah ee kala duwan ee isle'egta ${eq}$. (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U qaado dhinaca bidix $f(x)$, kadibna ka fikir tirada isgoysyada qalooca $y=f(x)$ iyo xariiqda $y=k$ ($k$ waa joogtada dhinaca midig).
Baadh kordhidda iyo hoos u dhaca $f$, hubi qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ah iyo qiimaha marka $x\to\pm\infty$, kadibna barbar dhig $k$ iyo qiimayaashaas. U qiyaas $e$ sida $2.7<e<2.8$.
ca2_rootCount.explanation: Maadaama ${fpx}$, marka la baadho kordhidda iyo hoos u dhaca, qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ahi waa ${ext}$, xaddiguna waa ${lim}$. Maadaama ${cm}$, isgoysyada qalooca $y=f(x)$ iyo xariiqda $y=k$ waa ${ans}$, xididdada dhabta ahna waa ${ans}$.

ca2_rootCountParam.prompt: Hel tirada tirooyinka dhan ee $k$ ee ka dhigaya in isle'egta ${eq}$ ay leedahay ${nr}$ xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan. (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U qaado dhinaca bidix $f(x)$, kadibna raadi xadka $k$ ee isgoysyada qalooca $y=f(x)$ iyo xariiqda $y=k$ ay noqdaan ${nr}$ adigoo isticmaalaya kordhidda, hoos u dhaca iyo qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ah.
Haddii qiimaha xad-dhaafka ah ku jiro $e$, u qiyaas sida $2.7<e<2.8$ oo tiri tirooyinka dhan ee xadka ku jira.
ca2_rootCountParam.explanation: Maadaama ${fpx}$, qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ahi waa ${ext}$, si isgoysyadu u noqdaan ${nr}$, ${rg}$. Tirooyinka dhan ee $k$ ee xadkan ku jira waa ${lst}$, sidaa darteed waa ${ans}$.

ca2_seqGeoLimit.prompt: Hel xadka isku-xigga soo socda. $\lim_{n\to\infty}{ex}$ (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Awoodda leh salka qiimaha saxda ah ugu weyn ee madaxa iyo lambarka sare ayaa go'aamisa xadka.
Marka lambarka sare iyo madaxa lagu qaybiyo awoodda taas, ereyada leh salka qiimaha saxda ah ee yar waxay u socdaan $0$.

cm1_matCayley.explanation: $A^{{n}}={Apow}$, marka la barbar dhigo xubnaha $pA+qE$, $p={p}$, $q={q}$. Sidaas darteed ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_matWord.prompt: Laba dukaan A, B ayaa ka iibiya ${ni}$ nooc oo alaab ah. Xubinta (i, j) ee matrix-ka $P={mp}$ waa qiimaha (won) hal alaab ee j-aad ee dukaanka i (safka 1: dukaanka A, safka 2: dukaanka B), xubinta (j, l) ee matrix-ka $Q={mq}$ waa tirada alaabta j-aad ee qofka l-aad (sadarka 1: Gap, sadarka 2: Eul) uu rabo inuu iibsado. Gap iyo Eul mid kasta wuxuu alaabta oo dhan ka iibsadaa hal dukaan, labaduba waxay doortaan dukaanka jaban. Wadarta lacagta ay bixiyaan labadooda waa imisa won? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Lacagta qofka l uu ka bixiyo dukaanka i waa wadarta ka timaadda dhufashada xubnaha safka i ee $P$ iyo sadarka l ee $Q$.
Qiimahaas waa xubnaha matrix-ka $PQ$. Hel $PQ$, ka dibna sadar kasta ka dooro qiimaha ugu yar oo isku dar.
cm1_matWord.explanation: $PQ={pq}$. Lacagta Gap ay bixiyo waa ${pq11}$ won dukaanka A, ${pq21}$ won dukaanka B, sidaas darteed ${m1}$ won ee jaban; Eul waa ${pq12}$ won dukaanka A, ${pq22}$ won dukaanka B, sidaas darteed ${m2}$ won ee jaban. Sidaas darteed wadarta waa ${ans}$ won.

cm1_omega.prompt: Haddii $\omega$ ay tahay xal mala-awaal ah oo isla'eg-labaad ${eq}$, qiimaha ${expr}$ waa imisa? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Labada dhinac ee isla'egta ku dhufo $x-1$ ama $x+1$ si aad u ogaato qiimaha $\omega^3$.
Haddii $\omega^3=\pm1$ markaas $\omega^6=1$. Waxaad u baahan tahay oo keliya inta soo hartay marka tilmaamaha loo qaybiyo wareegga.
cm1_omega.explanation: Maadaama $\omega$ ay tahay xalka ${eq}$, ${rel}$. Sidaas darteed awoodaha waxay ku soo laabtaan isla qiime ${per}$ kasta, oo waxaad tixgelisaa oo keliya inta soo hartay marka tilmaamaha loo qaybiyo ${per}$, taas oo ah ${step}$. Sidaas darteed qiimaha la doonayo waa ${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLine.prompt: Marka parabola-kan iyo xariiqdan ay is taabtaan, qiimaha joogtada $k$ waa imisa? (parabola $y={f}$, xariiq $y={g}$) (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Is-taabashadu waxay la macno tahay in isla'egta labaad ee labadooda isku-xidha ay leedahay xal laba-laab ah.
Ka saar $y$ labada isla'eg, oo ka dhig kala-sooceha isla'egta labaad $0$.
cm1_parabolaLine.explanation: ${f}={g}$ waxay siinaysaa ${eq2}=0$, maadaama ay is taabtaan, kala-sooceha $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)=0$. Xalliddeeda waxay siinaysaa $k={ans}$.

cm1_parabolaLineCount.prompt: Waa imisa tiro oo dhan $k$ oo ku jira ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ oo ka dhigaya in parabola-kan iyo xariiqdan aysan is-aragin? (parabola $y={f}$, xariiq $y={g}$) (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: In labada garaaf aysan is-aragin waxay la macno tahay in isla'egta labaad ee labadooda isku-xidha aysan lahayn xal dhab ah.
Ka saar $y$ labada isla'eg, hel xadka $k$ ee kala-sooceha isla'egta labaad uu noqdo $D<0$, ka dibna tiri tirooyinka oo dhan ee ku jira.
cm1_parabolaLineCount.explanation: ${f}={g}$ waxay siinaysaa ${eq2}=0$, si aysan is-arag waa in kala-sooceha $D<0$. $D=({bm})^2-4\cdot({a})\cdot({c}-k)={dk}<0$ waxay siinaysaa ${kr}$, sidaas darteed tirooyinka oo dhan ee ku jira ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$ waa ${ks}$, wadarta ${ans}$.

cm1_parabolaXaxis.prompt: Garaafka howsha laba-jibaaran $y={f}$ wuxuu ku kulmaa dhidibka $x$ laba barood oo kala duwan, masaafada u dhexeysa labada baroodna waa ${d}$. Waa maxay qiimaha joogtada $k$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Isku-xigaallada $x$ ee labada barood ee goynta waa labada xal ee isla'egta ${f}=0$.
Haddii labada xal loo bixiyo $\alpha$, $\beta$, masaafada u dhexeysa labada barood waa $|\alpha-\beta|$, $(\alpha-\beta)^2=(\alpha+\beta)^2-4\alpha\beta$.
cm1_parabolaXaxis.explanation: Isku-xigaallada $x$ ee goynta $\alpha$, $\beta$ waa labada xal ee ${f}=0$, sidaa darteed $\alpha+\beta={sm}$. $(\alpha-\beta)^2=({sm})^2-4\alpha\beta={d}^2$ waxay ka dhigtaa $\alpha\beta={ab}$, xiriirka xalalka iyo isku-dhufashooyinka na $\alpha\beta=\frac{k}{{p}}$, sidaa darteed $k={ans}$.

cm1_permArrange.prompt: Marka ${m}$ wiil iyo ${w}$ gabdhood loo safeeyo hal safka, waa imisa habab oo loo safeeyo si aanay labo gabdhood oo midna ay isu dhow noqon? (Ardayda dhammaantood way kala duwan yihiin.) (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Way fududahay in kuwa aan isu dhawaan karin (gabdhaha) dambe la geliyo. Marka hore wiilasha u safee hal safka.
Wiilasha dhexdooda iyo labada dhammaad waxaa ka abuurma meelo gabdhaha lagu fadhiisiyo. Ka dooro meelahaas meelo kala duwan oo gabdhaha lagu safeeyo.
cm1_permArrange.explanation: Habka marka hore loo safeeyo ${m}$ wiil waa ${m}!={mf}$ habab. Wiilasha dhexdooda iyo labada dhammaad ${m1}$ meelood, ka dooro ${w}$ meelood oo kala duwan oo gabdhaha lagu safeeyo waa ${}_{{m1}}\mathrm{P}_{{w}}={pv}$ habab. Sidaa darteed ${mf}\times{pv}={ans}$ habab.

cm1_permNumbers.prompt: Waxaa jira ${nc}$ kaar oo mid kasta ku qoran yahay tiro kala duwan, tirooyinkuna waa ${digs}$. Kuwaas, marka ${r}$ kaar la doorto oo la safeeyo si loo sameeyo tiro dabiici ah oo ${r}$ god leh, imisa ayaa ah isku-dhufashooyinka ${m}$? ($0$ lama dhigi karo meesha ugu horreysa.) (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: In tiro ay tahay isku-dhufasho ${m}$ waxaa go'aamisa god-gaarka. Marka hore go'aamin tirooyinka ka imaan kara god-gaarka.
Kadib go'aaminta god-gaarka, meesha ugu horreysa ka dooro tirooyin aan ahayn $0$, meelaha kalena ku buuxi kaararka haray (sharciga isku-dhufashada).
cm1_permNumbers.explanation: Tirooyinka ka imaan kara god-gaarka waa ${Lstr}$. Mid kasta, hel (tirada habaabka loo doorto meesha ugu horreysa)$\times$(tirada habaabka loo buuxiyo meelaha kale) oo isku dar, ${work}={ans}$.

cm1_polyDivQR.prompt: Marka tiro-badan $P(x)={pp}$ la qaybiyo $({dv})$, haddii qaybtu tahay $Q(x)$ inta harana $R(x)$, waa maxay qiimaha $Q({t})+R({t})$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Ku qaybi qodobbada ugu sarreeya si aad u hesho eraygii hore ee qaybta, kadibna ku dhufo qaybiyaha oo ka jar, oo tallaabadan ku celceli.
Eraygii hore ee qaybta waa ${qlead}$, darajada inta harana way ka yar tahay darajada qaybiyaha.
cm1_polyDivQR.explanation: Marka qaybinta la sameeyo, $P(x)=({dv})({qq})+({rr})$, sidaa darteed $Q(x)={qq}$, $R(x)={rr}$. Sidaa darteed $Q({t})+R({t})={ans}$.

cm1_polyProdCoef.prompt: Marka laba tiro-badan $A={pa}$, $B={pb}$ la fidiyo $AB$, waa maxay isku-dhufashada $x^{{k}}$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Uma baahnid inaad si buuxda u fidiso $AB$. Raadi oo keliya lammaanayaasha qodobbada isku-dhufashadoodu noqonayo $x^{{k}}$.
Lammaane kasta oo wadarta darajooyinka qodobka $A$ iyo kan $B$ ay tahay ${k}$, ku dhufo isku-dhufashooyinkooda, kadibna isku dar.
cm1_polyProdCoef.explanation: Isku dar isku-dhufashooyinka qodobbada isku-dhufashadoodu noqonayo $x^{{k}}$, ${terms}={ans}$. (Marka runtii la fido, $AB={prod}$.)

cm1_quadFence.prompt: Silig bir ah oo dhererkiisu yahay ${L}$ m ayaa loo isticmaalayaa in lagu sameeyo xayndaab leydi ah oo hal dhinac uu derbiga taabanayo, iyo ${j}$ gaar-kala-qaybiye oo derbiga ku taagan si loo kala qaybiyo goobta. Marka silig derbiga dhinaciisa lagu isticmaalin, gaar-kala-qaybiyayaashuna la mid yihiin silig, waa imisa $\mathrm{m}^2$ aagga ugu weyn ee xayndaabka oo dhan? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U qaado dhererka dhinaca derbiga ku taagan $x$ m, kadibna tiri imisa dhinac oo noocaas ah ayaa jira.
Ku muuji dhererka dhinaca derbiga la socda $x$, aagga ka dhig laba-jibbaar oo $x$ ah, kadibna hel qaybta sare.
cm1_quadFence.explanation: Dhinacyada derbiga ku taagan waa labada dhammaad iyo ${j}$ gaar-kala-qaybiye, isku-geyn ${k}$, sidaa darteed dhererka dhinaca derbiga la socda waa $({L}-{k}x)$ m. Aagga $S(x)=x({L}-{k}x)$ wuxuu ugu weyn yahay marka $x={u}$, qiimaha ugu weynna waa ${ans}$ $\mathrm{m}^2$.

cm1_quadIneqAlways.prompt: Imisa tiro dhan oo $k$ ah ayaa ka dhigaya in xalka sinnaan-la'aanta ${ineq}$ uu yahay dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Maadaama isku-dhufashada $x^2$ uu yahay $k$, kala qaybi marka $k=0$ iyo marka kale. Haddii $k\ne0$, waa inay hoos u foorarsan tahay oo kala-soocidda ay tahay $D<0$ (ama $D\le0$).
U qor kala-soocidda $D$ sida ereyga $k$ oo xalli sinnaan-la'aanta. Marka ay sare u foorarsan tahay ($k<0$), dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah ma buuxin karto.
cm1_quadIneqAlways.explanation: Haddii $k=0$, dhinaca bidix wuxuu noqonayaa joogto ${n}$ oo keliya, qiimahaasna wuxuu ka weyn yahay $0$, sidaa darteed sinnaan-la'aantu had iyo jeer waa run. Haddii $k\ne0$, waa inay hoos u foorarsan tahay, sidaa darteed $k>0$ iyo $\frac{D}{4}={d4}{rel}0$, taas oo marka la xalliyo siinaysa ${kr}$. Sidaa darteed, $k=0$ la darsaday, tirooyinka dhan ee $k$ waa ${ks}$, isku-geyn ${ans}$.

cm1_quadIneqSol.prompt: Marka xalka sinnaan-la'aanta labajibbaaran ${mx2}+ax+b{op}0$ uu yahay ${sol}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${ask}$ ee joogtooyinka $a$, $b$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Qiimayaasha dhammaadka xalka sinnaan-la'aanta waa labada xidid ee isle'egta labajibbaaran ${mx2}+ax+b=0$.
U qor ereyga labajibbaaran sida ($x^2$ isku-dhufashadiisa)$\times(x-\alpha)(x-\beta)$ oo la barbar dhig qaabka la balaadhiyay.
cm1_quadIneqSol.explanation: Maadaama xalku yahay ${sol}$, labada xidid waa ${lo}$, ${hi}$, isku-dhufashada $x^2$ waa ${m}$, sidaa darteed ${mx2}+ax+b={fac}={full}$. Sidaa darteed $a={a}$, $b={b}$ iyo ${ask}={ans}$.

cm1_quadRange.prompt: Waa maxay isugeynta qiimaha ugu weyn iyo ugu yar ee shaqada $y={f}$ marka ${m}\le x\le {n}$? (Halkan, $x$ waa tiro dhab ah.) (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Shaqada labajibbaaran, marka hore hubi in isku-xidhka $x$ ee qaybta sare uu ku jiro inta la siiyay.
Haddii qaybta sare ku jirto inta, barbar dhig qiimayaasha qaybta sare iyo labada dhammaad; haddii ka baxsan tahay, labada dhammaad oo keliya.
cm1_quadRange.explanation: Qaybta sare ee shaqadan waa $({h},{kv})$, qiimaha $y$ ee labada dhammaad ee inta waa ${fm}$ marka $x={m}$ iyo ${fn}$ marka $x={n}$. Marka la eego in isku-xidhka $x$ ee qaybta sare uu ku jiro inta ${m}\le x\le {n}$ oo la helo qiimaha ugu weyn iyo ugu yar, isugeyntoodu waa ${ans}$.

cm1_quadRevenue.prompt: Alaab qiimaheedu yahay ${w}$ won, haddii hal qayb lagu iibiyo ${a}$ won, maalintii waxaa la iibiyaa ${b}$ qayb. Marka qiimaha iibka ${s}$ won la kordhiyo mar kasta, iibka maalinlaha ah wuxuu hoos u dhacaa ${c}$ qayb. Haddii qiimaha iibka la kordhin karo ${s}$ won tiro dhan oo jeer ah (oo ay ku jirto $0$ jeer), waa imisa won faa'iidada ugu badan maalintii? (Faa'iidada waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa (qiimaha iibka $-$ qiimaha asalka)$\times$(tirada la iibiyay).) (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U qaado tirada jeerarka qiimaha la kordhiyay $t$, kadibna ku muuji qiimaha iibka iyo tirada la iibiyay $t$.
(faa'iidada qayb kasta)$\times$(tirada la iibiyay) waa laba-jibbaar oo $t$ ah. Hubi in $t$ ee qaybta sare ay tahay tiro dhan.
