cm1_quadRevenue.explanation: Haddii tirada jeerarka la kordhiyay ay tahay $t$, faa'iidada qayb kasta waa $({e1}+{s}t)$ won, tirada la iibiyayna waa $({b}-{c}t)$, sidaa darteed faa'iidadu waa $({e1}+{s}t)({b}-{c}t)$ won. Labajibbaarkani wuxuu ugu weyn yahay marka $t={tstar}$, faa'iidada wakhtigaas-na waa ${ans}$ won.

cm1_remQuadDiv.prompt: Tiro-badan $P(x)$ ayaa leh: inta harta $P(x)\div({dv1})$ waa ${r1}$, inta harta $P(x)\div({dv2})$ na waa ${r2}$. Haddii inta harta $P(x)\div\left(({dv1})({dv2})\right)$ ay tahay $R(x)$, waa maxay qiimaha $R({c})$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Inta harta marka lagu qaybiyo laba-jibaaran waa tiro-badan darajo koowaad ama ka yar. U qaado $R(x)=px+q$.
Laga bilaabo $P(x)=({dv1})({dv2})Q(x)+R(x)$, ku beddel labada qiimood ee qaybiyaha ka dhigaya $0$.
cm1_remQuadDiv.explanation: Haddii $R(x)=px+q$, $R({a})=P({a})={r1}$, $R({b})=P({b})={r2}$. Labada isla'eg isku xal, $p={p}$, $q={q}$, sidaa darteed $R(x)={Rx}$ iyo $R({c})={ans}$.

cm1_remUnknown.prompt: Tiro-badan $P(x)={pp}$ marka lagu qaybiyo $({dv})$ inta harta waa ${R}$. Waa maxay qiimaha joogtada $k$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Aragtida inta harta: inta harta marka tiro-badan $P(x)$ lagu qaybiyo $x-a$ waa $P(a)$.
Qiimaha $x$ ee qaybiyaha ka dhigaya $0$ waa: $x={t}$. Marka tan lagu beddelo $P(x)$, waxay noqotaa isla'eg darajo koowaad ah oo $k$ ah.
cm1_remUnknown.explanation: Marka loo eego aragtida inta harta, waa in $P({t})={R}$. $P({t})={lhs}$, sidaa darteed ${lhs}={R}$ waxay ka dhigtaa $k={ans}$.

cm1_rootSignCond.prompt: Isla'egta laba-jibaaran ${eq}=0$ waxay leedahay laba xal oo dhab ah oo kala duwan oo labaduba ka weyn yihiin ${t}$. Waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar ee tirada dhan $k$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Haddii dhinaca bidix loo bixiyo $f(x)$, garaafka $y=f(x)$ wuxuu ku kulmaa dhidibka $x$ laba barood oo kala duwan oo labaduba ku yaalaan dhinaca midig ee $x={t}$.
Hubi saddexda shuruudood: kala-saaraha $D>0$, goobta dhidibka (dhidibka $x>{t}$), iyo $f({t})>0$.
cm1_rootSignCond.explanation: Si labada xal ee $f(x)={eq}$ labaduba uga weyn yihiin ${t}$, waa in la buuxiyaa saddexda shuruudood: (i) $\frac{D}{4}={d4}>0$, (ii) dhidibka $x=k$ oo $k>{t}$, (iii) $f({t})={ft}>0$. Tirada dhan ee ugu yar ee $k$ ee buuxisa waa ${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricEval.prompt: Marka tirooyinka dhabta ah $x$, $y$ ay leeyihiin ${cond}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${expr}$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: U muuji qaabka la doonayo wadarta $x+y$ iyo isku-dhufashada $xy$. Tusaale ahaan $x^2+y^2=(x+y)^2-2xy$.
Kuwa saddexda awood ah isticmaal $x^3+y^3=(x+y)^3-3xy(x+y)$, kuwa afarta awood ah marka hore hel $x^2+y^2$ kadibna isticmaal $x^4+y^4=(x^2+y^2)^2-2(xy)^2$.
cm1_symmetricEval.explanation: Marka qaabka isku-dhufashada la beddelo, ${expr}={work}$. (Halkan $(x-y)^2=(x+y)^2-4xy={dd}\ge0$, sidaa darteed waxaa jira tirooyin dhabta ah $x$, $y$ oo buuxiya shuruudda.) Sidaa darteed qiimaha la doonayo waa ${ans}$.

cm1_symmetricInv.prompt: Marka tirada dhabta ah $x$ ay leedahay $x+\frac{1}{x}={k}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${expr}$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Isku-dhufashada $x$ iyo $\frac{1}{x}$ waa $1$. Sidaa darteed haddii la ogaado wadarta $x+\frac{1}{x}$, wadarta awoodaha ayaa la heli karaa.
$x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^2-2$, $x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}=\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)^3-3\left(x+\frac{1}{x}\right)$, afarta awood na $x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}$ mar kale labajibaaree.
cm1_symmetricInv.explanation: Marka qaabka isku-dhufashada la beddelo, ${expr}={work}$. (Tirada dhabta ah $x$, $\left|x+\frac{1}{x}\right|\ge2$, sidaa darteed waxaa jira tiro dhab ah oo buuxisa shuruudan.) Sidaa darteed qiimaha la doonayo waa ${ans}$.

cm1_sysReal.prompt: Imisa tiro dhan oo $k$ ah oo $-{M}\le k\le {M}$ ah ayaa ka dhigaya in nidaamka isle'egyada ${e1}$, ${e2}$ uu leeyahay xal dhab ah $(x, y)$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Isticmaal hal isle'eg si aad u baabi'iso $y$, waxaad heli doontaa isle'eg labajibbaaran oo $x$ ah.
Si ay u lahaato xal dhab ah, kala-soocidda isle'egtaas labajibbaaran waa inay noqotaa $0$ ama ka weyn.
cm1_sysReal.explanation: Marka $y$ laga baabi'iyo hal isle'eg, waxay noqonaysaa isle'eg labajibbaaran oo $x$ ah, si ay u lahaato xal dhab ah waa in ${dcond}$. Waa ${kr}$, sidaa darteed tirooyinka dhan ee $-{M}\le k\le {M}$ ku jira waa ${ans}$.

cm1_sysTwo.prompt: Marka tirooyinka dhabta ah $x$, $y$ ay yihiin xalka nidaamka isle'egyada ${e1}$, ${e2}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee $x$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U kala saar hal isle'eg ama ku muuji hal jaad jaad kale si aad u yarayso tirada jaadadka.
Hel dhammaan xalalka dhabta ah ee suurtagalka ah $(x, y)$, kadibna dooro qiimaha ugu weyn ee $x$.
cm1_sysTwo.explanation: Marka nidaamka la xalliyo, $(x,\ y)={sols}$. Ka mid ah kuwan, qiimaha ugu weyn ee $x$ waa ${ans}$.

cm1_vietaExpr.prompt: Ha ahaadaan $\alpha$, $\beta$ labada xidid ee isle'egta labajibbaaran ${eq}=0$. Waa maxay qiimaha ${expr}$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isle'egta labajibbaaran $ax^2+bx+c=0$, isugeynta labada xidid waa $-\frac{b}{a}$, wax-soo-saarkooduna waa $\frac{c}{a}$.
Ku muuji ereyga la raadinayo $\alpha+\beta$ iyo $\alpha\beta$, kadibna ku beddel qiimayaasha.
cm1_vietaExpr.explanation: Marka loo eego xidid-iyo-isku-dhufasho, $\alpha+\beta={sf}$, $\alpha\beta={pf}$. Sidaa darteed ${expr}={work}={res}$.

cm1_vietaUnknown.prompt: Ha ahaadaan $\alpha$, $\beta$ labada xidid ee isle'egta labajibbaaran $x^2-kx{cs}=0$. Marka ${cond}$, waa maxay qiimaha togan ee $k$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Marka loo eego xidid-iyo-isku-dhufasho, isugeynta labada xidid waa $k$, wax-soo-saarkoodu waa ${c}$.
Ku muuji shuruudda la siiyay $\alpha+\beta$ iyo $\alpha\beta$, ama u qaado hal xidid jaad oo kan kale ku muuji, kadibna hel $k$.
cm1_vietaUnknown.explanation: Marka loo eego xidid-iyo-isku-dhufasho, $\alpha+\beta=k$, $\alpha\beta={c}$. ${work}$ Sidaa darteed $k={ans}$.

cm2_amgmMin.prompt: Marka ${dom}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar ee ${ex}$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Laba tiro oo togan $A$, $B$, $A+B\ge 2\sqrt{A\,B}$ (sinnaantu waa marka $A=B$).
Isku lammaan si wax-soo-saarku u noqdo joogto, isticmaal xiriirka celceliska xisaabeed iyo geometric, kadibna hubi in qiimaha $x$ ee sinnaanta ay ku jirto xadka shuruudda ${dom}$.
cm2_amgmMin.explanation: ${work}$, sinnaantuna waxay dhacdaa marka $x={xe}$, qiimahaasna wuxuu ku jiraa xadka shuruudda ${dom}$. Sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu yar waa ${ans}$.

cm2_chordLength.prompt: Goobada $C$: ${circ}$, xariiqda $l$: ${line}$. Waa maxay dhererka xargaha ay $l$ ka jarto $C$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Tiirka laga soo dhigo bartamaha goobada xariiqda wuxuu u qaybiyaa xargaha laba qaybood oo siman. Marka hore hel masaafada u dhexeysa bartamaha iyo xariiqda.
Haddii raadiyaha yahay $r$ iyo masaafada bartamaha ilaa xariiqda $d$, dhererka xargaha waa $2\sqrt{r^2-d^2}$.
cm2_chordLength.explanation: Bartamaha goobadu waa $({cx}, {cy})$, raadiyuhuna waa ${rad}$. Masaafada u dhexeysa bartamaha iyo xariiqda waa $d=\frac{|{la}\times({cx})+({lb})\times({cy})+({lc})|}{\sqrt{({la})^2+({lb})^2}}=\frac{{dh}}{{h}}={d}$, sidaa darteed dhererka xargaha waa $2\sqrt{{rad}^2-{d}^2}=2\times{half}={ans}$.

cm2_circleGeneral.prompt: Muuqaalka ay matalayso isle'egta ${eq}$ waa goobo. Haddii isku-xidhka bartamaha goobadan yahay $(a, b)$ iyo raadiyuhu yahay $r$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b+r$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U beddel qaabka labajibbaarka dhammaystiran ee $x$ iyo $y$, $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2=r^2$.
Ku qaybi labada dhinac isku-dhufashada $x^2$, $y^2$, kadibna isku kooxee $x$ iyo $y$ si aad u samayso labajibbaar dhammaystiran.
cm2_circleGeneral.explanation: Maadaama isku-dhufashada $x^2$ uu yahay ${kk}$, ku qaybi labada dhinac isku-dhufashadaas oo u beddel labajibbaar dhammaystiran: ${std}$. Bartamuhu waa $({cx}, {cy})$, raadiyuhuna waa ${rad}$, sidaa darteed $a+b+r={cx}+({cy})+{rad}={ans}$.

cm2_circleTangentAxes.prompt: Goobooyinka bartamahoodu ku yaal rubuca 1aad oo taabanaya dhidibka $x$ iyo dhidibka $y$ isku mar, waxaa jira laba goobo oo marta barta $P({p}, {q})$. Laba goobo kan, waa maxay dhererka bar-dhexroorka goobada weyn? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Bartamaha goobada ee rubuca 1aad ee taabanaysa labada dhidib waa $(r, r)$ bar-dhexroorkuna waa $r$.
Ku beddel isku-xidhka barta goobada $(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ kadibna xalli isle'egga laba-jibbaaran ee $r$.
cm2_circleTangentAxes.explanation: Isle'egga goobadu waa $(x-r)^2+(y-r)^2=r^2$ ($r>0$) wuxuuna maraa barta $P$, sidaa darteed $({p}-r)^2+({q}-r)^2=r^2$, taasoo ah $r^2-{u}r+{t}=0$. Marka la xalliyo, $r={rs}$ ama $r={rl}$, sidaa darteed bar-dhexroorka weyn waa ${ans}$.

cm2_compFindG.prompt: Laba shaqo $f$, $g$ oo $f(x)={f}$ iyo shaqada isku-dhafan $(f\circ g)(x)={comp}$, waa maxay qiimaha $g({t})$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Maadaama $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, meesha $x$ ee isle'egga $f$ ku beddel $g(x)$.
Laga bilaabo $f(g(x))={comp}$, xalli isle'egga ku saabsan $g(x)$ si aad u hesho $g(x)$, kadibna geli $x={t}$.

cm2_compTable.prompt: Laba shaqo $f$, $g$ oo ka socda kooxda $X=\{{xset}\}$ una socda $X$ waa sidan: $f$: ${ft}$, $g$: ${gt}$. Imisa curiye $x$ oo ka mid ah $X$ ayaa buuxiya $(f\circ g)(x)=(g\circ f)(x)$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$, $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$. $x$ kasta labada qiime si gooni ah u hel.
$x=1, 2, \dots$ isdaba-joog u samee miis $f(g(x))$ iyo $g(f(x))$ oo barbar dhig.
cm2_compTable.explanation: $x$ kasta, marka la helo $f(g(x))$, $g(f(x))$, waa ${work}$. Tirada $x$ ee labada qiime isle'egyihiin waa ${ans}$.

cm2_divPoint.prompt: Labada barood $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$ waxaa jira bar $P$ oo gudaha u qaybisa qaybta xariiqda $AB$. Marka $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={m}:{n}$, waa maxay wadarka isku-xidhka $x$ iyo isku-xidhka $y$ ee barta $P$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Isku-xidhka barta gudaha u qaybisa qaybta xariiqda $AB$ saamiga $m:n$ waa $\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Hel isku-xidhka $x$ iyo $y$ si gooni ah, kadibna isku dar. Isku-xidhka $x$ waa $\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}}$.
cm2_divPoint.explanation: $P\left(\frac{{m}\times({x2})+{n}\times({x1})}{{m}+{n}},\ \frac{{m}\times({y2})+{n}\times({y1})}{{m}+{n}}\right)=({px}, {py})$, sidaa darteed wadarka labada isku-xidhe waa ${px}+({py})={ans}$.

cm2_divRatioFind.prompt: Saddexda barood $A({x1}, {y1})$, $B({x2}, {y2})$, $P({px}, {py})$, barta $P$ waxay ku taal qaybta xariiqda $AB$ iyo $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=m:n$. Marka $m$, $n$ yihiin tirooyin dabiici ah oo isku-qaybiye guud ma lahan (1 mooyee), waa maxay qiimaha $m+n$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Haddii $P$ ay gudaha u qaybiso $AB$ saamiga $m:n$, isku-xidhka $x$ waa $\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n}$. Si ka duwan, isku-xidhka $P$ ka hel saamiga.
Isku-xidhka $x$ farqigiisa ka hel $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}=|p_x-x_1|:|x_2-p_x|$ oo dhim.
cm2_divRatioFind.explanation: Marka isku-xidhka $x$ la barbar dhigo, $|{px}-({x1})|={u}$, $|({x2})-({px})|={w}$, sidaa darteed $\overline{A P}:\overline{P B}={u}:{w}$, marka loogu muujiyo saami tiro buuxda oo isku-qaybiye guud aan lahayn waa ${m}:{n}$. (Isku-xidhka $y$ wuxuu sidoo kale bixiyaa isla saamigan.) Sidaa darteed $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_existsInterval.prompt: $U$ waa kooxda dhammaan tirooyinka buuxda laga bilaabo ${p}$ ilaa ${q}$. Waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee tirada buuxda $k$ si hadalkan '$U$ waxaa ku jira curiye $x$ oo ${form}$' uu run u noqdo? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: 'Curiye $x$ jira' waxay run tahay haddii ugu yaraan hal $x$ uu buuxiyo shuruudda.
Sinnaan-la'aanta u beddel qaab $k<g(x)$, kadibna ka hel qiimaha ugu weyn ee $g(x)$ curiyeyaasha $U$.
cm2_existsInterval.explanation: ${form}$ waxaa loo beddeli karaa qaab $k<{gx}$. Curiyeyaasha $U$ dhexdooda, ${gx}$ waa ugu weyn ${gm}$ marka $x={xm}$, haddii $k<{gm}$ markaas $x$ kan ayaa run ka dhigaya. Sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu weyn ee tirada buuxda $k$ waa ${ans}$.

cm2_funcInjective.prompt: Shaqooyinka hal-ka-hal ah $f$ ee ka socda kooxda $X=\{{xset}\}$ una socda kooxda $Y=\{{yset}\}$, imisa ayaa buuxiya $f(1)\le {t}$ iyo $f(2)\ge {u}$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Shaqada hal-ka-hal ah waxay curiyeyaasha kala duwan ee $X$ ugu xirtaa qiimaha shaqo ee kala duwan. Marka hore go'aami $f(1)$, $f(2)$.
Tiri tirada $(f(1), f(2))$ ee $f(1)\ne f(2)$, kadibna ku dhufo tirada siyaabaha loo go'aamin karo qiimaha shaqo ee curiyeyaasha kale.
cm2_funcInjective.explanation: $f(1)$ waxay leedahay ${t}$ siyaabood, $f(2)$ waxay leedahay ${n}-{u}+1$ siyaabood, iyo ${ov}$ xaaladood oo $f(1)=f(2)$ ay noqoto, sidaa darteed $(f(1), f(2))$ waxay leedahay ${pairs}$ siyaabood. ${mr}$ curiye ee hadhay waxaa loogu xiraa ${nr}$ qiime ee hadhay hal-ka-hal, taasoo siinaysa ${rest}$ siyaabood, tirada la rabaa waa ${pairs}\times{rest}={ans}$.

cm2_funcMonotone.prompt: Shaqooyinka $f$ ee ka socda kooxda $X=\{{xset}\}$ una socda kooxda $Y=\{{yset}\}$, imisa ayaa buuxiya ${chain}$ iyo $f(1)\ge {u}$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Haddii $f(1)<f(2)<\cdots$, qiimayaasha shaqadu dhammaan way kala duwan yihiin, marka qiimayaasha la doorto, xiriirka sida u kala horreeya ayaa si gaar ah u go'aaminaya.
Tirooyinka noqon kara qiimaha shaqada waa tirooyin buuxda laga bilaabo ${u}$ ilaa ${w}$, waana tirada siyaabaha loo dooran karo ${m}$ ka mid ah oo kala duwan.
cm2_funcMonotone.explanation: Qiimayaasha shaqadu waa in laga doorto ${m}$ kala duwan oo ka mid ah ${k}$ tiro oo buuxda laga bilaabo ${u}$ ilaa ${w}$. Marka qiimayaasha la doortay laga bilaabo kii ugu yaraa loogu xiro $f(1), f(2), \dots$, si gaar ah ayaa loo go'aamiyaa, sidaa darteed tirada waa $_{{k}}\mathrm{C}_{{m}}={ans}$.

cm2_inclusionParam.prompt: Marka laba kooxood $A=\{x\mid {Ac}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {Cc}\}$ ($x$ waa tiro dhab ah), imisa kooxood $B=\{x\mid a\le x\le b\}$ ($a$, $b$ waa tirooyin buuxda) ayaa buuxisa $A\subset B\subset C$? ($\subset$ waxay ku jirtaa xaaladda labada kooxood ay isle'egyihiin.) (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Marka hore $A$ iyo $C$ ku muuji qaab kala-duwanaansho $\alpha\le x\le\beta$.

Haddii $A\subset B$, $a$ waa inay ahaataa ka yar ama le'eg dhammaadka bidix ee $A$, $b$ na ka weyn ama le'eg dhammaadka midig ee $A$; haddii $B\subset C$, $a$ iyo $b$ waa inay ku jiraan kala-duwanaanshaha $C$. Tiri qiimaha suurtagalka ah ee $a$ iyo $b$ mid mid.
cm2_inclusionParam.explanation: $A=\{x\mid {al}\le x\le {ar}\}$, $C=\{x\mid {cl}\le x\le {cr}\}$. Si $A\subset B\subset C$ u noqoto, waa in ${cl}\le a\le {al}$, ${ar}\le b\le {cr}$, sidaa darteed $a$ waxay leedahay ${na}$ qiime, $b$ waxay leedahay ${nb}$ qiime, tirada $B$ waa ${na}\times{nb}={ans}$.

cm2_inverseQuadDom.prompt: Haddii shaqada $f(x)={fx}$ (${dom}$) shaqadeeda rogan loo yaqaan $g$, waa maxay qiimaha $g({t})$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Marka aagga qeexitaanka la xaddido (${dom}$), $f$ waa hal-ka-hal oo waxay leedahay shaqo rogan.
Haddii $g({t})=x$, $f(x)={t}$. Xalli isle'egga laba-jibbaaran $f(x)={t}$ kadibna dooro xalka ku habboon aagga.
cm2_inverseQuadDom.explanation: $f(x)={vf}$ ayaa lagu beddeli karaa, $f(x)={t}$ waxay siinaysaa ${sq}={s2}$, sidaa darteed ${xp}=\pm{s}$. Maadaama aagga qeexitaanku yahay ${dom}$, ${xp}={rt}$ iyo $g({t})={ans}$.

cm2_inverseRational.prompt: Haddii shaqada rogan ee shaqada $f(x)=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ loo yaqaan $g$, waa maxay qiimaha $g({k})$? (Aagga qeexitaanka $f$ waa dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah ee hoosahoodu aanu ahayn $0$.) (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Haddii $g({k})=x$, $f(x)={k}$.
Isle'egga $\frac{{num}}{{den}}={k}$ labada dhinac ku dhufo hoosaha, kadibna u xalli sidii isle'eg heerka koowaad ee $x$.
cm2_inverseRational.explanation: Haddii $g({k})=x$, $f(x)={k}$, sidaa darteed ${num}={k}\times({den})$. Marka loo habeeyo $x$, $({coef})x={rhs}$, sidaa darteed $x={ans}$, taasoo ah $g({k})={ans}$.

cm2_irrLineCount.prompt: Imisa tiro oo buuxda $k$ ayaa ka dhigaya in isgoysyada qalooca $y=\sqrt{{fr}}$ iyo xariiqda $y=x+k$ ay noqdaan 2? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: U qeex xaraf cusub $t$ sidan: $t=\sqrt{{fr}}$ ($t\ge 0$). Markaas $x$ waxaa lagu muujin karaa $t$. Tirada isgoysyadu waxay la mid tahay tirada xididdada dhabta ah ee aan taban ee kala duwan ee isle'egga laba-jibbaaran ee $t$.
Shuruudda isle'egga laba-jibbaaran ee $t$ uu u leeyahay laba xidid dhab ah oo aan taban oo kala duwan waa $D>0$, (wadarka labada xidid)$\ge 0$, (wax-isku-dhufka labada xidid)$\ge 0$.
cm2_irrLineCount.explanation: Haddii xaraf cusub $t$ loo qeexo $t=\sqrt{{fr}}\ (t\ge 0)$, $x=\frac{t^2-({b})}{{a}}$, laga bilaabo $t=x+k$ waxaa soo baxda $t^2-{a}t+({a}k-({b}))=0$. Si uu u yeesho laba xidid dhab ah oo aan taban oo kala duwan, $D={a}^2-4({a}k-({b}))>0$ iyo wax-isku-dhufka ${a}k-({b})\ge 0$ (wadarka ${a}>0$), sidaa darteed ${lt}\le k<{ht}$. Tirooyinka buuxda $k$ ee buuxiya tan waa ${lo}$ ilaa ${hi}$, ${ans}$ guud ahaan.

cm2_irrationalMinMax.prompt: Waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee shaqada $f(x)={fx}$ marka ${lo}\le x\le {hi}$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Maadaama wixii ku jira xididka ay yihiin heer koowaad, marka $x$ weynaado $f(x)$ wuxuu u beddelmaa hal dhinac oo keliya. Sidaa darteed barbar dhig qiimayaasha labada dhammaad ee kala-duwanaanshaha.
Hel qiimaha shaqada marka $x={lo}$ iyo marka $x={hi}$, kadibna dooro midka weyn.
cm2_irrationalMinMax.explanation: $f({lo})=\sqrt{{rl}}+({c})={flo}$, $f({hi})=\sqrt{{rh}}+({c})={fhi}$. Kala-duwanaanshahan $f$ wuxuu kordhaa ama hoos u dhacaa oo keliya, sidaa darteed qiimaha weyn ee labadaas waa ugu weyn, waana ${ans}$.

cm2_irrationalPass.prompt: Bar ku taal garaafka shaqada aan caqliga lahayn $y=\sqrt{a({xp})}{qs}$ ($a$ waa joogto aan $0$ ahayn) waa $P({x0}, {y0})$. Waa maxay qiimaha $a$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Ku beddel isku-xidhka barta isle'egga. Xusuuso in xididka laba-jibbaaran uu ka weyn yahay ama le'eg yahay $0$.
Ka tag xididka oo keliya, labada dhinac labajibaaree, kadibna u xalli sidii isle'eg heerka koowaad ee $a$.
cm2_irrationalPass.explanation: Marka barta $P$ la geliyo, ${y0}=\sqrt{a({x0}-({p}))}+({q})$, sidaa darteed $\sqrt{a\times({d})}={s}$. Marka labada dhinac la labajibaareeyo, $a\times({d})={s2}$, sidaa darteed $a={ans}$.

cm2_lineCircleCount.prompt: Goobada $C$: ${circ}$, xariiqda $l$: ${line}$. Imisa tiro buuxda oo togan $k$ ayaa ka dhigaya in $C$ iyo $l$ ay isku goynayaan laba bar oo kala duwan? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Haddii masaafada u dhexaysa bartamaha goobada iyo xariiqdu ka yar tahay bar-dhexroorka, waxay isku goyn laba bar oo kala duwan.
Masaafada $\frac{|{u}\times({cx})+({w})\times({cy})-k|}{\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}}<{rad}$ u habee sidii sinnaan-la'aan ku saabsan $k$.
cm2_lineCircleCount.explanation: Masaafada laga bilaabo bartamaha $({cx}, {cy})$ ilaa xariiqda waa inay ka yartahay bar-dhexroorka ${rad}$, sidaa darteed $|{K0}-k|<{rad}\sqrt{({u})^2+({w})^2}=\sqrt{{R2}}$. Tirooyinka buuxda ee buuxiya tan waa ${lo}\le k\le {hi}$, kuwa togan ee ka mid ahna waa ${ans}$.

cm2_lineThroughPerp.prompt: Toosinta ka baxda barta $P({px}, {py})$ ee ku toosan xariiqda $l$: ${line}$ (xariiqda ka gudubta $P$ ee ku toosan $l$) markay dhidibka $y$ ku kulanto, waa maxay isku-duwaha $y$ ee barta? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka laba xariiq ay is-toosan yihiin, isku-dhufashada jiidashadooda waa $-1$.
Marka hore hel jiidashada $l$, kaddib jiidashada xariiqda toosan ku samee isla'egta bar-iyo-jiidasho, oo geli $x=0$.
cm2_lineThroughPerp.explanation: Jiidashada xariiqda $l$ waa ${ms}$, sidaa darteed jiidashada xariiqda toosan waa ${mp}$. Maadaama ay maraysa barta $P$, $y-({py})={mp}\left(x-({px})\right)$, marka $x=0$ la geliyo $y={ans}$.

cm2_necessaryDiv.prompt: Laba shuruud oo ku saabsan tiro dhammaystiran $x$: $p$: $x$ waa isku-dhufashada $m$. $q$: $x$ waa isku-dhufashada ${n}$. Waa immisa tiro dabiici ah $m$ oo ka dhigaya $p$ shuruud lagama maarmaan ah oo $q$ ah, laakiin aan ahayn shuruud ku filan? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Haddii $p$ ay tahay shuruud lagama maarmaan ah oo $q$ ah, $q\Rightarrow p$. Kooxo run ah ahaan $Q\subset P$.
Si dhammaan isku-dhufashooyinka ${n}$ ay u noqdaan isku-dhufashooyin $m$, $m$ waa inuu ahaado kala-qaybiyaha ${n}$. Si aysan shuruud ku filan u noqon, $p\Rightarrow q$ waa inaanay run ahayn.
cm2_necessaryDiv.explanation: Maadaama ay tahay shuruud lagama maarmaan ah, $q\Rightarrow p$, taas oo ah in dhammaan isku-dhufashooyinka ${n}$ ay noqdaan isku-dhufashooyinka $m$, taasna waxay run tahay marka $m$ uu yahay kala-qaybiyaha ${n}$. Si aysan shuruud ku filan u noqon, $p\Rightarrow q$ waa inay been noqotaa, laakiin marka $m$ uu yahay kala-qaybiyaha ${n}$, $p\Rightarrow q$ waxay run tahay marka $m={n}$ keliya. Kala-qaybiyayaasha ${n}$ waa ${nd}$, sidaa darteed tirada $m$ ee la doonayo waa ${nd}-1={ans}$.

cm2_perpParam.prompt: Labada xariiq $l_1: {l1}$, $l_2: {l2}$, waa maxay wadarta dhammaan qiimayaasha dhabta ah ee $k$ ee ka dhigaya labada xariiq is-barbar socda ama is-toosan? (Xaalad ay labada xariiq is-dul dhacaan is-barbar socod ma aha.) (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Labada xariiq $ax+by+c=0$, $a'x+b'y+c'=0$ waa is-barbar socda (ama isku mid) haddii $ab'-a'b=0$, waana is-toosan yihiin haddii $aa'+bb'=0$.
Shuruudda is-barbar socodku waa isla'eg labaad-darajo oo ku saabsan $k$, shuruudda is-toosnaanta-na waa isla'eg koowaad-darajo. Mid walba xalli oo qiimayaasha dhan ururi.
cm2_perpParam.explanation: Isku-dhufashooyinka $x$, $y$ ee $l_1$ waa ${p}$, $k$, kuwa $l_2$-na waa $k{qs}$, ${rr}$. Shuruudda is-barbar socodka: ${p}\times({rr})=k(k{qs})$, taas oo ah ${eqPar}=0$, $k={k1}$ ama $k={k2}$, labada xaaladoodba isma dul dhacaan. Shuruudda is-toosnaanta: ${p}(k{qs})+({rr})k=0$, $k={k3}$. Sidaa darteed wadarta waa ${k1}+({k2})+({k3})={ans}$.

cm2_pointLineDist.prompt: Waa maxay fogaanta barta $P({x0}, {y0})$ ilaa xariiqda ${line}$? (Waxaad ku qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: Fogaanta u dhexeysa barta $(x_0,y_0)$ iyo xariiqda $ax+by+c=0$ waa $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+c|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$.
Korreeyaha xisaabi $|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|$, hooseeyuhuna waa $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}$.
cm2_pointLineDist.explanation: Gudaha $\frac{|{a}\times({x0})+({b})\times({y0})+({c})|}{\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}}$, korreeyuhu waa ${N}$ iyo $\sqrt{({a})^2+({b})^2}={h}$, sidaa darteed fogaantu waa $\frac{{N}}{{h}}={ans}$.

cm2_rationalAsym.prompt: Marka labada xariiq ee garaafka shaqada jajabka ah $y=\frac{{num}}{{den}}$ ku dhow yihiin ay yihiin xariiqaha $x=p$, $y=q$, waa maxay qiimaha $p+q$? (Waxaad ku qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: Qiimaha $x$ ee hooseeyaha ka dhigaya $0$ waa xariiqda ku dhow ee toosan.
Qiimaha ay $y$ ku dhowaato marka qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee $x$ aad u weynaado waa xariiqda ku dhow ee jiifka ah. Waa saamiga isku-dhufashooyinka $x$ ee korreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha.
cm2_rationalAsym.explanation: Xariiqda ku dhow ee toosan waa qiimaha $x$ ee hooseeyaha ka dhigaya $0$, sidaa darteed waa xariiqda $x={px}$. Marka $x\to\infty$, $y\to\frac{{a}}{{c}}={qy}$, sidaa darteed xariiqda ku dhow ee jiifka ahi waa $y={qy}$. Sidaa darteed $p+q=({px})+({qy})={ans}$.

cm2_rationalIntersectCount.prompt: Imisa tiro dhan oo $n$ ah oo $-{N}\le n\le {N}$ ah ayaa ka dhigaya graph-ka shaqada $y={fr}$ iyo xariiqda ${line}$ inay laba meel isgooyaan? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Isku xir labada isle'eg si aad u hesho isle'egta labajibbaaran ee $x$, kadibna ka fikir shuruudda ay ku leedahay laba xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan (kala-soocid).
Maadaama aad ku dhufatay erey ka kooban $x$ si aad hooseeyaha u baabi'iso, hubi in xididdada isle'egta aysan hoosaha ka dhigin $0$.
cm2_rationalIntersectCount.explanation: Marka la isku xiro, laga bilaabo $\frac{{k}}{{den}}{qs}={mx}+n$, kadib baabi'inta hoosaha, kala-soocidda isle'egta labajibbaaran waa $D=({nstr})^2{ds}$. (Xididdadu hoosaha $0$ uma beddelaan.) Waa in $D>0$, sidaa darteed marka laga saaro tirooyinka dhan ee $n$ aan buuxinayn, ${tot}$ ee ku jira xadka ${bad}$ ayaa laga saaray, waxaana haray ${ans}$.

cm2_rationalParam.prompt: Graph-ka shaqada $y=\frac{k}{x}$ ($k$ waa joogto aan $0$ ahayn) ayaa lagu raray ${p}$ jihada $x$ iyo ${q}$ jihada $y$. Meel ku taal graph-kaas waa $P({x0}, {y0})$. Waa maxay isku-xidhka $x$ ee meesha graph-kani ku dhufto dhidibka $x$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Marka la rido, ereyga $x$ wuxuu noqonayaa $x-({p})$, $y$-na wuxuu noqonayaa $y-({q})$.
Ku beddel isku-xidhka meesha la siiyay si aad u hesho $k$, kadibna ku beddel $y=0$.
cm2_rationalParam.explanation: Graph-ka la rray waa $y=\frac{k}{{xsh}}{ysh}$. Maadaama meesha $P$ ay graph-ka ku taal, ${y0}=\frac{k}{{dx}}{ysh}$ waxay siinaysaa $k={kk}$. Marka $y=0$, $\frac{{kk}}{{xsh}}={nq}$, sidaa darteed $x={ans}$.

cm2_reflectChainOrder.prompt: Meesha $P(a, b)$ ayaa lagu raray ${m}$ jihada $x$ iyo ${n}$ jihada $y$ si ay u noqoto $Q$; $Q$ waxaa loo muraayadeeyay xagga isha si ay u noqoto $R$; $R$ waxaa loo muraayadeeyay xagga dhidibka $x$ si ay u noqoto $S$. Haddii isku-xidhka $S$ yahay $({sx}, {sy})$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Muraayadaynta xagga isha waa $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, muraayadaynta xagga dhidibka $x$-na waa $(x,y)\to(x,-y)$.
Marka hore waa la rarayaa, kadibna waa la muraayadaynayaa, sidaa darteed qaddarka la raray sidoo kale wuu beddelayaa calaamadda. Ka bilow $S$ oo u laabo talaabo talaabo, ama ku muuji $a$, $b$.
cm2_reflectChainOrder.explanation: Marka lagu muujiyo $a$, $b$: $Q(a+({m}), b+({n}))$, $R(-a-({m}), -b-({n}))$, $S(-a-({m}), b+({n}))$. Laga bilaabo $-a-({m})={sx}$, $a={pa}$; laga bilaabo $b+({n})={sy}$, $b={pb}$, sidaa darteed $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectCurve.prompt: Graph-ka shaqada $y={orig}$ waxaa loo muraayadeeyay xagga isha, kadibna lagu raray ${m}$ jihada $x$ iyo ${n}$ jihada $y$. Haddii isku-xidhka quruxda dhaladka paraabolada la helay yahay $(s, t)$, waa maxay qiimaha $s+t$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Muraayadaynta xagga isha waa $(x,y)\to(-x,-y)$, sidaa darteed ereyga ku beddel $x$ ilaa $-x$ iyo $y$ ilaa $-y$.
Waad hel kartaa qaybta sare ee paraabolada asalka ah oo labada guuritaan isku xigxig ugu dabaqi kartaa, ama si toos ah u qori kartaa ereyga la beddelay.
cm2_reflectCurve.explanation: Qaybta sare ee paraabolada asalka ahi waa $({h}, {k})$. Marka loo muraayadeeyo xagga isha, waxay noqonaysaa paraabolo qaabka $y=-({orig2})$ oo qaybta sarahu tahay $({nh}, {nk})$. Marka lagu raro ${m}$ jihada $x$ iyo ${n}$ jihada $y$, $(s, t)=({s}, {t})$, sidaa darteed $s+t={ans}$.

cm2_reflectPointChain.prompt: Meesha $P(a, b)$ waxaa loo muraayadeeyay xagga xariiqda $y=x$ si ay u noqoto $Q$; $Q$ waxaa loo muraayadeeyay xagga dhidibka $y$ si ay u noqoto $R$; $R$ waxaa lagu raray ${m}$ jihada $x$ iyo ${n}$ jihada $y$ si ay u noqoto $S$. Haddii isku-xidhka $S$ yahay $({sx}, {sy})$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Muraayadaynta xagga xariiqda $y=x$ waa $(x,y)\to(y,x)$, muraayadaynta xagga dhidibka $y$-na waa $(x,y)\to(-x,y)$.
Ka bilow $S$ oo u laabo talaabo talaabo, ama ku muuji isku-xidhka laga bilaabo $P(a,b)$ ilaa $S$ iyadoo la isticmaalayo $a$, $b$.
cm2_reflectPointChain.explanation: Marka lagu muujiyo $a$, $b$: $Q(b, a)$, $R(-b, a)$, $S(-b+({m}), a+({n}))$. Laga bilaabo $-b+({m})={sx}$, $b={pb}$; laga bilaabo $a+({n})={sy}$, $a={pa}$, sidaa darteed $a+b={ans}$.

cm2_reflectShortest.prompt: Marka la siiyo barta $A({a1}, {a2})$ iyo barta $B({b1}, {b2})$ ee heyska isku-duwaha, iyo barta $P$ oo ku dhaqaaqda dhidibka $x$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar ee $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Maadaama labada bar ay dhinac isku mid ah ka yihiin dhidibka $x$, haddii barta mid ka mid ah loo muuqaal-rogo dhidibka $x$, $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}$ waxaa loo beddeli karaa dhererka hal qayb.
Haddii $B$ loo muuqaal-rogo dhidibka $x$ si loo helo barta $B'$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$ ayaa jira, $\overline{A P}+\overline{PB'}\ge\overline{AB'}$ ayaana run ah.
cm2_reflectShortest.explanation: Haddii barta ka timaadda muuqaal-rogidda $B$ ee dhidibka $x$ la yiraahdo $B'({b1}, {nb2})$, $\overline{P B}=\overline{PB'}$, sidaa darteed $\overline{A P}+\overline{P B}\ge\overline{AB'}$; $A$ iyo $B'$ waxay ku yaalliin labada dhinac ee dhidibka $x$, sidaa darteed qaybta $AB'$ waxay ku kulantaa dhidibka $x$ oo sinnaanta ayaa jirta. $\overline{AB'}=\sqrt{({b1}-({a1}))^2+({a2}-({nb2}))^2}=\sqrt{{dx}^2+{ss}^2}={ans}$.

cm2_setOpSum.prompt: $U$ waa kooxda dhammaan tirooyinka dabiiciga ah ee ka bilaabma 1 ilaa ${N}$, $A$ waa kooxda dhammaan kala-qaybiyayaasha ${da}$ ee ka tirsan $U$, $B$ waana kooxda dhammaan isku-dhufashooyinka ${mb}$ ee ka tirsan $U$. Waa maxay wadarta dhammaan xubnaha kooxda ${ex}$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka hore $A$ iyo $B$ ku qor habka liis-gareynta xubnaha.
Dheeraadka $X^c$ waa waxa ka haray $U$ marka xubnaha $X$ laga saaro. Xisaabi si tartiib ah ka bilaabo qawsyada gudahooda.

cm2_setSumCount.prompt: Labada kooxood $A=\{{sa}\}$, $B=\{{sb}\}$ ee loo yaqaan, waa maxay wadarta dhammaan xubnaha kooxda $C=\{x+y\mid x\in A,\ y\in B\}$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Dooro hal xubin oo $A$ ah iyo hal xubin oo $B$ ah, isku dar, oo samee dhammaan wadarrada suurtagalka ah.
Xataa haddii isla qiimuhu dhowr jeer soo baxo, xubin kooxeed ahaan mar keliya tiri.
cm2_setSumCount.explanation: Marka la helo dhammaan wadarrada suurtagalka ah, qiimayaasha kala duwan waa ${sc}$. Kooxdu xubin isku mid ah mar keliya ayay qortaa, sidaa darteed wadarta xubnuhu waa ${ans}$.

cm2_sufficientQuad.prompt: Waxaa jira laba shuruud oo ku saabsan tiro dhab ah $x$: $p$: $x>a$, $q$: ${quad}>0$. Waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar ee tiro dhammaystiran $a$ oo ka dhigaya $p$ shuruud ku filan oo $q$ ah? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Haddii $p$ ay tahay shuruud ku filan oo $q$ ah, markaas $p\Rightarrow q$, taas oo ah in kooxda run-ka ee $p$ ay ku jirto kooxda run-ka ee $q$.
Marka hore xalli isla'eg-la'aanta labaad-darajo ${quad}>0$ si aad u hesho kooxda run-ka ee $q$.
cm2_sufficientQuad.explanation: Xalka ${quad}>0$ waa $x<{Rs}$ ama $x>{Rl}$. Si kooxda run-ka ee $p$, $\{x\mid x>a\}$, ugu jirto kooxdan, waa in $a\ge {Rl}$. Sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu yar ee tiro dhammaystiran $a$ waa ${ans}$.

cm2_tangentAtPoint.prompt: Barta $({x1}, {y1})$ ee ku taal goobaabinta ${circ}$, hal bar oo ku taal taabashadeeda waa $Q({t}, k)$. Waa maxay qiimaha $k$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Taabashada barta goobaabinta ku taal waxay ku toosan tahay raadiyaha isku xidha barta iyo dhexda.
Marka hore qor isla'egta taabashada, kaddib ku beddel isku-duwaha barta $Q$.
cm2_tangentAtPoint.explanation: Isla'egta taabashadu waa ${tang}$. Maadaama barta $Q$ ay ku taal taabashada, $x={t}$, $y=k$ marka la geliyo, $k={ans}$.

cm2_translateCurve.prompt: Garaafka shaqada $y={orig}$ waxaa lagu raray $m$ jihada dhidibka $x$ iyo $n$ jihada dhidibka $y$, waxayna noqotay isku mid garaafka shaqada $y={img}$. Waa maxay qiimaha $m+n$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka lagu rarto $m$ jihada dhidibka $x$ iyo $n$ jihada dhidibka $y$, $x$ waxaa lagu beddelaa $x-m$, $y$-na waxaa lagu beddelaa $y-n$.
Fidi $y-n=f(x-m)$, oo marka hore barbar dhig isku-dhufashada $x$ si aad u hesho $m$.
cm2_translateCurve.explanation: Isla'egta la raray waa $y-n={shift}$. Marka la fidiyo oo la barbar dhigo isku-dhufashada $x$, ${b}-({tw})m={b2}$, sidaa darteed $m={m}$, marka la barbar dhigo tirada joogtada ah, $n={n}$. Sidaa darteed $m+n={ans}$.

cm2_truthRange.prompt: Laba shuruud oo ku saabsan tiro dhab ah $x$: $p$: ${quad}\le 0$, $q$: $|{cx}|\le a$. Ha ahaato $\alpha$ tirada dabiiciga ah ee ugu yar ee $a$ ee ka dhigaysa lid-bixinta (contrapositive) ee hadalka $p\to q$ run, $\beta$-na tirada dabiiciga ah ee ugu weyn ee $a$ ee ka dhigaysa lidka (converse) ee hadalka $p\to q$ run. Waa maxay qiimaha $\alpha\beta$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Hadalka iyo lid-bixintiisu mar walba run-been ahaan way isku mid yihiin. Lidka $q\to p$ gooni ayaa loo eegaa hadalka asalka ah. Haddii kooxaha run-ka ay yihiin $P$, $Q$, marka $p\to q$ run tahay, $P\subset Q$.
Marka hore $P$ ku muuji kala-duwanaansho, $Q$-na ka hel xallinta $|{cx}|\le a$ oo ku muuji $a$. Hel kala-duwanaanshaha $a$ ee ka dhigaya lid-bixinta $P\subset Q$ iyo lidka $Q\subset P$ mid walba.
cm2_truthRange.explanation: $P=\{x\mid {m}\le x\le {n}\}$ oo $|{cx}|\le a$ waa $-a\le {cx}\le a$. Lid-bixintu waxay run-been ahaan la mid tahay hadalka asalka ah, sidaa darteed waa inuu noqdaa $P\subset Q$; labada dhammaad ee $P$ $x={m}$, $x={n}$ waxaa ku yaal qiimayaasha ${cx}$ ${u}$, ${w}$, sidaa darteed $a\ge {d1}$, $a\ge {d2}$. Sidaa darteed $\alpha={al}$. Lidku waa inuu noqdaa $Q\subset P$, $Q$-na waa ${lowS}\le {kx}\le {highS}$, sidaa darteed ${lowS}\ge {km}$, ${highS}\le {kn}$, taas oo ah $a\le {d1}$, $a\le {d2}$. Sidaa darteed $\beta={be}$ iyo $\alpha\beta={al}\times{be}={ans}$.

cm2_vennReverse.prompt: Laba qayb oo ka mid ah kooxda guud $U$, $A$, $B$, marka $n(U)={nu}$, $n(A)={na}$, $n(B)={nb}$, $n((A\cup B)^c)={nc}$, waa maxay qiimaha $n(A^c\cup B)$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka hore hel tirada xubnaha isku-darka $n(A\cup B)=n(U)-n((A\cup B)^c)$.
Isticmaal $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$, sidaa darteed $n(A^c\cup B)=n(U)-n(A-B)$.
cm2_vennReverse.explanation: $n(A\cup B)={nu}-{nc}={un}$ iyo $n(A\cap B)=n(A)+n(B)-n(A\cup B)={na}+{nb}-{un}={ab}$. $A^c\cup B=(A-B)^c$ oo $n(A-B)={na}-{ab}$, sidaa darteed $n(A^c\cup B)={nu}-({na}-{ab})={ans}$.

cul_bordaMax.prompt: Waa doorasho Borda oo laga dooranayo hal musharax oo ka mid ah A, B, C. Booska 1aad waxaa la siiyaa $2$ dhibcood, booska 2aad $1$ dhibic, booska 3aad $0$ dhibic. Marka liiska kala-horreynta '{b1}' uu leeyahay ${n1}$ qof, '{b2}' ${n2}$ qof, '{b3}' ${n3}$ qof, waa maxay wadarta dhibcaha ugu sarreysa ee saddexda musharax? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Raadi booska musharax kasta ee liis kasta, kaddib go'aami dhibcaha.
Hel wadarta dhibcaha saddexda musharax dhammaantood, kaddib dooro tan ugu weyn.
cul_bordaMax.explanation: Wadarta dhibcaha A waa ${eA}$ dhibcood, B waa ${eB}$ dhibcood, C-na waa ${eC}$ dhibcood. Wadarta dhibcaha ugu sarreysa waa ${ans}$ dhibcood.

cul_bordaTotal.prompt: Waa doorasho Borda oo laga dooranayo hal musharax oo ka mid ah A, B, C. Booska 1aad waxaa la siiyaa $2$ dhibcood, booska 2aad $1$ dhibic, booska 3aad $0$ dhibic. Marka liiska kala-horreynta 'A>B>C' uu leeyahay ${n1}$ qof, 'B>C>A' ${n2}$ qof, 'C>A>B' ${n3}$ qof, waa maxay wadarta dhibcaha musharax A? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka hore raadi booska A ee liis kasta.
Isku dar (tirada dadka)×(dhibcaha booska) dhammaantood.
cul_bordaTotal.explanation: A waa booska 1aad (2 dhibcood) liiska koowaad, booska 3aad (0 dhibcood) kan labaad, booska 2aad (1 dhibic) kan saddexaad, sidaa darteed ${n1}\times2+{n2}\times0+{n3}\times1={ans}$ dhibcood.

cul_brailleAtMost.prompt: Hal unug oo Braille ah wuxuu leeyahay ${d}$ meelood oo dhibco la geli karo, meel kastana waa kor u kacsan tahay ama ma kacsana. Waa immisa qaab oo kala duwan oo hal unug ah oo leh ugu yaraan 1 dhibic oo kacsan iyo ugu badnaan ${k}$ dhibcood oo kacsan? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Tirada qaabab leh sax ahaan $j$ dhibcood oo kacsan waa tirada habab ee loo dooran karo $j$ meelood ${d}$ meelood ka mid ah.
Mid walba u xisaabi $j=1$ ilaa $j={k}$ kaddib isku dar.
cul_brailleAtMost.explanation: Qaabab leh $j$ dhibcood oo kacsan waa $_{{d}}\mathrm{C}_{j}$ habab, sidaa darteed ${terms}={ans}$ habab.

cul_pitchFifth.prompt: Frequency-ga codka aasaasiga ahi waa ${f}$ Hz. Codka lagu kor qaaday octave ${k}$, codka ka sarreeya perfect fifth (frequency ratio $3:2$) frequency-gisu waa immisa Hz? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Codka octave ka sarreeya frequency-gisu wuxuu noqdaa laba jeer.
Perfect fifth ka sarreeya, frequency-ga ku dhufo $\frac{3}{2}$.
cul_pitchFifth.explanation: Octave ${k}$ ka sarreeya: ${f}\times 2^{{k}}={mid}$ Hz, perfect fifth ka sarreeya: ${mid}\times\frac{3}{2}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_stringLength.prompt: Dhuumaha qalabka xargaha, marka xargaha gaabto frequency-gu wuu kordhaa, haddii dhumucda iyo adkaantiisu isku mid yihiin frequency-gu wuxuu la socdaa dhererka xarigga si bedel ah (inversely proportional). Haddii xarig dhererkiisu yahay ${L}$ cm uu soo saaro cod ${f}$ Hz ah, marka isla xarigga la riixo si qaybta gariirta loo gaabiyo ilaa ${L2}$ cm, frequency-ga codka soo baxaya waa immisa Hz? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Qiimaha (frequency)×(dherer) isma beddelo.
Ku qaybi qiimaha ${f}\times{L}$ dhererka cusub ${L2}$ cm.
cul_stringLength.explanation: Maadaama (frequency)×(dherer) joogto yahay, ${f}\times{L}=x\times{L2}$. Sidaa darteed $x=\frac{{f}\times{L}}{{L2}}={ans}$ Hz.

cul_voteGuarantee.prompt: Musharraxiinta A, B, C waxay ku tartamayaan codbixin ay ku guuleysato kan codka ugu badan helay. Natiijada dhexe ee tirinta waa A ${a}$ cod, B ${b}$, C ${c}$, waxaana ka harsan ${m}$ cod oo aan wali la tirin. Si C u noqdo kan kaliya ee ugu horreeya inkasta oo codadka haray loo kala qaybiyo A iyo B si kasta, C waa inuu ugu yaraan helaa immisa cod ee ${m}$ cod ee haray? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Haddii C uu helo $x$ cod ee haray, ${m}$−$x$ codka harayna waxay u tagaan musharraxiinta kale. Xaaladda ugu xun waa in dhammaantood u tagaan musharraxa hadda hoggaaminaya.
Codadka C waa inay ka badnaadaan (ma aha isle'eg) kuwa musharraxa hoggaaminaya. Samee inequality oo hel integer-ka ugu yar $x$.
cul_voteGuarantee.explanation: Codka ugu badan hadda waa ${M}$. Haddii C uu helo $x$ cod ee haray, ${m}-x$ codka harayna dhammaantood u tago musharraxa leh ${M}$, waa inay ${c}+x>{M}+({m}-x)$. Habaynta waxay bixisaa $x>{half}$, sidaa darteed integer-ka ugu yar waa ${ans}$.

econ_annuityPV.prompt: Waxaa jira pension laga helo ${A}$ won dhammaadka sanad kasta muddo ${n}$ sano ah (bixinta ugu horreysa hal sano ka dib, tan ugu dambaysa ${n}$ sano ka dib). Haddii heerka dulsaarka sannadlaha ahi yahay ${r}$% oo lagu xisaabiyo compound sanad kasta, present value-ga pension-kan waa immisa won? (Wixii ka hooseeya won waa la tuuraa. Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Bixin kasta u beddel qiimaha hadda iyadoo la tixgelinayo waqtiga bixinta, kadibna dhammaan isku dar.
Haddii heerka dulsaarku yahay $i=\frac{{r}}{100}$, present value waa $A\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}$.
econ_annuityPV.explanation: $i={r}/100$, sidaa darteed present value waa ${A}\times\frac{1-(1+i)^{-{n}}}{i}\approx{ex}$ won, marka wixii ka hooseeya won la tuuro waa ${ans}$ won.

econ_compoundFV.prompt: Waxaa kaydka compound interest ee heerka sannadlaha ahi yahay ${r}$%, dulsaarka mar kasta oo la geliyo aasaaska ${m}$ jeer sanadkii, ${P}$ won ayaa la dhigay muddo ${n}$ sano ah. Heerka dulsaarka xisaab kasta waa (heerka sannadlaha)$\div{m}$, lacagna dhexda lagama qaado. Wadarka dhammaan ${n}$ sano ka dib waa immisa won? (Wixii ka hooseeya won waa la tuuraa. Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Tirada xisaabinta dulsaarka waa (tirada sanadkii)×(sannadaha).
Isticmaal heerka dulsaarka xisaab kasta ${rp}$%: wadarku waa aasaaska oo lagu dhufto $(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})$ oo la isku dhufto tirada xisaabinta.
econ_compoundFV.explanation: Tirada xisaabinta waa ${m}\times{n}={k}$, heerka xisaab kasta waa ${rp}$%, sidaa darteed wadarku waa ${P}\times(1+\frac{{rp}}{100})^{{k}}\approx{ex}$ won, marka wixii ka hooseeya won la tuuro waa ${ans}$ won.

econ_elasticityPoint.prompt: Demand function-ku waa $q={D}$ ($p$ waa qiimaha, $q$ waa tirada la rabo). Marka qiimuhu yahay $p={p0}$, qiimaha price elasticity of demand $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$ waa maxay? (Ku qor jajab aan la soo koobi karin. Haddii ay tahay lambar dhan, ku qor lambar dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore hel $q'(p)$ kadibna qiimaha $p={p0}$.
Sidoo kale hel tirada la rabo $q$ marka $p={p0}$ oo geli formula-ka $e$.
econ_elasticityPoint.explanation: Qiimaha $q'(p)$ marka $p={p0}$ waa ${dqv}$, tirada la rabo waa $q={qv}$, sidaa darteed $e=\frac{{adq}\times{p0}}{{qv}}={fr}$.

econ_elasticityUnit.prompt: Shaqada rabitaanka $q={D}$ ku jirta, waa maxay qiimaha $p$ marka jilicsanaanta qiimaha $e=\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|$ ay noqoto 1? (Ka fikir xadka $p>0$ iyo qadarka rabitaanka $q>0$.) (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Marka aad hesho $q'(p)$, u qor $\left|q'(p)\times\frac{p}{q}\right|=1$ sidii isle'eg ku saabsan $p$.
Marka $q>0$, $q'(p)<0$, sidaa darteed marka qiimaha buuxa laga saaro waa $-q'(p)\times p=q$.
econ_elasticityUnit.explanation: $q'(p)={dq}$, sidaa darteed $-q'(p)\times p=q$ waxay noqotaa ${eqn}$, xalka $p>0$ waa $p={ans}$.

econ_equilibriumTable.prompt: Qadarka rabitaanka badeecad waa ${qd1}$ halkii qiimaha uu yahay ${p1}$ won, iyo ${qd2}$ marka uu yahay ${p2}$ won; qadarka bixintuna waa ${qs1}$ marka qiimaha uu yahay ${p3}$ won, iyo ${qs2}$ marka uu yahay ${p4}$ won. Haddii qadarka rabitaanka iyo qadarka bixintu ay labaduba yihiin shaqooyin toosan oo qiimaha ah, waa imisa won qiimaha isu-dheelitirka marka rabitaanku iyo bixintu isle'egyihiin? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Isticmaal dhaadhaca xariiqda mara labada barood si aad u hesho sida qadarka rabitaanka iyo bixintu ugu beddelmaan qiimaha.
U yaal qadarka rabitaanka $Q_d$ iyo qadarka bixinta $Q_s$, kadibna hel qiimaha uu $Q_d=Q_s$ yahay.
econ_equilibriumTable.explanation: Heerka beddelka rabitaanku waa $\frac{{qd2}-{qd1}}{{p2}-{p1}}={md}$, sidaa darteed $Q_d={qd1}{md}(p-{p1})$; heerka beddelka bixintu waa ${ns}$, sidaa darteed $Q_s={qs1}+{ns}(p-{p3})$. Xallinta $Q_d=Q_s$ waxay siinaysaa $p={ans}$ won.

econ_exchangeCross.prompt: Sarifka lacagtu waa 1 doolar $={d}$ won, 1 yuuro $={e}$ won. Haddii ${n}$ yuuro loo beddelo doolar iyadoo aan wax kharash ah la bixin, waa imisa doolar? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Marka hore ka hel imisa won ay tahay ${n}$ yuuro.
Qadarkaas won ku qaybi qiimaha 1 doolar ${d}$ won.

econ_inverseEntry.prompt: Waa maxay unugga $({i}, {j})$ ee matrikska rogan $A^{-1}$ ee matrikska $A={M}$? (Unugga $(i, j)$ waa unugga safka $i$ iyo tiirka $j$.) (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Go'aamiyaha matrikska ${G}$ waa $ad-bc$. Haddii aanu eber ahayn, matrikska rogan wuu jiraa.
Matrikska rogan waa ${H}$.
econ_inverseEntry.explanation: Go'aamiyuhu waa ${ap}\times{dp}-{bp}\times{cp}={det}$, unugga $({i}, {j})$ ee $A^{-1}$ waa $\frac{{num}}{{det}}$, taasoo ah ${fr}$.

econ_leontief.prompt: Matrikska isku-xidhka gelinta ee labada warshadood 1 iyo 2 waa $A={M}$ (unugga $(i, j)$ ee $A$ waa qadarka wax-soo-saarka warshadda $i$ ee loo baahan yahay marka warshadda $j$ ay soo saarto 1 unug). Haddii wax-soo-saarka guud ee labada warshadood loo yaqaan $x_1$, $x_2$ (unug: boqol milyan won), rabitaanka ugu dambeeyana yahay $d_1={d1}$, $d_2={d2}$, markaas ${XV}=A{XV}+{DV}$ waa run. Waa imisa $x_1$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Isle'egga u beddel $(I-A){XV}={DV}$.
Hel matrikska rogan ee $I-A$ oo ku dhufo ${DV}$. Matrikska rogan ee $2\times2$ waa $\frac{1}{ad-bc}$ oo lagu dhuftay matrikska unugyadiisa dib loo habeeyey.
econ_leontief.explanation: $(I-A)\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{d}$, sidaa darteed $\mathbf{x}=(I-A)^{-1}\mathbf{d}$. Go'aamiyaha $I-A$ waa ${D}$, sidaa darteed $x_1=\frac{{c22}\times{d1}+{a12}\times{d2}}{{D}}={ans}$.

econ_marginalRevenue.prompt: Qalooca rabitaanka badeecad waa $p={a}-{b}q$ ($p$ waa qiimaha (won), $q$ waa qadarka la iibiyey (xabbo)). Dakhliga guud waa $R(q)=pq$, dakhliga dheeraadka ahna waa $R'(q)$, derivative-ka $R(q)$ ee ku saabsan $q$. Waa imisa xabbo qadarka iibka $q$ marka dakhliga dheeraadku yahay ${m}$ won? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Ku beddel $p={a}-{b}q$ gudaha $R(q)=pq$ si $R(q)$ loogu muujiyo $q$.
Hel $q$ marka qiimaha derivative-ka $R(q)$ uu yahay ${m}$ won.

econ_presentValue.prompt: Dulsaarka sannadlaha ah waa ${r}$% oo sannad kasta lagu xisaabiyo dulsaar isku-dhafan. Waa imisa won qiimaha hadda ee ${F}$ won oo la heli doono ${n}$ sannadood ka dib? (Wixii ka hooseeya won waa la tuuraa. Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Qiimaha hadda $P$ waa qiimaha marka $P$ lagu kordhiyo dulsaar isku-dhafan ${n}$ sannadood uu noqdo ${F}$ won.
Xisaabi $P=F\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}$.
econ_presentValue.explanation: $P={F}\div(1+\frac{{r}}{100})^{{n}}\approx{ex}$ won, marka wixii ka hooseeya won la tuuro waa ${ans}$ won.

econ_profitCubic.prompt: Kharashka guud ee soo saarista $q$ badeecad waa $C(q)=q^3-{b}q^2+{c}q+{f}$ (won), qiimaha iibkuna waa ${p}$ won oo joogto ah halkii badeecad. Haddii dhammaan badeecadaha la soo saaray la iibiyo, waa imisa won faa'iidada ugu badan (dakhliga guud ka jar kharashka guud)? ($q$ waa tiro dhab ah oo 0 ama ka weyn.) (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Faa'iidadu waa $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$. Kala-duwan oo hel $q$ ee $\pi'(q)=0$.
Xididka togan ee $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=0$, calaamadda $\pi'(q)$ waxay ka beddelmaysaa + una beddelmaysaa -.
econ_profitCubic.explanation: Maadaama $\pi(q)={p}q-C(q)$, $\pi'(q)=-3q^2+{twob}q+{pc}=-3(q-{q0})(q+{s})$. Marka $q\ge0$, $\pi'$ waa togan ka hor $q={q0}$ taban-na wixii ka dambeeya, sidaa darteed ugu badnaanta waa $q={q0}$, $\pi({q0})={ans}$ won.

econ_regionLP.prompt: Warshad ayaa soo saarta $x$ badeecad A iyo $y$ badeecad B ($x$, $y$ waa tirooyin dhan oo 0 ama ka weyn). Badeecad A kasta waxay u baahan tahay ${a1}$ kg alaab ah iyo ${t1}$ saac shaqo, badeecad B-na ${b1}$ kg iyo ${t2}$ saac. Alaabta maalintii la isticmaali karo waa ${M}$ kg ama ka yar, isugeynta saacadaha shaqada ee dhammaan shaqaalaha waa ${T}$ saac ama ka yar, faa'iidadu waa ${pa}$ (10,000 won) badeecad A kasta iyo ${pb}$ (10,000 won) badeecad B kasta. Waa imisa 10,000 won faa'iidada ugu badan maalintii? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: U qor shuruudaha sinnaan-la'aan ahaan, kadibna iyada iyo $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$ ku muuji aag ahaan dhidibka isku-xidhka.
Faa'iidada ${pa}x+{pb}y$ waxay ugu badan tahay mid ka mid ah geesaha aagga. Marka hore hubi isgoyska labada xariiq ee xadka.
econ_regionLP.explanation: Sinnaan-la'aantu waa ${a1}x+{b1}y\le{M}$, ${t1}x+{t2}y\le{T}$, $x\ge0$, $y\ge0$. Geeska faa'iidada ugu badan leh waa isgoyska labada xariiq $({x0}, {y0})$, oo ah meel tiro dhan ah, sidaa darteed faa'iidada ugu badan waa ${pa}\times{x0}+{pb}\times{y0}={ans}$ (10,000 won).

econ_taxBracket.prompt: Canshuurta dakhliga wadan gaar ah waxay u qaybisaa dakhliga canshuur-bixinta qaybo, qayb walbana waxay leedahay heer canshuur ka duwan. Qaybta ${b1}$ (10,000 won) ama ka yar waxaa lagu dabaqaa ${r1}$%, qaybta ka badan ${b1}$ ilaa ${b2}$ (10,000 won) waxaa lagu dabaqaa ${r2}$%, qaybta ka badan ${b2}$ (10,000 won) waxaa lagu dabaqaa ${r3}$%. Marka dakhliga canshuur-bixintu yahay ${x1}$ (10,000 won), waa imisa canshuurta la bixinayo (10,000 won)? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Heerka canshuurta waxaa lagu dabaqaa kaliya qadarka ku jira qaybtaas. Marka hore hel qadarka qayb kasta ku jira.
Isku dar (qadarka qayb kasta)×(heerka canshuurta).
econ_taxBracket.explanation: Qadarka qayb kasta waa ${s1}$, ${s2}$, ${s3}$ (10,000 won), sidaa darteed canshuurtu waa ${s1}\times\frac{{r1}}{100}+{s2}\times\frac{{r2}}{100}+{s3}\times\frac{{r3}}{100}={ans}$ (10,000 won).

econ_taxEquilibrium.prompt: Qalooca dalabka badeecad waa $p={a}-{b}q$, qalooca bixinta-na waa $p={c}+{d}q$. Halkan $p$ waa qiimaha (won), $q$ waa tirada (badeecad). Haddii dawladdu ku soo rogto bixiyaha ${t}$ won canshuur badeecad kasta oo uu iibiyo, bixiyuhu wuxuu helaa qiimaha macmiilku bixiyay ka jar canshuurta. Marka lagu jiro isu-dheelitirka kadib canshuurta, waa imisa won qiimaha macmiilku bixinayo? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Qiimaha uu bixiyuhu runtii helo waa $p-{t}$.
Meesha $p$ ee qalooca bixinta ku beddel $p-{t}$, kadibna ku beddel qalooca dalabka $p={a}-{b}q$ si aad u hesho $q$.
econ_taxEquilibrium.explanation: Qiimaha uu bixiyuhu helo waa $p-{t}$, sidaa darteed $({a}-{b}q)-{t}={c}+{d}q$. Marka la xalliyo $q={qn}$, qiimaha macmiilku bixinayo waa $p={a}-{b}\times{qn}={ans}$ won.

econ_utilityBundle.prompt: Alaabta x hal-hal waxay ku kacaysaa ${a}$ won, alaabta y hal-hal-na ${b}$ won. Miisaaniyadda ${I}$ won oo dhan oo aan wax ka hadhin waxaad rabtaa inaad ku iibsato $x$ xabbo oo x ah iyo $y$ xabbo oo y ah ($x$, $y$ waa tirooyin dhammaystiran oo ka weyn ama le'eg 0). Haddii faa'iidada la siiyey ay tahay $U={U}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee faa'iidada $U$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Hel dhammaan tirooyinka dhammaystiran $(x, y)$ ee ka weyn ama le'eg 0 ee buuxiya isla'egta miisaaniyadda ${a}x+{b}y={I}$.
$(x, y)$ kasta oo la helay u xisaabi qiimaha $U$ kaddib barbar dhig.
econ_utilityBundle.explanation: $(x, y)$ ee buuxiya isla'egta miisaaniyadda waa ${pairs}$. Intaas ka mid ah, lammaanaha leh qiimaha $U$ ugu weyn waa $(x, y)=({bx}, {by})$ (haddii dhowr lammaane ay qiimaha ugu weyn leeyihiin, hal ka mid ah), kaddib $U={ans}$.

geo_conicGeneral.prompt: Bar-dhexaadyada qalooca labaad-darajada ${eq}$ ka mid ah, midka isku-duwaha $x$ uu ugu weyn yahay (haddii bar-dhexaad keliya jiro, barta kaas) haddii ay tahay $(a,\ b)$, waa maxay qiimaha $a+b$? (Qor tiro dhammaystiran. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Ku beddel $x$ iyo $y$ mid walba qaab labajibbaar dhamaystiran si aad u hesho qaabka caadiga ah.
Qaabka caadiga ah ka akhri bartamaha (ama kor-geeska), kaddib u dhaqaaq $c$ (barakaha $p$) jihada bar-dhexaadyadu ku yaalliin si aad u hesho bar-dhexaadka.
geo_conicGeneral.explanation: Marka loo beddelo labajibbaar dhamaystiran waa ${std}$. Bar-dhexaadyadu waa ${foc}$, sidaa darteed $a+b={ans}$.

geo_conicParam.prompt: Fogaanta ka dhexeysa labada bar-dhexaad ee qalooca ${eq}$ waa ${fd}$ iyo ${cond}$, waa maxay qiimaha $k$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Haddii fogaanta ka dhexeysa labada bar-dhexaad ay tahay $2c$, marka hore waxaad heli kartaa qiimaha $c$. Sidoo kale go'aami hooseeyaha ay tahay $a^2$.
Ellipse-ka, $c^2=a^2-b^2$; hyperbola-da, $c^2=a^2+b^2$. Isla'egtan ka hel $k$.
geo_conicParam.explanation: Maadaama fogaanta ka dhexeysa labada bar-dhexaad ay tahay $2c={fd}$, $c={c}$, $c^2={c2}$. ${work}$, sidaa darteed $k={ans}$.

geo_conicTangentLine.prompt: Xariiqda ${ln}$ ee taabata qalooca ${eq}$, waa maxay qiimaha togan ee $k$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Isla'egta xariiqda ku geli isla'egta qalooca si aad u hesho isla'eg labaad-darajo oo ku saabsan $x$; haddii ay taabato, kala-soocaha waa $0$.
Kala-soocaha $D=0$ ka hel isla'eg ku saabsan $k$.
geo_conicTangentLine.explanation: Marka isla'egta xariiqda lagu geliyo isla'egta qalooca si loo helo isla'eg labaad-darajo oo ku saabsan $x$, waa ${quad}$, maadaama ay taabanayso, kala-soocaha $D=0$. ${work}$, sidaa darteed qiimaha togan ee $k$ waa ${ans}$.

geo_divPoint.prompt: Meel bannaan isku-duwaha leh, labada bar $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$, barta P waxay ku taal qaybta AB, $AP:PB={m}:{n}$. Waa maxay wadarta saddexda isku-duwaha ee barta P? (Qor tiro dhammaystiran. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Isku-duwaha barta qaybisa AB saamiga $m:n$ waa $\left(\frac{mx_2+nx_1}{m+n},\ \frac{my_2+ny_1}{m+n},\ \frac{mz_2+nz_1}{m+n}\right)$.
Isku-duwaha mid walba si gooni ah u xisaabi.
geo_divPoint.explanation: $P=\left(\frac{{n}\,x_A+{m}\,x_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,y_A+{m}\,y_B}{{mn}},\ \frac{{n}\,z_A+{m}\,z_B}{{mn}}\right)={pp}$, sidaa darteed wadarta saddexda isku-duwaha waa ${ans}$.

geo_divRatioPlane.prompt: Meel bannaan isku-duwaha leh, labada bar $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$, ha ahaato P barta ay qaybta AB ku kulanto sagxadda ${pl}$. Haddii $AP:PB=m:n$ ($m$, $n$ waa tirooyin dabiici ah oo isku-mid ah oo aan wadaagin qodob), waa maxay qiimaha $m+n$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Barta ku taal sagxadda ${pl}$ waxay leedahay hal isku-duwaha oo ah $0$.
Isku-duwahaas ee barta qaybisa AB saamiga $s:t$ ku muuji $s$, $t$ oo ka dhig $0$.
geo_divRatioPlane.explanation: Haddii $AP:PB=s:t$, isku-duwaha u dhigma ee barta P waa inuu noqdaa $\frac{t\cdot({za})+s\cdot({zb})}{s+t}=0$, sidaa darteed $s:t=|{za}|:|{zb}|={ua}:{ub}$. Marka loo gaabiyo tirooyin aan wadaagin qodob waa ${m}:{n}$, sidaa darteed $m+n={ans}$.

geo_dotAngle.prompt: Haddii cabbirka xagalka ay samaynayaan labada vektar $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ uu yahay $\theta$ ($0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$), waa maxay qiimaha $\theta$? (Qor lambarka darajooyinka oo keliya.)
hints: Kosayn-ka xagalka u dhexeeya labada vektar waa $\cos\theta=\frac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a||\vec b|}$.
Hel isku-dhufashada dhibcaha iyo cabbirka labada vektar mid mid.
geo_dotAngle.explanation: $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, $|\vec a||\vec b|=\sqrt{{na2}}\sqrt{{nb2}}=\sqrt{{pr}}={rt}$, sidaa darteed $\cos\theta=\frac{{dt}}{{rt}}={cs}$. Marka $0^\circ\le\theta\le180^\circ$, $\theta={ans}^\circ$.

geo_dotNormExpand.prompt: Marka labada vektar $\vec a$, $\vec b$ ay leeyihiin $|\vec a|={na}$, $|\vec b|={nb}$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dt}$, waa maxay qiimaha $|{ex}|^2$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Maadaama $|\vec x|^2=\vec x\cdot\vec x$, ku fidi ${ex}$ adigoo isku-dhufasho dhibco ah la samaynaya naftiisa.
U muuji $|\vec a|^2$, $|\vec b|^2$, $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ oo qiimayaasha ku beddel.

geo_ellipseExtSum.prompt: Aan u qaadno in barta xudunta ee labada xudun ee ellipse-ka ${eq}$ ay tahay $F({fx},\ {fy})$, barta ku jirta gudaha ellipse-ka na ay tahay $A({xa},\ {ya})$. Marka barta P ee ku taal ellipse-ka ay dhaqaaqdo, waa maxay isku-dhufashada qiimaha ugu weyn iyo ugu yar ee $PA+PF$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Haddii xudunta kale loo bixiyo F', $PF=2a-PF'$. Markaas $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$.
Marka loo eego sinnaan-la'aanta saddex-geeska, $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, maadaama A ay ku jirto gudaha ellipse-ka, labada sinnaan waa suurtagal.
geo_ellipseExtSum.explanation: Haddii xudunta kale loo bixiyo F', $PA+PF=2a+(PA-PF')$, $a={a}$, $AF'={dd}$. Maadaama $-AF'\le PA-PF'\le AF'$, qiimaha ugu weyn waa $2a+AF'={mx}$, ugu yar waa $2a-AF'={mn}$, isku-dhufashadooduna waa ${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFocal.prompt: Aan u qaadno in labada xudun ee ellipse-ka ${eq}$ ay yihiin F iyo F'. Marka barta P ee ku taal ellipse-ka ay tahay ${cond}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${ask}$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Wadarta masaafada barta ku taal ellipse-ka ilaa labada xudun waa joogto, qiimaheeduna waa dhererka dhidibka weyn.
Haddii dhererka dhidibka weyn uu yahay $2a$ iyo masaafada u dhexeysa labada xudun $2c$, $a={a}$, $c={c}$. Isticmaal $PF+PF'=2a$.
geo_ellipseFocal.explanation: Dhererka dhidibka weyn waa $2a={tw}$, masaafada u dhexeysa labada xudun waa $2c={tc}$, sidaa darteed $PF+PF'={tw}$, $FF'={tc}$. ${work}$ awgeed, qiimaha la doonayo waa ${ans}$.

geo_ellipseFromEq.prompt: Waa maxay masaafada u dhexeysa labada xudun ee ellipse-ka ${eq}$? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Marka isla'egta ellipse-ka loo beddelo qaabka $\frac{x^2}{\square}+\frac{y^2}{\square}=1$ oo dhinaca midig yahay $1$, hooseeyaha weyn ee labada waa $a^2$.
Labada hooseeye waa ${a2}$ iyo ${b2}$, $c^2=a^2-b^2$.
geo_ellipseFromEq.explanation: Marka loo muujiyo qaabka ${std}$, $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, sidaa darteed $c^2=a^2-b^2={c2}$, $c={c}$. Masaafada u dhexeysa labada xudun waa $2c={ans}$.

geo_ellipseRightTri.prompt: Aan u qaadno in labada xudun ee ellipse-ka ${eq}$ ay yihiin F iyo F'. Marka barta P ee ku taal ellipse-ka ay buuxiso $\angle FPF'=90^\circ$, waa maxay aagga saddex-geeska PFF'? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Qeexitaanka ellipse-ka waa $PF+PF'=2a$, maadaama uu yahay saddex-geeska xagal qumman, $PF^2+PF'^2=(FF')^2$.
Isticmaal $(PF+PF')^2=PF^2+PF'^2+2\,PF\cdot PF'$ si aad u hesho $PF\cdot PF'$.
geo_ellipseRightTri.explanation: $a^2={a2}$, $b^2={b2}$, $c^2={c2}$, sidaa darteed $PF+PF'=2a={tw}$, $FF'=2c={tc}$. $PF^2+PF'^2={tc2}$, sidaa darteed $2\,PF\cdot PF'=({tw})^2-{tc2}$, taasoo ah $PF\cdot PF'={pr}$. Aagga waa $\frac{1}{2}\times PF\times PF'={ans}$.

geo_hyperAsym.prompt: Labada xariiq ee ku dhow hyperbolada ${eq}$, waa maxay jiidashada xariiqda jiidashadeedu tahay togan? (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Xariiqaha ku dhow hyperbolada $\frac{x^2}{a^2}-\frac{y^2}{b^2}=1$ waa $y=\pm\frac{b}{a}x$, kuwa $\frac{y^2}{a^2}-\frac{x^2}{b^2}=1$ waa $y=\pm\frac{a}{b}x$.
Haddii dhinaca midig ee isla'egtu aanay ahayn $1$, marka hore ka dhig $1$, kaddib ka akhri $a^2$, $b^2$ hooseeyayaasha $x^2$, $y^2$.
geo_hyperAsym.explanation: Maadaama ay tahay qaabka ${std}$, xariiqaha ku dhow waa ${asy}$. Jiidashada xariiqda ku dhow ee jiidashadeedu tahay togan waa ${ansf}$.

geo_hyperFocal.prompt: Ha ahaato F, F' labada bar-dhexaad ee hyperbolada ${eq}$. Marka barta P ee hyperbolada ku taal ay tahay ${cond}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${ask}$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Faraqa-qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee fogaanta barta hyperbolada ku taal ilaa labada bar-dhexaad waxay la mid tahay dhererka dhidibka weyn $2a$.
Maadaama $a={a}$, $c={c}$, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, fogaanta barta hyperbolada ku taal ilaa bar-dhexaad kastana waa ugu yaraan $c-a={ca}$.
geo_hyperFocal.explanation: $a={a}$, $b={b}$, $c={c}$ iyo $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$. Marka ${work}$, P waxay ku taal laanta u dhow F, $PF'>PF$. (Haddii $PF'=PF-2a$, ${alt}$ ayaa ka yar $c-a$, taasoo suurtagal ah maaha.) Sidaa darteed ${work2}$, qiimaha la doonayaa waa ${ans}$.

geo_hyperFocalRel.prompt: Ha ahaato F, F' labada bar-dhexaad ee hyperbolada ${eq}$. Marka barta P ee hyperbolada ku taal ay tahay ${cond}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${ask}$ ? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Faraqa-qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee fogaanta barta hyperbolada ku taal ilaa labada bar-dhexaad waxay la mid tahay dhererka dhidibka weyn $2a$.
Maadaama $a={a}$, $c={c}$, $|PF-PF'|=2a={tw}$, fogaanta barta hyperbolada ku taal ilaa bar-dhexaad kastana waa ugu yaraan $c-a={ca}$.

geo_lineIntersectParam.prompt: Meel bannaan, haddii labada xariiq ${l1}$, ${l2}$ ay hal bar ku kulmaan, waa maxay qiimaha joogtada $k$ ? (Qor tiro dhammaystiran. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Qiimaha wadaagga ah ee xariiq kasta ku tiri $s$, $t$, kaddib isku-duwaha barta xariiqda ku taal ku muuji $s$, $t$.
Isla'egta ah in isku-duwaha $x$, $y$ isle'eg yihiin ka hel $s$, $t$, kaddib barbar dhig isku-duwaha $z$.
geo_lineIntersectParam.explanation: Haddii qiimaha wadaagga ah ee xariiqda koowaad yahay $s$, kan labaad-na $t$, isku-duwaha $x$, $y$ waa inay isle'eg yihiin, sidaa darteed ${xy}$, marka la xaliyo $s={ss}$, $t={tt}$. Isku-duwaha $z$ sidoo kale waa inuu isle'eg yahay, sidaa darteed ${eq3}$ iyo $k={ans}$.

geo_lineSpacePoint.prompt: Barooyinka ku yaal xariiqda ${ln}$ dhexdeeda, waxaa jira bar leh ${cond}$. Waa maxay wadarta labada isku-duwaha kale ee barta? (Qor tiro dhammaystiran. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Haddii qiimaha wadaagga ah ee saddexda jajab yahay $s$, $x$, $y$, $z$ dhammaantood waxaa lagu muujin karaa $s$.
Marka hore hel $s$ adigoo isticmaalaya shuruudda la bixiyey ${cond}$.
geo_lineSpacePoint.explanation: Haddii qiimaha wadaagga ahi yahay $s$, $(x,\ y,\ z)=({par})$. Shuruudda ${cond}$ waxay siinaysaa $s={ss}$, sidaa darteed barta waa ${pt}$, wadarta labada isku-duwaha kalena waa ${ans}$.

geo_parFocusDir.prompt: Barakaha bar-dhexaadkiisu yahay $F({fx},\ {fy})$ iyo toosinta ${dirEq}$, barta $P(x,\ y)$ ee barakaha ku taal, marka ${cond}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee ${un}$ ? (Qor tiro dhammaystiran. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Barta barakaha ku taal fogaanta ilaa bar-dhexaadka iyo ilaa toosinta waa isku mid.
Dhexda ka dhexeysa bar-dhexaadka iyo toosintu waa kor-geeska. Marka hore qor isla'egta barakaha ee kor-geeskiisu yahay $({vx},\ {vy})$ iyo $p={pp}$.
geo_parFocusDir.explanation: Kor-geesku waa $({vx},\ {vy})$, $p={pp}$, sidaa darteed isla'egta barakaha waa ${eqn}$. Marka ${cond}$, ${un}={sol}$, sidaa darteed qiimaha ugu weyn ee ${un}$ waa ${ans}$.

geo_parMinSum.prompt: Ha ahaato F bar-dhexaadka barakaha ${eq}$, barta A-na isku-duwaha waa $({xa},\ {ya})$. Marka barta P ee barakaha ku taal ay dhaqaaqdo, waa maxay qiimaha ugu yar ee $PA+PF$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Fogaanta $PF$ ee barta P ee barakaha ku taal ilaa bar-dhexaadka waxay la mid tahay fogaanta P ilaa toosinta.
Haddii cag-toosinta P ilaa toosinta ay tahay H, $PA+PH$ waa ugu yar marka A, P, H ay ku yaalliin hal xariiq.
geo_parMinSum.explanation: Toosintu waa ${dir}$. Barta A waxay ku jirtaa gudaha barakaha (${chk}$), sidaa darteed haddii cag-toosinta P ilaa toosinta ay tahay H, qiimaha ugu yar ee $PA+PF=PA+PH$ waa fogaanta A ilaa toosinta ${ans}$.

geo_planeNormal.prompt: Barta $A{pa}$, sagxadda ka gudubta A oo ku toosan vector-ka $\vec n=({vn})$ markay dhidibka ${ax}$ ku kulanto, waa maxay isku-duwaha ${ax}$ ee barta? (Waxaad ku qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: Haddii vector-ka goobta barta kasta ee sagxadda ku taal P uu yahay $\vec p$, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$.
Marka hore hel isla'egta sagxadda $ax+by+cz=d$, kaddib isticmaal in barta dhidibka ${ax}$ ku taal ay leedahay labada isku-duwaha kale $0$.
geo_planeNormal.explanation: Barta P ee sagxadda ku taal, $\vec n\cdot(\vec p-\vec a)=0$, sidaa darteed isla'egta sagxaddu waa ${plane}$. Barta dhidibka ${ax}$ ku taal labada isku-duwaha kale waa $0$, sidaa darteed ${solve}$ isku-duwaha ${ax}$ waa ${ans}$.

geo_projEllipse.prompt: Sagxadda $\alpha$ waxaa ku yaal goobaabin raadiyaheedu yahay ${rr}$. Marka goobaabintan loo muuqaal-rogo sagxadda $\beta$, waxay noqotaa ellipse. Haddii cabbirka xagalka ay sameeyaan sagxadaha $\alpha$, $\beta$ uu yahay $\theta$ oo $\cos\theta={cs}$, waa maxay fogaanta ka dhexeysa labada bar-dhexaad ee ellipse-kan? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Dhexroorka goobaabinta ee is-barbar socda xariiqda isu gudbinta labada sagxad dhererkiisu ma beddelmo, kan toosan-na wuxuu yaraadaa $\cos\theta$ jeer.
Hel dhererka dhidibka weyn $2a$ iyo dhidibka yar $2b$ ee ellipse-ka la muuqaal-rogay, kaddib xisaabi $c=\sqrt{a^2-b^2}$.
geo_projEllipse.explanation: Dhererka dhidibka weyn ee ellipse-ka waa $2a=2\times {rr}$, dhidibka yar waa $2b=2\times {rr}\cos\theta=2\times {bb}$, sidaa darteed $a={rr}$, $b={bb}$. $c=\sqrt{{rr}^2-{bb}^2}={cc}$, sidaa darteed fogaanta ka dhexeysa labada bar-dhexaad waa $2c={ans}$.

geo_projPlaneArea.prompt: Waa maxay cabbirka shaxanka cabbirkiisu yahay ${ar}$ ee ku yaal sagxadda ${pl}$ marka loo muuqaal-rogo sagxadda ${cp}$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Haddii xagalka ay sameeyaan sagxadda shaxanku ku yaal iyo sagxadda ${cp}$ uu yahay $\theta$, cabbirka muuqaal-rogidda waa (cabbirka shaxanka)$\times\cos\theta$.

Xagalka $\theta$ ee labada sagxad waxaa loo qaadaa $0^\circ\le\theta\le90^\circ$, sidaa darteed $\cos\theta=\frac{|\vec n_1\cdot\vec n_2|}{|\vec n_1||\vec n_2|}$ (qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee wax-dhaca labada vector ee caadiga ah oo lagu qaybiyey isku-dhufashada cabbirradooda).
geo_projPlaneArea.explanation: Vector-ka caadiga ah ee sagxadda ${pl}$ waa $({nv})$, cabbirkiisuna waa ${nn}$. Vector-ka caadiga ah ee sagxadda ${cp}$ waa $({cn})$, sidaa darteed $\cos\theta=\frac{|{ns}|}{{nn}}=\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}$, cabbirka muuqaal-rogiddu waa ${ar}\times\frac{{ni}}{{nn}}={ans}$.

geo_spaceDist.prompt: Meel bannaan isku-duwaha leh, waa maxay fogaanta labada bar $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Fogaanta labada bar ee meel bannaan $(x_1,\ y_1,\ z_1)$, $(x_2,\ y_2,\ z_2)$ waa $\sqrt{(x_2-x_1)^2+(y_2-y_1)^2+(z_2-z_1)^2}$.
Marka hore hel farqiga saddexda isku-duwaha.

geo_sphereExpand.prompt: Marka isle'egta ${eq}$ ay matalayso kubbad raadiyaha ah ${rad}$, waa maxay qiimaha joogtada $s$? (U qor tiro dhan. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Ku beddel $x$, $y$, $z$ mid kasta labajibbaar dhammaystiran si aad u hesho qaabka $(x-a)^2+(y-b)^2+(z-c)^2=r^2$.
Dhinaca midig waa inuu noqdaa $r^2={rad2}$.
geo_sphereExpand.explanation: Marka la sameeyo labajibbaarka dhammaystiran, waa ${std}$. Labajibbaarka raadiyahaku waa ${s4}-s={rad2}$, sidaa darteed $s={s4}-{rad2}={ans}$.

geo_sphereSection.prompt: Qaybta kubbadda ${eq}$ ee dhidibka ${pl}$ waa goobo. Haddii aagga goobadan yahay $m\pi$, waa maxay qiimaha tirada dabiiciga ah $m$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Ka akhri bartamaha kubbadda iyo labajibbaarka raadiyaha isle'egta.
Haddii la helo masaafada $d$ ee u dhexaysa bartamaha iyo dhidibka, raadiyaha qaybta $r$ wuxuu buuxiyaa $r^2=R^2-d^2$.
geo_sphereSection.explanation: Bartamaha kubbaddu waa ${cc}$, labajibbaarka raadiyahakuna waa $R^2={rr2}$. Masaafada ka socota bartamaha ilaa dhidibka ${pl}$ waa $d={dd}$, sidaa darteed labajibbaarka raadiyaha goobada qaybtu waa ${rr2}-{dd}^2={ans}$, aaggeeduna waa ${ans}\pi$.

geo_sphereTangentPlane.prompt: Marka loo eego kubbad bartamaheedu yahay $C{cc}$ oo raadiyahakeedu yahay ${rad}$, dhidibka ${pl}$ wuxuu taabanayaa kubbadda. Waa maxay qiimaha weyn ee joogtada $k$? (U qor tiro dhan. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Marka ay taabtaan, masaafada ka socota bartamaha kubbadda ilaa dhidibka waxay la mid tahay raadiyaha.
Masaafada u dhexaysa meesha $(x_0,\ y_0,\ z_0)$ iyo dhidibka $ax+by+cz=k$ waa $\frac{|ax_0+by_0+cz_0-k|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2+c^2}}$.
geo_sphereTangentPlane.explanation: Cabbirka vector-ka caadiga ah $({nv})$ waa ${nn}$, marka bartamaha lagu beddelo isle'egta dhidibka waa ${dc}$. Laga bilaabo masaafada $\frac{|{dc}-k|}{{nn}}={rad}$, $|{dc}-k|={rl}$, sidaa darteed $k={dc}\pm{rl}$, qiimaha weyn waa ${ans}$.

geo_tangentAt.prompt: Waa maxay aagga saddex-geeslaha ay ku ag wareegaan xariiqda taabanaysa qalooca ${eq}$ ee meesha $P({x0},\ {y0})$ iyo dhidibyada $x$ iyo $y$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Xariiqda taabanaysa qalooca ee meesha $(x_1,\ y_1)$ waxaa lagu helaa adigoo beddelaya $x^2\to x_1x$, $y^2\to y_1y$ (paraabolada, $y^2\to y_1y$, $x\to\frac{x+x_1}{2}$).
Isle'egta xariiqda taabanaysa ka hel gooynta $x$ iyo gooynta $y$, kadibna xisaabi $\frac{1}{2}\times|\text{gooynta }x|\times|\text{gooynta }y|$.
geo_tangentAt.explanation: Isle'egta xariiqda taabanaysa waa ${tan}$, gooynta $x$ waa ${xi}$, gooynta $y$-na waa ${yi}$. Sidaa darteed aagga waa $\frac{1}{2}\times|{xi}|\times|{yi}|={ansf}$.

geo_tangentsFromPoint.prompt: Waa maxay isku-dhufashada jiifnaanta labada xariiq ee taabanaya qalooca ${eq}$ ee laga soo jeediyay meesha $({x1},\ {y1})$? (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: U qaado jiifnaanta xariiqda taabanaysa $m$, kadibna ku beddel isle'egta qalooca xariiqda ${lnp}$ ee dhex marta meesha $({x1},\ {y1})$.
Shuruudda taabashada (kala-soocid $=0$) waxay siinaysaa isle'eg labajibbaaran oo $m$, jiifnaanta labada xariiq waa labadeeda xidid.
geo_tangentsFromPoint.explanation: Marka xariiqda ${lnp}$ lagu beddelo isle'egta qalooca, kala-soocidda isle'egta labajibbaaran ee $x$ waa inay noqotaa $0$, sidaa darteed jiifnaanta xariiqda taabanaysa $m$ waa labada xidid ee isle'egta labajibbaaran ${quad}=0$. Marka loo eego xidid-iyo-isku-dhufasho, isku-dhufashada jiifnaanta labada xariiq waa ${prod}$.

geo_threePerp.prompt: Laga bilaabo meesha P ee ka baxsan dhidibka $\alpha$, tiirka u dhacaya $\alpha$ wuxuu dhacayaa H; laga bilaabo H, tiirka u dhacaya xariiqda $\ell$ ee dhidibka $\alpha$ wuxuu dhacayaa K, oo meesha A ee ku taal $\ell$ ee ka duwan K waa la doortay. Ha ahaato masaafada ka socota P ilaa xariiqda $\ell$ $d$. Marka ${giv}$, waa maxay qiimaha ${ask}$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Maadaama $PH\perp\alpha$ iyo $HK\perp\ell$, marka loo eego Aragtida Saddexda Tiir, $PK\perp\ell$.
Ku dabaq Aragtida Pythagoras isku xigxig saddex-geesleyaasha xagalka qumman ee laga helay Aragtida Saddexda Tiir.
geo_threePerp.explanation: Maadaama $PH\perp\alpha$ iyo $HK\perp\ell$, marka loo eego Aragtida Saddexda Tiir, $PK\perp\ell$. ${work}$, sidaa darteed qiimaha la raadinayo waa ${ans}$.

geo_vecCircleEq.prompt: Vector-yada goobta ee barooyinka $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ ha ahaadaan $\vec a$, $\vec b$, vector-ka goobta ee barta P-na $\vec p$. Waa maxay dhererka raadiyaha goobaabinta ay samaynayaan dhammaan barooyinka P ee buuxiya $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$? (Waxaad ku qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ macnaheedu waa in labada vector $\vec p-\vec a$, $\vec p-\vec b$ ay is-toosan yihiin.
Intee darajo ayaa ah xagalka laga arko qaybta AB barta P?
geo_vecCircleEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ macnaheedu waa in P ay ku taal goobaabinta dhexroorkeedu yahay qaybta AB. $AB={ab}$, sidaa darteed dhererka raadiyaha waa $\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

geo_vecDecompose.prompt: Marka $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, $\vec c={vc}$, tirooyinka dhabta ah $m$, $n$ ee buuxiya $\vec c=m\vec a+n\vec b$, waa maxay qiimaha ${ask}$? (Waxaad ku qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: Qor qaybaha $m\vec a+n\vec b$ adigoo isticmaalaya $m$, $n$, kaddib ka dhig kuwa le'eg qaybaha $\vec c$.
Xalli nidaamka isla'egaha ee ku saabsan $m$, $n$ ee laga helay labada qaybood.
geo_vecDecompose.explanation: Marka qaybaha la barbar dhigo, ${eqs}$, sidaa darteed $m={mt}$, $n={nt}$. Sidaa darteed ${ask}={ans}$.

geo_vecDotParam.prompt: Labada vector $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, marka $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dd}$, waa maxay qiimaha ugu weyn ee tirada dhabta ah $t$? (Qor tiro dhammaystiran. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Isku dhufo qaybaha oo isku dar si aad $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ ugu muujiso $t$.
Xalli isla'egta la helay, hel dhammaan qiimayaasha $t$, kaddib dooro kan ugu weyn.
geo_vecDotParam.explanation: $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, sidaa darteed xalka isla'egta ${dexp}={dd}$ waa ${sol}$. Qiimaha ugu weyn ee kuwaas waa ${ans}$.

geo_vecLinComb.prompt: Marka $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$, waa maxay qiimaha $|{ex}|$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Isku-darka vector-yada iyo jeer-jeerka tirada dhabta ah waxaa lagu xisaabiyaa qaybaha.
Marka hore hel qaybaha ${ex}$, kaddib hel xididka labajibbaarka togan ee wadarta labajibbaarrada qaybaha.

geo_vecOrthoParam.prompt: Marka labada vector $\vec a={va}$, $\vec b={vb}$ ay is-toosan yihiin, waa maxay qiimaha tirada dhabta ah $t$? (Qor tiro dhammaystiran. Haddii ay taban tahay, ku dar -)
hints: Wax-dhaca labada vector ee is-toosan waa $0$.
Isku dhufo qaybaha oo isku dar si aad $\vec a\cdot\vec b$ ugu muujiso $t$.
geo_vecOrthoParam.explanation: Maadaama labada vector ay is-toosan yihiin, $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$. $\vec a\cdot\vec b={dexp}$, sidaa darteed marka la xalliyo isla'egta ${dexp}=0$, waa ${sol}$.

geo_vecSphereEq.prompt: Vector-yada goobta ee barooyinka $A{pa}$, $B{pb}$ ha ahaadaan $\vec a$, $\vec b$, vector-ka goobta ee barta P-na $\vec p$. Waa maxay dhererka raadiyaha kubbadda ay samaynayaan dhammaan barooyinka P ee buuxiya $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$? (Waxaad ku qori kartaa tobanle ama jajab sida 3/4)
hints: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ macnaheedu waa in labada vector $\vec p-\vec a$, $\vec p-\vec b$ ay is-toosan yihiin.
Intee darajo ayaa ah xagalka laga arko qaybta AB barta P?
geo_vecSphereEq.explanation: $(\vec p-\vec a)\cdot(\vec p-\vec b)=0$ macnaheedu waa in P ay ku taal kubbadda dhexroorkeedu yahay qaybta AB. $AB={ab}$, sidaa darteed dhererka raadiyaha waa $\frac{1}{2}AB={ans}$.

job_boxTunnel.prompt: Xabbad alwaax ah oo qaabkeedu yahay cuboid, dhererkeedu ${a}$ cm, ballaarkeedu ${b}$ cm, dhererka kor u socdaa ${c}$ cm, ayaa godad loogu qoday cuboid dhererkiisu ${p}$ cm, ballaarkiisu ${q}$ cm, laga bilaabo dhexda dusha sare ilaa hoose (godku ma gaadho dhinacyada xabbadda). Haddii dhinacyada gudaha godka lagu daro dhaqdhaqaaqa dusha (surface area), dusha xabbadda godka leh waa immisa cm²? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Marka godka la qodo, dusha sare iyo hoose waxay yaraadaan cabbirka godka.
Halkii, afar dhinac oo gudaha godka ah ayaa cusub oo soo baxaya.
job_boxTunnel.explanation: Dusha ka hor qodista waa $2({a}\times{b}+{b}\times{c}+{c}\times{a})={s0}$ cm². Ka jar ${p}\times{q}$ laba jeer dusha sare iyo hoose, kadibna ku dar dhinacyada gudaha $2({p}+{q})\times{c}$, sidaa darteed ${s0}-{pq2}+{inn}={ans}$ cm².

job_boxesCeil.prompt: ${n}$ qaybood ayaa lagu xidhaa ${k}$ sanduuq kasta, sanduuqyada ayaa lagu raraa ${m}$ pallet kasta. Xitaa haddii qaybo harto waxay galaan hal sanduuq, xitaa haddii sanduuqyo harto waxay yimaadaan hal pallet. Immisa pallet ayaa ugu yaraan loo baahan yahay? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Haddii qaybintu aanay dhammaystirmin, waxaa loo baahan yahay hal sanduuq (pallet) oo dheeraad ah oo harta lagu shubo.
Marka hore hel tirada sanduuqyada loo baahan yahay, kadibna si la mid ah hel tirada pallet-yada.
job_boxesCeil.explanation: Sanduuqyada loo baahan yahay waa ${bx}$, taas oo ah qiimaha ${n}\div{k}$ oo kor loo rogay, pallet-yada loo baahan yahayna waa ${ans}$, qiimaha ${bx}\div{m}$ oo kor loo rogay.

job_chanceDraw.prompt: Sanduuq ayaa ku jira ${n}$ qaybood, ${d}$ ka mid ah waa kuwo xumaaday. Haddii laba qaybood si random ah isla markiiba la soo saaro, suurtagalnimada ugu yaraan hal qayb inay xumaato waa maxay? (Ku qor jajab aan la soo koobi karin. Haddii ay tahay lambar dhan, ku qor lambar dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Dhammaan siyaabaha loo soo saari karo waa tirada siyaabaha laga dooran karo 2 oo ka mid ah ${n}$.
Ka soo horjeeda 'ugu yaraan hal qayb inay xumaato' waa 'labada oo dhan inay wanaagsan yihiin'.
job_chanceDraw.explanation: Dhammaan xaaladaha waa $_{{n}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={tot}$, xaaladaha labada oo dhan ay wanaagsan yihiin waa $_{{g}}\mathrm{C}_{2}={good}$. Suurtagalnimada la raadinayo waa $1-\frac{{good}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

job_floorPlan.prompt: Qol qaabkiisu yahay rectangle, dhererkiisu waa ${a}$ m, ballaarkiisu waa ${b}$ m. Dhexda darbi dherer ah oo dhinac ah, waxaa ka baxsan oo ku dhegan meel rectangle ah oo ballaarkeedu yahay ${d}$ m, moolkeeduna ${c}$ m (${d}<{a}$ lagana taabanayn geesaha qolka). Skirting board ayaa lagu dhejiyaa darbiyada gudaha oo dhan, laakiin lagama dhejiyo meesha albaabka ee ballaarkeedu yahay ${w}$ m. Dhererka skirting board ee loo baahan yahay waa immisa m? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Sawir oo ka fikir sida perimeter-ka shaqallada isku xidhan ee meesha leh uu uga duwan yahay kan rectangle-ka.
Hal dhinac oo ballaarkiisu ${d}$ m ayaa luma, laakiin laba dhinac oo moolkoodu ${c}$ m iyo hal dhinac oo ballaarkiisu ${d}$ m ayaa soo baxa.
job_floorPlan.explanation: Perimeter-ka qolka oo dhan waa $2({a}+{b})+2\times{c}={per}$ m (dhinaca ballaarkiisu ${d}$ m waxaa lagu beddelay laba dhinac oo moolkoodu ${c}$ m iyo hal dhinac oo ballaarkiisu ${d}$ m, sidaa darteed waxay kordhisaa laba dhinac oo ${c}$ m ah). Ka jar meesha albaabka ${w}$ m, sidaa darteed ${per}-{w}={ans}$ m.

job_flowUnits.prompt: Dhuunta biyo-nadiifiyaha (nozzle) ayaa daqiiqad kasta si joogto ah uga baxda ${r}$ mL biyo. Haddii nozzle-kan la furan yahay ${h}$ saacadood iyo ${m}$ daqiiqo, biyaha oo dhan ee soo baxa waa immisa L? (1 L = 1000 mL, qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Waqtiga oo dhan u beddel daqiiqado si aad u hesho waqtiga la furay.
Ku hel mL adigoo (qaddarka daqiiqad kasta)×(daqiiqadaha), kadibna ku qaybi 1000 si aad L u noqoto.
job_flowUnits.explanation: Waqtiga la furay waa ${h}\times60+{m}={tot}$ daqiiqo, biyaha soo baxayna waa ${r}\times{tot}={ml}$ mL. ${ml}\div1000={ans}$ L.

job_markupProfit.prompt: Dukaan ayaa shay qiimihiisa asalka ahi yahay ${c}$ won ku daray ${u}$% faa'iido ee qiimaha asalka si loo helo qiimaha liiska, kadibna qiimaha liiska ayuu ${d}$% ka dhimay, oo dhammaan ${n}$ ayuu iibiyay. Faa'iidada guud ee qiimaha asalka waa immisa won? (Qor lambarka oo kaliya)
hints: Qiimaha liiska waa $(100+{u})$% ee qiimaha asalka.
Qiimaha iibka waa $(100-{d})$% ee qiimaha liiska, faa'iidada hal shay waa (qiimaha iibka)−(qiimaha asalka).
job_markupProfit.explanation: Qiimaha liiska waa ${c}\times\frac{{100+u}}{100}={lp}$ won, qiimaha iibka waa ${lp}\times\frac{{100-d}}{100}={sp}$ won. Faa'iidada hal shay waa ${sp}-{c}={g}$ won, sidaa darteed faa'iidada ${n}$ waa ${g}\times{n}={ans}$ won.

job_outfitCount.prompt: Waxaa jira ${s}$ nooc oo dharka shaqada ee sare ah iyo ${p}$ nooc oo hoose ah, iyo ${h}$ nooc oo koofiyad ah. Hal dhar oo sare iyo hal mid hoose ayaa la doortaa, koofiyadna waxaa la xidhi karaa mid ka mid ah ${h}$ nooc ama lama xidhi karo. Haddii ${f}$ lammaane (sare, hoose) aan lagu xidhi karin isku mar sababo la xiriira xeerarka badbaadada, imisa nooc oo kala duwan oo labis ah ayaa la xidhi karaa guud ahaan? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Marka hore hel tirada lammaanayaasha (sare, hoose) ee la xidhi karo.
Tiri dhammaan siyaabaha koofiyadda looga dooran karo ${h}$ nooc ama aan la xidhin, ka dibna isku dhufo.
job_outfitCount.explanation: Lammaanayaasha (sare, hoose) waa ${s}\times{p}-{f}={ok}$, koofiyaduna waa ${h}+1={hh}$ oo ay ku jirto aan la xidhin. Xeerka isku-dhufashada, ${ok}\times{hh}={ans}$.

job_planCompare.prompt: Qorshaha A wuxuu leeyahay kharash bille oo go'an ah ${f1}$ won iyo ${p1}$ won isticmaal kasta, Qorshaha B wuxuu leeyahay kharash bille ${f2}$ won iyo ${p2}$ won isticmaal kasta. Haddii tirada isticmaalka bishii ay tahay $x$ (halkaas $x$ waa tiro dabiici ah), $x$-ka ugu yar ee kharashka bille ee Qorshaha B uu ka hooseeyo kan Qorshaha A waa imisa? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Kharashka bille ee labada qorshe ku muuji sida $x$ ku xiran.
Xalli sinnaan la'aanta (kharashka B)<(kharashka A) si aad u hesho xadka $x$.
job_planCompare.explanation: Kharashka A waa ${f1}+{p1}x$, kharashka B waa ${f2}+{p2}x$. Laga bilaabo ${f2}+{p2}x<{f1}+{p1}x$, ${dl}x>{df}$, taas oo ah $x>\frac{{df}}{{dl}}$. Tirada dabiiciga ah ee ugu yar ee buuxisa taas waa ${ans}$.

job_ratioChain.prompt: Saddex habka A, B, C wax-soo-saarka maalinlaha ah saamigiisu waa A : B $={a}:{b}$, B : C $={c}:{d}$. Haddii wadarta wax-soo-saarka maalinlaha ah ee saddexda habba ay tahay ${T}$, wax-soo-saarka maalinlaha ah ee habka C waa imisa? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: B u isticmaal tixraac, labada saami hal xariiq ku xidh si aad u samayso A : B : C.
Wadarta wax-soo-saarka ${T}$ ku qaybi wadarta saamiga A : B : C si aad u hesho cabbirka hal qayb.
job_ratioChain.explanation: Marka qiimaha saamiga B la isle'eg yeelo, A : B : C $={pa}:{pb}:{pc}$. Wadarta saamigu waa ${S}$, sidaas darteed hal qayb waa ${T}\div{S}={u}$, C-na waa ${pc}\times{u}={ans}$.

job_scaleDrawing.prompt: Naqshad cabbirkeedu yahay $1:{k}$, qol leh qaab afar-geesle ah ayaa lagu sawiray balac ${w}$ cm iyo dherer ${h}$ cm. Bedka dhabta ah ee qolka waa imisa m²? (1 m = 100 cm, tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Haddii cabbirku yahay $1:{k}$, dhererka naqshadda ku dhufo ${k}$ si aad u hesho dhererka dhabta ah.
Hel balaca iyo dhererka dhabta ah cm ahaan, ka dibna u beddel m oo isku dhufo.
job_scaleDrawing.explanation: Balaca dhabta ah waa ${w}\times{k}={rw}$ cm$={rwm}$ m, dhererka dhabta ah waa ${h}\times{k}={rh}$ cm$={rhm}$ m, sidaas darteed bedku waa ${rwm}\times{rhm}={ans}$ m².

job_tableRule.prompt: Waa miiska kharashka kirada qalabka. Saacad kasta oo lagu darana, kharashku wuxuu kordhaa qaddar go'an. ${x1}$ saacadood waa ${y1}$ won, ${x2}$ saacadood waa ${y2}$ won, ${x3}$ saacadood waa ${y3}$ won. Kharashka kirada ${N}$ saacadood waa imisa won? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Miiska ka hel intee ayuu kharashku kordhaa marka saacad la ku daro.
Kharashka ku muuji (qaddarka saacad kasta kordhaa)×(saacadaha)+(qaddarka aasaasiga ah) oo hel qaddarka aasaasiga ah.
job_tableRule.explanation: Waxay kordhaan ${k}$ won saacad kasta, sidaas darteed kharashku waa $y={k}x+{b}$ (qaddarka aasaasiga ah ${b}$ won si ${x1}$ saacadood ay u noqdaan ${y1}$ won). ${N}$ saacadood waa ${k}\times{N}+{b}={ans}$ won.

job_workTogether.prompt: Shaqaale A wuxuu saacad kasta sameeyaa ${a}$ shay, shaqaale B wuxuu saacad kasta sameeyaa ${b}$ shay xawaare go'an. A ayaa marka hore bilaabay, B-na wuxuu ku biiray ${h}$ saacadood ka dib. Ilaa wadarta alaabta ay labaduba sameeyeen ay noqoto si sax ah ${N}$, A wuxuu shaqeeyey imisa saacadood guud ahaan? (tiro oo keliya qor)
hints: Haddii saacadaha A shaqeeyey ay yihiin $t$, saacadaha B shaqeeyey waa $t-{h}$.
Samee isla'eg toosan oo ah (tirada A sameeyey)+(tirada B sameeyey)$={N}$.
job_workTogether.explanation: Haddii A uu shaqeeyo $t$ saacadood, B wuxuu shaqeeyaa $t-{h}$ saacadood, sidaas darteed ${a}t+{b}(t-{h})={N}$. Marka la nadiifiyo, ${ab}t={tot}$, sidaas darteed $t={ans}$ saacadood.

pst_atLeast.prompt: Bac ay ku jiraan ${w}$ kubbadood oo cadcad iyo ${bk}$ kubbadood oo madow ah, marka ${k}$ kubbadood isku mar laga soo saaro, hel suurtagalnimada in ugu yaraan ${r}$ kubbadood oo cadcad ay soo baxaan. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Dhacdada dhinta ee '${r}$ ama ka badan' waa marka tirada kubbadaha cadcad ay tahay ${zs}$.
Tirada guud ee siyaabaha loo soo saari karo waa $\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$.
