pst_atLeast.explanation: Dhacdada dhintu waa marka tirada kubbadaha cadcad ay tahay ${zs}$ iyo tirada siyaabaha ay tahay ${bx}={bad}$. Tirada guud waa $\binom{{nn}}{{k}}={tot}$, sidaa darteed suurtagalnimada la raadinayo waa $1-\frac{{bad}}{{tot}}={fr}$.

pst_bayes.prompt: Dishe cadaalad ah hal mar ayaa la tuuraa; haddii dhibcuhu yihiin ${t}$ ama ka yar, hal kubbad waxaa laga soo saaraa sanduuqa A, haddii kale sanduuqa B. Sanduuqa A waxaa ku jira ${w1}$ kubbadood oo cadcad iyo ${b1}$ kubbadood oo madow ah, sanduuqa B-na ${w2}$ kubbadood oo cadcad iyo ${b2}$ kubbadood oo madow ah. Haddii kubbadda la soo saaray ay cad tahay, hel suurtagalnimada inay ka timid sanduuqa A. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: $P(A\mid \text{kubbad cad})=\frac{P(A\cap \text{kubbad cad})}{P(\text{kubbad cad})}$.
Madaxu waa isugeynta suurtagalnimada kubbad cad ee A iyo suurtagalnimada kubbad cad ee B.
pst_bayes.explanation: Suurtagalnimada kubbad cad ee A waa ${tA}$, tan B-na waa ${tB}$, sidaa darteed suurtagalnimada la raadinayo waa $\frac{{tA}}{{tA}+{tB}}={fr}$.

pst_bestOf.prompt: Labada koox A, B ayaa ciyaaraya, kooxda ugu horreysa ee ${w}$ guul gaarta ayaa guuleysata. Suurtagalnimada A inay ku guuleysato ciyaar kasta waa ${fp}$, ciyaar kastaana waa madax-bannaan tahay, kana ma jirto barbardhac. Hel suurtagalnimada kooxda A inay guuleysato. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Ka fikir ciyaarta imisa ee kooxda A ay gaarto guushii ${w}$-aad.
Si ay ugu guuleysato ciyaarta ${w}+j$-aad, ciyaarihii ka horreeyay ${wm1}+j$ waa inay ahaayeen ${wm1}$ guul iyo $j$ guuldarro.
pst_bestOf.explanation: Suurtagalnimada kooxda A ay ku guuleysato ciyaarta ${w}+j$-aad ($j={jr}$) waa $\binom{{wm1}+j}{j}\left({fp}\right)^{{w}}\left(1-{fp}\right)^{j}$. Qiimayaashani isku xigxig waa ${tm}$, marka la isku daro waa ${fr}$.

pst_binomCoef2.prompt: Hel isku-dhufashada $x^{{k}}$ ee balaadhinta $({ax}{bs})^{{n}}$. (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Ereyga guud ee aragtida laba-geesoodka waa qaabka $\binom{N}{j}A^{N-j}B^{j}$.
Raadi ereyga uu $x$ ku dhufto ${k}$ jeer.
pst_binomCoef2.explanation: Waa ereyga marka $x$ la doorto ${k}$ jeer iyo ereyga joogtada ah la doorto ${nk}$ jeer, sidaa darteed isku-dhufashadu waa $\binom{{n}}{{k}}\cdot{a}^{{k}}\cdot({b})^{{nk}}={ans}$.

pst_binomFindN.prompt: Doorsoome random ah $X$ wuxuu raacayaa qaybinta laba-geesoodka ah $B(n,\ p)$ iyo $E(X)={mu}$, $V(X)={vr}$. Hel qiimaha $n$. (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Marka $V(X)$ lagu qaybiyo $E(X)$, waxaad heli $1-p$.
pst_binomFindN.explanation: $\frac{V(X)}{E(X)}=1-p$, sidaa darteed $1-p={q}$, taasoo ah $p={pp}$. Laga bilaabo $np={mu}$, $n={ans}$.

pst_binomNormal.prompt: Doorsoome random ah $X$ wuxuu raacayaa qaybinta laba-geesoodka ah $B({n},\ {pf})$. Adigoo $X$ u qiyaasaya qaybinta caadiga ah (hagaajinta joogtada ah ma samaynayso), hel qiimaha $P({ev})$. Doorsoome random ah $Z$ oo raacaya qaybinta caadiga ah ee heerka, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Qor ilaa meesha afraad ee tobanlaha)
hints: Qaybinta laba-geesoodka ah $B(n,\ p)$ waxaa loo qiyaasi karaa $N(np,\ np(1-p))$ marka $n$ weyn yahay.
U beddel heer caadi ah adigoo isticmaalaya (celcelis, leexasho caadi ah)=$({mu},\ {sg})$.
pst_binomNormal.explanation: $E(X)={mu}$, $\sigma(X)=\sqrt{{vr}}={sg}$, sidaa darteed $X$ waxay qiyaas ahaan raacdaa $N({mu},\ {sg}^{2})$. Marka loo beddelo heer caadi ah $Z=\frac{X-{mu}}{{sg}}$, ${zs}$, sidaa darteed $P({ev})\approx P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_binomPmfEq.prompt: Marka doorsoomaha aan qorshaysnayn $X$ uu raaco qaybinta laba-magacoodka ah $B({n},\ p)$ iyo $P(X={r})=P(X={r1})$, hel qiimaha $p$. (Halkan $0<p<1$) (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Labada suurtagalnimo u qor qaab $\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ oo labada dhinac ku qaybi arrinta guud.
Marka la habeeyo, waxaad heli doontaa qiimaha $\frac{p}{1-p}$.
pst_binomPmfEq.explanation: Laga bilaabo $\binom{{n}}{{r}}p^{{r}}(1-p)^{{nr}}=\binom{{n}}{{r1}}p^{{r1}}(1-p)^{{nr1}}$, $\binom{{n}}{{r}}(1-p)=\binom{{n}}{{r1}}p$, taasoo ah $\frac{p}{1-p}=\frac{{r1}}{{nr}}$. Sidaa darteed $p={fe}$.

pst_binomSumId.prompt: Hel qiimaha soo socda. $$\sum_{k=0}^{{n}}\binom{{n}}{k}\,{at}^{k}$$ (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Laga bilaabo sharciga laba-magacoodka ah $(1+x)^{N}=\sum_{k=0}^{N}\binom{N}{k}x^{k}$, ku geli tiro ku habboon $x$.
Go'aami qiimaha $x$ si $(1+x)^{N}$ ay ula mid noqoto wadarka.
pst_binomSumId.explanation: Marka sharciga laba-magacoodka ah lagu geliyo $x={a}$, $\sum_{k=0}^{{n}}\binom{{n}}{k}{at}^{k}=(1+{at})^{{n}}=({base})^{{n}}={ans}$.

pst_binomTail.prompt: Marka doorsoomaha aan qorshaysnayn $X$ uu raaco qaybinta laba-magacoodka ah $B({n},\ {pf})$, hel qiimaha $P(X{rel}{t})$. (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: $P(X=j)=\binom{N}{j}p^{j}(1-p)^{N-j}$ ($N$ waa tirada tijaabooyinka). Haddii ay jiraan erayo badan oo la isku darayo, ka fikir dhacdada ka soo horjeedda.
Isku dar erayada $j=$ ${js}$.
pst_binomTail.explanation: $P(X=j)=\binom{{n}}{j}\left({pf}\right)^{j}\left(1-{pf}\right)^{{n}-j}$, suurtagalnimada la rabaa waa wadarka qiimayaasha marka $j={js}$, taasoo ah $\frac{{tm}}{{D}}=\frac{{num}}{{D}}={fe}$.

pst_binomUnknown.prompt: Marka isku-dhufta $x^{{k}}$ ee ballaarinta $(x+a)^{{n}}$ ay tahay ${V}$, hel qiimaha $a$ ee togan. (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: U muuji isku-dhufta $x^{{k}}$ adigoo isticmaalaya $a$.
Maadaama $\binom{{n}}{{k}}={C}$, marka hore hel qiimaha $a^{{nk}}$.
pst_binomUnknown.explanation: Isku-dhufta $x^{{k}}$ waa $\binom{{n}}{{k}}a^{{nk}}={C}a^{{nk}}$, sidaa darteed ${C}a^{{nk}}={V}$, taasoo ah $a^{{nk}}={q}$. Maadaama $a>0$, $a={ans}$.

pst_ciBounds.prompt: Tiro-koob raacaya qaybinta caadiga ah leh leexasho heer ah ${s}$, waxaa si aan qorshe lahayn looga qaaday muuqaal cabbirkiisu yahay ${n}$ celceliskiisuna wuxuu ahaa ${xb}$. Haddii kala-duwanaanshaha kalsoonida ee celceliska tiro-koobka $m$ ee kalsoonida ${cl}\%$ loo yaqaan $a\le m\le b$, hel qiimaha $b$. (Kalsoonida ${cl}\%$ qiimaha ku haboon waa $z={z}$.) (Ku qor jajab tobanle ah)
hints: Kala-duwanaanshaha kalsoonidu waa $\overline{x}-z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\le m\le \overline{x}+z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.
Maadaama $\sqrt{{n}}={rt}$, marka hore hel $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}$.

pst_ciSampleSize.prompt: Tiro-koob raacaya qaybinta caadiga ah leh leexasho heer ah ${s}$, marka muuqaal si aan qorshe lahayn loo qaado si loo qiyaaso celceliska tiro-koobka iyadoo kalsoonidu tahay ${cl}\%$, hel qiimaha ugu yar ee cabbirka muuqaalka $n$ si dhererka u dhexeeya kalsoonidu ay u noqoto ${L}$ ama ka yar. (Kalsoonida ${cl}\%$ qiimaha ku haboon waa $z={z}$, $n$ waa tiro dabiici ah.) (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Dhererka u dhexeeya kalsoonidu waa $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Xalli sinnaan-la'aanta soo socota $\sqrt{n}$, kadibna labada dhinac labajibaaree. $2z\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$
pst_ciSampleSize.explanation: Dhererka u dhexeeya kalsoonidu waa $2\times{z}\times\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{n}}\le {L}$, sidaa darteed $\sqrt{n}\ge\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}$, taasoo ah $n\ge\left(\frac{2\times{z}\times{s}}{{L}}\right)^{2}{eq}{nq}$. Tirada dabiiciga ah ee ugu yar ee buuxisa waa ${ans}$.

pst_condDice.prompt: Laba laba-geesood oo cadaalad ah oo la kala garan karo ayaa isku mar la tuuray, tirooyinka muuqday waa $a,\ b$ siday u kala horreeyaan. Dhacdada $A$ ha noqoto '$a+b{rel}{t}$', dhacdada $B$ ha noqoto '$a{relb}b$'. Hel suurtagalnimada shuruudaysan $P(B\mid A)$. (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore hel dhammaan xaaladaha ka tirsan dhacdada $A$.
$P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$.
pst_condDice.explanation: Tirada xaaladaha dhacdada $A$ waa ${nA}$, tirada xaaladaha $A\cap B$ waa ${nAB}$. Sidaa darteed $P(B\mid A)={fe}$.

pst_condTable.prompt: Kooxda arday ee ${N}$ arday ka mid ah, ${m}$ waa wiilal, ${g}$ arday ayaa indho-daloola xidhan, ${x}$ wiil ayaa indho-daloola xidhan. Haddii hal arday si aan qorshe lahayn looga doorto kooxdan oo uusan xidhnayn indho-daloola, hel suurtagalnimada in uu yahay gabadh. (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Samee miis oo buuxi tirada afarta unug ee wiil/gabadh, indho-daloola xidhan/aan xidhnayn.
Suurtagalnimada shuruudaysan $P(B\mid A)=\frac{n(A\cap B)}{n(A)}$, halkaas $A$ waa 'indho-daloola ma xidhna'.
pst_condTable.explanation: Gabdhuhu waa ${f}$, gabdhaha indho-daloola xidhan waa ${g}-{x}={gy}$, sidaa darteed gabdhaha aan xidhnayn waa ${f}-{gy}={fn}$. Ardayda aan xidhnayn indho-daloola waa ${N}-{g}={ng}$, sidaa darteed suurtagalnimadu waa ${fe}$.

pst_deMorgan.prompt: Laba dhacdo $A,\ B$ marka ${gv}$, hel qiimaha $P({ev})$. (Ku qor jajab tobanle ah)
hints: Sawir jaantuska Venn oo u qaybi afar meelood: $A\cap B$, $A\cap B^{c}$, $A^{c}\cap B$, $A^{c}\cap B^{c}$.

$P(A\cap B^{c})=P(A)-P(A\cap B)$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)=P(B)-P(A\cap B)$. Waxaad kale oo isticmaali kartaa sharciga De Morgan $(A\cup B)^{c}=A^{c}\cap B^{c}$, $(A\cap B)^{c}=A^{c}\cup B^{c}$ iyo $P(E^{c})=1-P(E)$.
pst_deMorgan.explanation: $P(A\cap B)$ waa ${der}$. Suurtagalnimooyinka afarta meelood waa $P(A\cap B)={pab}$, $P(A\cap B^{c})={ao}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B)={bo}$, $P(A^{c}\cap B^{c})={ne}$, wadartooduna waa $1$. $P({ev})$ waa wadarka meelaha ku habboon, sidaa darteed ${sumx}$.

pst_diceQuad.prompt: Laba-geesood cadaalad ah oo ay ku yaalaan ishaha $1$ ilaa ${s}$ ayaa laba jeer la tuuray, tirooyinka muuqday waa $a,\ b$ siday u kala horreeyaan. Hel suurtagalnimada in isle'egga laba-jibbaaran $x^{2}-{pa}x+{qb}=0$ uu leeyahay laba xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan. (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Shuruudda laba xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan waa kala-soocaha $D>0$.
$D={d1}-4\times{qb}$, qiime kasta oo $a$ ah mid mid u go'aami oo tiri $b$ ee ku habboon.
pst_diceQuad.explanation: Tirada lammaanayaasha $(a,\ b)$ ee buuxiya kala-soocaha $D={d1}-4\times{qb}>0$ waa ${cnt}$ oo ka mid ah ${tot}$ guud ahaan, sidaa darteed suurtagalnimadu waa ${fe}$.

pst_diceSum.prompt: Laba disho oo cadaalad ah, mid walbana wuxuu leeyahay dhibco ka bilaabma $1$ ilaa ${s}$, ayaa isku mar la tuuray. Haddii dhibcuhu yihiin $a,\ b$ siday u kala horreeyaan, hel suurtagalnimada $a+b{rel}{t}$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Haddii labada dishe la kala saaro, tirada guud ee natiijooyinka waa ${s}\times{s}$.
Beddel $a$ ilaa $1$ ilaa ${s}$ oo tiri tirada $b$ ee buuxinaysa shuruudda, kadibna isku dar.
pst_diceSum.explanation: Natiijooyinka oo dhan waa ${tot}$, kuwa buuxinaya shuruudda $(a,\ b)$ waa ${cnt}$. Sidaa darteed suurtagalnimadu waa ${fe}$.

pst_expectTable.prompt: Qiimayaasha ay yeelan karto doorsoomaha random ah $X$ waa $1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$ iyo $P(X=x)=k(x+{c})$ ($x=1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {n}$). Hel celceliska $E(X)$ ee $X$. (Halkan, $k$ waa joogto.) (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore hel $k$ adigoo isticmaalaya shuruudda ah in isugeynta guud ee suurtagalnimadu tahay $1$.
$E(X)=\sum x\,P(X=x)$.
pst_expectTable.explanation: Maadaama isugeynta suurtagalnimadu tahay $1$, $k({t1})={S1}k=1$, taasoo ah $k=\frac{1}{{S1}}$. $E(X)=\frac{1}{{S1}}({t2})=\frac{1}{{S1}}\times{S2}={fe}$.

pst_indepFindN.prompt: Laga bilaabo $n$ kaar oo mid walbana ku qoran yahay tiro dabiici ah $1$ ilaa $n$, hal kaar ayaa si random ah loo qaadaa; ha ahaato dhacdada $A$ 'tirada kaarka waa isku-dhufasho ${p}$' iyo dhacdada $B$ 'tirada kaarka waa isku-dhufasho ${q}$'. Ka mid ah tirooyinka dabiiciga ah $n$ ee $2\le n\le {M}$, hel qiimaha ugu weyn ee $n$ ee ka dhigaya labada dhacdo $A,\ B$ inay madax-bannaan yihiin. (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Haddii ay madax-bannaan yihiin, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$, $A\cap B$ waa isku-dhufasho ${l}$. Haddii ay jiraan $a$ isku-dhufasho ${p}$, $b$ isku-dhufasho ${q}$ iyo $c$ isku-dhufasho ${l}$, shuruudda madax-bannaanidu waa $ab=cn$.
Hubi waxa dhaca marka $n$ uu yahay isku-dhufasho ${l}$.
pst_indepFindN.explanation: Haddii $n={l}t$ ($t$ waa tiro dabiici ah), $P(A)=\frac{1}{{p}}$, $P(B)=\frac{1}{{q}}$, $P(A\cap B)=\frac{1}{{l}}$, sidaa darteed way madax-bannaan yihiin. Isku-dhufashada ${l}$ ee ugu weyn ee ${M}$ ama ka yar waa ${ans}$. $n$ ka weyn tan, hubi haddii shuruudda madax-bannaanida $\frac{c}{n}=\frac{a}{n}\cdot\frac{b}{n}$, taasoo ah $ab=cn$, ay run tahay marka ay jiraan $a$ isku-dhufasho ${p}$, $b$ isku-dhufasho ${q}$ iyo $c$ isku-dhufasho ${l}$. Maadaama ${chk}$, madax-bannaan ma aha. Sidaa darteed waa ${ans}$.

pst_indepUnknown.prompt: Labada dhacdo $A,\ B$ waa madax-bannaan yihiin iyo $P(A)={fa}$, $P(A\cup B)={fu}$. Hel qiimaha $P(B)$. (U qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, u qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Haddii ay madax-bannaan yihiin, $P(A\cap B)=P(A)P(B)$.
U habee aragtida isku-darka $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$ sida isle'eg $P(B)$ ah.
pst_indepUnknown.explanation: Maadaama ay madax-bannaan yihiin, $P(A\cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)$, taasoo ah $P(B)\{1-P(A)\}=P(A\cup B)-P(A)$. $1-{fa}={d1}$, ${fu}-{fa}={d2}$, sidaa darteed $P(B)={d2}\div{d1}={fr}$.

pst_latticePath.prompt: Laga bilaabo meesha $(0,\ 0)$ ee dhidibka isku-xidhka ilaa meesha $({m},\ {n})$, marka hal talaabo oo midig ama kor ah keliya la qaado, imisa waddo oo ugu gaaban ayaa dhex mari waaya meesha $\mathrm{P}({p},\ {q})$? (Qor lambarka oo keliya)
hints: Isticmaal permutation leh walxo isku mid ah si aad u tiriso tirada guud ee wadooyinka. Wadooyinka aan dhex marin = guud - kuwa dhex maraya.
Wadooyinka dhex maraya meesha $\mathrm{P}$ waxaa lagu tiriyaa (laga bilaabo bilowga ilaa $\mathrm{P}$)×(laga bilaabo $\mathrm{P}$ ilaa dhammaadka).
pst_latticePath.explanation: Wadooyinka guud waa ${tot}$. Laga bilaabo bilowga ilaa $\mathrm{P}$ waa ${via1}$, laga bilaabo $\mathrm{P}$ ilaa dhammaadka waa ${via2}$, sidaa darteed wadooyinka dhex maraya $\mathrm{P}$ waa ${via1}\times{via2}={via}$. Sidaa darteed ${tot}-{via}={ans}$.

pst_linTransform.prompt: Haddii celceliska doorsoomaha aan qorshaysnayn $X$ uu yahay ${m}$, leexashada heerkuna ${s}$, hel qiimaha $E(Y^{2})$ ee doorsoomaha $Y={ya}$. (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Isticmaal $E(Y)=aE(X)+b$, $V(Y)=a^{2}V(X)$.

pst_lineUp.prompt: Marka ${m}$ wiil iyo ${w}$ gabadh ay safka isku taagaan, hel suurtagalnimada in labada gabadh midna aysan isku dhawayn. (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Isla jinsiga kuwooda isma kala saaro; haddii aad ka fikirto habaynta jinsiga oo keliya, suurtagalnimadu waa isku mid. Marka hore taag wiilasha, kadibna ka fikir xaaladaha ay gabdhuhu ka taagnaan karaan inta u dhaxaysa iyo labada dhammaad.
Meelaha ay gabdhuhu ku taagnaan karaan waa ${m1}$.
pst_lineUp.explanation: Tirada guud ee habaynta jinsigu waa $\binom{{nn}}{{w}}={tot}$. Haddii ${w}$ meel laga doorto ${m1}$ meel ee u dhexeysa wiilasha iyo labada dhammaad, gabdhuhu isma dhawaanayaan, sidaa darteed $\binom{{m1}}{{w}}={good}$ siyaabood. Suurtagalnimadu waa ${fe}$.

pst_monotoneSeq.prompt: Curiyeyaasha $a,\ b,\ c,\ d$ ee kooxda $\{1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}\}$, hel tirada lammaanayaasha habaysan $(a,\ b,\ c,\ d)$ ee buuxiya $a{r1}b{r2}c{r3}d$. (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Meesha calaamaddu tahay $<$, labada tiro waa inay kala duwanaadaan. Yaree kala-duwanaanshaha tirooyinka la dooran karo si ku habboon.
Haddii ay jiraan $\le$ keliya, doorashada afarta tiro waxay la mid tahay isku-darka soo noqnoqda.
pst_monotoneSeq.explanation: $a<b$ waxay la mid tahay $a+1\le b$, sidaa darteed $<$ kasta, haddii tirada dambe laga jaro $1$, calaamaddaas waxay noqonaysaa $\le$. Su'aashan waxaa ku jira ${s}$ calaamadood oo $<$ ah, sidaa darteed dhammaan calaamaduhu waxay noqdaan $\le$, kala-duwanaanshaha tirooyinkuna wuxuu noqdaa $1$ ilaa ${ms}$. Tirada siyaabaha loo dooran karo $4$ tiro adigoo oggolaanaya soo noqnoqod waa ${}_{{ms}}\mathrm{H}_{4}=\binom{{top}}{4}={ans}$.

pst_multiplesUnion.prompt: Kaararka ${N}$ ee leh tirooyin dabiici ah $1$ ilaa ${N}$ oo mid mid ku qoran, marka hal kaar si aan qorshe lahayn loo qaado, hel suurtagalnimada in tirada kaarka ku qoran ay tahay mid ka mid ah isku-dhufashooyinka ${p}$ ama ${q}$. (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore hel tirada isku-dhufashooyinka ${p}$ iyo tirada isku-dhufashooyinka ${q}$. Isku-dhufashooyinka labadaba waa isku-dhufashooyinka isku-dhufta guud ee ugu yar ee labada tiro.
Tirada curiyeyaasha ururka = (wadar) - (isgoys).
pst_multiplesUnion.explanation: Isku-dhufashooyinka ${p}$ waa ${np}$, isku-dhufashooyinka ${q}$ waa ${nq}$, isku-dhufashooyinka isku-dhufta guud ee ugu yar ${l}$ waa ${nl}$. Sidaa darteed ${np}+{nq}-{nl}={cnt}$, suurtagalnimaduna waa ${fe}$.

pst_normalBetween.prompt: Marka doorsoomaha aan qorshaysnayn $X$ uu raaco qaybinta caadiga ah $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$, hel qiimaha $P({a}\le X\le {b})$. Doorsoome $Z$ oo raacaya qaybinta caadiga ah ee heerka, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Qor afar lambar oo jajab tobanle ah)
hints: Heeri adigoo isticmaalaya $Z=\frac{X-m}{\sigma}$ oo u beddel qaab $P(z_1\le Z\le z_2)$.
Garaafka qaybinta caadiga ah ee heerka waxay isku mid tahay dhinac kasta oo $Z=0$ ah.
pst_normalBetween.explanation: Marka lagu heeriyo $Z=\frac{X-{m}}{{s}}$, $\frac{{a}-{m}}{{s}}={z1}$, $\frac{{b}-{m}}{{s}}={z2}$, sidaa darteed $P({z1}\le Z\le {z2})={expr}$.

pst_normalFindParam.prompt: Marka doorsoomaha suurtagalka $X$ uu raacayo qaybinta caadiga ah $N(m,\ {s}^{2})$ iyo $P(X\ge {c})={pv}$, hel qiimaha joogtada $m$. Doorsoomaha $Z$ ee raacaya qaybinta caadiga ah ee heerka, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: U beddel $P(X\ge {c})$ fursad ku saabsan $Z$ oo la barbar dhig $0.5$.
Miiska ka raadi $z_0$ u dhiganta qiimaha $P(0\le Z\le z_0)$.
pst_normalFindParam.explanation: $P(X\ge {c})=P\left(Z\ge \frac{{c}-m}{{s}}\right)={pv}$. Miiska, $P(0\le Z\le |z_0|)=|{pv}-0.5|={tv}$, sidaa darteed $|z_0|={az}$. ${cmp}$ awgeed ${zsg}$, $\frac{{c}-m}{{s}}={zz}$. Sidaa darteed $m={ans}$.

pst_normalSymmetric.prompt: Marka doorsoomaha suurtagalka $X$ uu raacayo qaybinta caadiga ah $N({m},\ {s}^{2})$ iyo $P(X\le {L})=P(X\ge {R})$, hel qiimaha joogtada $k$. (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Qalooca qaybinta caadiga ah waa isu-eg celceliska $m$.
Labada qiimood waxay ka fog yihiin celceliska isla masaafo dhinacyo ka soo horjeeda. Taasoo ah in wadarta labada qiimood ay tahay $2m$.
pst_normalSymmetric.explanation: Maadaama qalooca qaybinta caadiga ahi isu eg yahay $x={m}$, $({L})+({R})=2\times{m}$. Marka la nidaamiyo ${A}k+({BD})={m2}$, sidaa darteed $k={ans}$.

pst_repCombEq.prompt: Marka tirooyinka dhan ee aan taban $x,\ y,\ z,\ w$ ay yihiin $x+y+z+w={n}$ iyo ${cond}$, hel tirada isku-xigxigaalaha $(x,\ y,\ z,\ w)$. (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: Doorsoomayaasha xadka hoose uu ka weyn yahay $0$, ka jar xadka hoose si ay u noqdaan $0$ ama ka weyn.
Isla'egta cusub waa qaabka $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$.
pst_repCombEq.explanation: Qeex doorsoomayaal cusub sidan: ${subs}$. (Haddii doorsoome xadkiisu yahay $0$, si fudud $x'=x$.) Markaas $x'+y'+z'+w'={m2}$, doorsoome kastana waa tiro dhan oo ah $0$ ama ka weyn. Isku-darka ku celceli ${}_{4}\mathrm{H}_{{m2}}=\binom{{m3}}{{m2}}={ans}$.

pst_repPermCond.prompt: Tirooyinka dabiiciga ah ee ${k}$-god leh oo laga sameeyay tirooyinka $0,\ 1,\ 2,\ \ldots,\ {m}$ iyadoo la oggol yahay ku celcelin (meesha ugu horreysa ma noqon karto $0$), imisa ayaa ku leh tiro ${t}$ hal mar ama in ka badan? (Qor lambarka kaliya.)
hints: 'Hal mar ama in ka badan' way fududahay in la isticmaalo dhacdada ka soo horjeedda ('midna lama isticmaalin'). Meesha ugu horreysa 0 ma noqon karto.
Tirada guud ee tirooyinka dabiiciga ah ee ${k}$-god leh waa ${tot}$.
pst_repPermCond.explanation: Tirooyinka dabiiciga ah ee ${k}$-god leh waa ${tot}$, kuwa aan midna ku isticmaalin tiro ${t}$ waa ${noExpr}={no}$. Sidaa darteed ${tot}-{no}={ans}$.

pst_sampleMeanDist.prompt: Boorso ayaa ku jira 3 kubadood, tirooyinka kubadaha ku qoran waa ${lst}$. Boorsada waxaa laga soo saaraa hal kubad, tirada la hubiyaa, kadibna dib ayaa loo celiyaa, tijaabadan waxaa lagu celceliyaa ${nt}$ jeer. Haddii celceliska ${nt}$ tirooyinka la hubiyay uu yahay $\overline{X}$, hel $P(\overline{X}\ge {t})$. (Ku qor jajab aan la dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhan, ku qor tiro dhan. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Maadaama la dib u celinayo, dhammaan isku-xigxigaalaha suurtagalka ah waxay leeyihiin fursad isku mid ah.
Tir dhammaan isku-xigxigaalaha celceliskoodu yahay ${t}$ ama ka badan.
pst_sampleMeanDist.explanation: Tirada guud ee kiisaska la kala saaray waa ${tot}$, kiisaska celceliskoodu yahay ${t}$ ama ka badan waa ${cnt}$. Sidaa darteed fursaddu waa ${fe}$.

pst_sampleMeanNormal.prompt: Tiro-koob leh celcelis ${m}$ iyo hawlgal caadi ah ${s}$ oo raacaya qaybinta caadiga ah, waxaa si aan qorshe lahayn looga qaaday muuqaal cabbirkiisu yahay ${n}$. Haddii celceliska muuqaalka loo yaqaan $\overline{X}$, hel qiimaha $P({ev})$. Doorsoome kasta oo $Z$ ah oo raacaya qaybinta caadiga ah ee heerka, $P(0\le Z\le 0.5)=0.1915$, $P(0\le Z\le 1)=0.3413$, $P(0\le Z\le 1.5)=0.4332$, $P(0\le Z\le 2)=0.4772$, $P(0\le Z\le 2.5)=0.4938$, $P(0\le Z\le 3)=0.4987$. (Qor afar lambar oo jajab tobanle ah)
hints: Celceliska muuqaalka $\overline{X}$ wuxuu raacaa qaybinta caadiga ah $N\left(m,\ \left(\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}\right)^{2}\right)$.
Leexashada heerka ee loo isticmaalo heerinta waxaa lagu helaa sidan: $\frac{\sigma}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$
pst_sampleMeanNormal.explanation: $\overline{X}$ wuxuu raacaa qaybinta caadiga ah $N({m},\ {h}^{2})$ ($\frac{{s}}{\sqrt{{n}}}={h}$). Marka lagu heeriyo $Z=\frac{\overline{X}-{m}}{{h}}$, waxay noqotaa ${zs}$, sidaa darteed $P({ev})=P({zev})={expr}$.

pst_sampleSd.prompt: Tiro-koob leh celcelis ${m}$ iyo kala-duwanaansho ${v}$, waxaa si aan qorshe lahayn looga qaaday muuqaal cabbirkiisu yahay ${n}$. Haddii celceliska muuqaalka loo yaqaan $\overline{X}$, hel qiimaha $E(\overline{X}^{2})$. (Ku qor jajab tobanle ah)
hints: Celceliska celceliska muuqaalku waa $E(\overline{X})=m$, kala-duwanaanshuhuna waa $V(\overline{X})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{{n}}$.
$E(\overline{X}^{2})=V(\overline{X})+\{E(\overline{X})\}^{2}$.

pst_stratified.prompt: Dadka degmo gaar ah waxay u qaybsan yihiin saddex koox A, B, C, tirooyinkoodu waa ${na}$, ${nb}$ iyo ${nc}$ qof siday u kala horreeyaan. Muuqaal waxaa laga qaaday iyadoo la adeegsanayo xulasho qaybaysan oo saamiyaysan, halkaasoo cabbirka muuqaalka loo cabbiray si ay ula jaan qaadaan tirada koox kasta, waxaana kooxda A laga xulay ${sa}$ qof. Imisa qof ayaa laga xulay kooxda C? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Haddii qaybintu saamiyaysan tahay, saamiga laga xulay koox kasta (tirada muuqaalka ÷ tirada kooxda) waa isku mid.
Marka hore ka hel saamiga kooxda A.
pst_stratified.explanation: Saamiga laga xulay kooxda A waa $\frac{{sa}}{{na}}$. Maadaama saamigaasi yahay mid isku mid ah kooxaha oo dhan, kooxda C waa ${nc}\times\frac{{sa}}{{na}}={ans}$ qof.

pst_totalProb.prompt: Laba-geesood cadaalad ah hal mar ayaa la tuuray; haddii tirada muuqata ay tahay ${t}$ ama ka yar, kubbad ayaa laga soo qaadaa sanduuqa A, haddii kale sanduuqa B. Sanduuqa A waxaa ku jira ${w1}$ kubbadood oo cadcad iyo ${b1}$ kubbadood oo madow, sanduuqa B waxaa ku jira ${w2}$ kubbadood oo cadcad iyo ${b2}$ kubbadood oo madow. Hel suurtagalnimada in kubbadda la soo qaaday ay cadcad tahay. (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Xaaladaha kubbadda la soo qaaday ay cadcad tahay waxay u qaybsamaan 'cadcad oo laga soo qaaday A' ama 'cadcad oo laga soo qaaday B'.
Mid kasta ka hel (suurtagalnimada sanduuqa la doorto)×(suurtagalnimada kubbad cadcad oo sanduuqaas ka timaadda).
pst_totalProb.explanation: Cadcad oo laga soo qaaday A: $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}={tA}$, cadcad oo laga soo qaaday B: $\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={tB}$ (halkan $\frac{{t6c}}{6}$ waa suurtagalnimada in B la doorto). Labada qiime isku dar: $\frac{{t}}{6}\times{pw1}+\frac{{t6c}}{6}\times{pw2}={fr}$.

pst_urnChain.prompt: Bac ay ku jiraan ${w}$ kubbadood oo cadcad iyo ${bk}$ kubbadood oo madow, kubbado ayaa mid mid loo soo qaadaa, kuwa la soo qaaday dib looma celiyo. Hel suurtagalnimada in ${r}$ jeer ee ugu horreeya ay isdaba-joog cadcad yihiin, jeerka ${r1}$aadna ay madow tahay. (Ku qor jajab aan dhimi karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro buuxda, ku qor tiro buuxda. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Sharciga isku-dhufashada suurtagalnimada: tirada kubbadaha hadhay way is beddelaysaa tallaabo kasta.
Suurtagalnimada in kii ugu horreeyay uu cadcad yahay waa $\frac{{w}}{{nn}}$.
pst_urnChain.explanation: Haddii suurtagalnimada (shuruudaysan) ee tallaabo kasta la isku dhufto, waa ${prod}={fe}$.

pst_varTable.prompt: Qaybinta suurtagalnimada doorsoomaha random-ka ah $X$ waa $P(X={x1})=\frac{{a1}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x2})=\frac{{a2}}{{d}}$, $P(X={x3})=\frac{{a3}}{{d}}$. Hel qiimaha kala-duwanaanshaha $V(X)$. (Qor jajab aan la gaabin karin. Haddii ay tahay tiro dhammaystiran, u qor tiro dhammaystiran. Tusaale: 3/4)
hints: Marka hore hel $E(X)$ iyo $E(X^{2})$.

stat_ciMean.prompt: Bulsho raacaysa qaybinta caadiga ah, {cnt} xubnood ayaa si random ah loo doortay. Celceliska muunadda waa $\bar{x}={xbar}$ iyo leexashada caadiga ah ee bulshadu waa $\sigma={sig}$. Kala-duwanaanshaha kalsoonida ${cl}\%$ ee celceliska bulshada waa $\bar{x}-z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+z\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$, qiimaha $z$ halkan waa ${z}$. Waa maxay xadka sare ee kala-duwanaanshahan kalsoonida? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka hore hel khaladka caadiga ah $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$. Maadaama $n$ uu yahay labajibbaaran, si sax ah ayuu u qaybsamaa.
Xadka khaladku waa $z\times$(khaladka caadiga ah), xadka sare-na waa $\bar{x}$ oo lagu daray tan.
stat_ciMean.explanation: Khaladka caadiga ahi waa $\frac{{sig}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, xadka khaladku waa ${z}\times{se}={moe}$, sidaa darteed xadka sare waa ${xbar}+{moe}={ans}$.

stat_ciProp.prompt: Ku saabsan siyaasad gaar ah, {cnt} qof ayaa si random ah loo sahamiyey, {ag}-na way ogolaadeen. Haddii saamiga muunadda uu yahay $\hat{p}$, kala-duwanaanshaha kalsoonida ${cl}\%$ ee saamiga bulshada waa $\hat{p}-z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}\le p\le\hat{p}+z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$, qiimaha $z$ halkan waa ${z}$. Waa maxay xadka sare ee kala-duwanaanshahan oo ah lambar boqolkiiba (%)? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka hore hel saamiga muunadda $\hat{p}=\dfrac{{ag}}{{cnt}}$.
$\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ waa tiro jajab ah oo si sax ah u soo baxda. Waa fudud inaad u beddesho boqolkiiba kaddib xisaabiso.
stat_ciProp.explanation: $\hat{p}={ph}\%$, $\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{{cnt}}}={sdp}\%$, sidaa darteed xadka khaladku waa ${z}\times{sdp}={moe}$(%), xadka sare-na waa ${ph}+{moe}={ans}$(%).

stat_linReverse.prompt: Doorsoome cusub $y$ ayaa laga sameeyay doorsoomaha $x$ ($y={eq}$). Celceliska $y$ wuxuu ahaa ${my}$, leexashada caadiga ahna ${sy}$. Waa maxay leexashada caadiga ah ee $x$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Haddii $y=ax+b$, leexashada caadiga ahi waxay noqotaa $|a|$ jeer.
Joogtada lagu daray $b$ iyo celceliska ma laha xidhiidh leexashada caadiga ah. U qaybi leexashada caadiga ah ee $y$ $|a|$.
stat_linReverse.explanation: Qiimaha-dhammaystiran ee isku-dhufashada $x$ waa ${aa}$, sidaa darteed leexashada caadiga ah ee $y$ waa ${aa}$ jeer tan $x$. Sidaa darteed leexashada caadiga ah ee $x$ waa ${sy}\div{aa}={ans}$.

stat_linTransform.prompt: Celceliska doorsoomaha $x$ waa ${m}$, kala-duwanaanshuhuna waa ${vx}$. Haddii doorsoome cusub $y$ uu yahay $y={eq}$, waa maxay kala-duwanaanshaha $y$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Haddii $y=ax+b$, kala-duwanaanshuhu wuxuu noqdaa $a^2$ jeer.
Joogtada lagu daray $b$ ma beddesho kala-firidhka, sidaa darteed kala-duwanaanshaha ma saamayso.
stat_linTransform.explanation: Gudaha $y={eq}$, isku-dhufashada $x$ waa ${ap}$, sidaa darteed kala-duwanaanshuhu waa ${vx}\times{ap}^{2}={vx}\times{a2}={ans}$ (joogtada lagu daray iyo celcelisku kala-duwanaanshaha ma saamaynayaan).

stat_quartileIqr.prompt: Xogta {data} waxaa lagu kala horreeyaa cabbirka, kaddib bartamaha dhexe ee badhka hoose waa rubuc-dhexaadka kowaad $Q_1$, bartamaha dhexe ee badhka sare-na waa rubuc-dhexaadka saddexaad $Q_3$. (Haddii tirada xogtu ker tahay, dhexda lafteedu badhna ma geliso.) Waa maxay qiimaha heerka rubucyada $Q_3-Q_1$? (Lambar kaliya qor)
hints: Marka hore dib u qor xogta adigoo ka bilaabaya kuwa yar.
Xogta u qaybi badh hoose iyo badh sare adigoo isticmaalaya dhexda guud, kaddib hel dhexda badh kasta.

stat_rejectN.prompt: Aan tijaabino male-awaalka soo socda. $H_0: m={mu0}$, $H_1: m>{mu0}$. Leexashada heerka tiro-koobku waa $\sigma={sig}$, celceliska muuqaalkuna waa $\bar{x}={xbar}$. Haddii tirada tijaabada $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ ay ka weyn tahay ${crit}$, male-awaalka eber waa la diidaa. Haddii celceliska muuqaalku isku mid yahay, waa maxay cabbirka muuqaalka ugu yar $n$ ee keenaya in male-awaalka eber la diido? (Tiro dabiici ah, Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Sinnaan-la'aanta soo socota u beddel isle'eg ku saabsan $\sqrt{n}$. $Z>{crit}$
Labajibaaree labada dhinac si aad u hesho kala-duwanaanshaha $n$, kadibna hel tirada dabiiciga ah ee ugu yar ee buuxisa shuruudda. Sinnaanta ma aha diidmo.
stat_rejectN.explanation: Laga bilaabo $Z=\dfrac{{xbar}-{mu0}}{{sig}}\sqrt{n}>{crit}$, $\sqrt{n}>{rt}$, taasoo ah $n>{lim}$ (qiime lagu muujiyey laba lambar oo jajab tobanle ah). Tirada dabiiciga ah ee ugu yar ee buuxisa tan waa ${ans}$.

stat_sdFreq.prompt: Waxaa jira miis qaybinta soo noqnoqda oo qiimayaasha doorsoomaha $x$ yihiin {xs}, soo noqnoqoshada qiime kastana ay u kala horreeyaan {fs}. Haddii xogtan loo arko tiro-koob dhan (hoosaha kala-duwanaanshuhu waa wadarka soo noqnoqoshada), waa maxay leexashada heerka? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Marka hore hel wadarka soo noqnoqoshada $N$ iyo celceliska $m=\dfrac{\sum f x}{N}$.
Kala-duwanaansho $=\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}-m^2$, leexashada heerkuna waa xididkeeda laba-jibbaaran ee togan.
stat_sdFreq.explanation: $N={tot}$, celcelis $m={mean}$, $\dfrac{\sum f x^2}{N}={msq}$, sidaa darteed kala-duwanaanshuhu waa ${var}$, leexashada heerkuna waa ${ans}$.

stat_stratified.prompt: Saddex fasal oo tirada ardaydoodu tahay {n1}, {n2}, {n3} arday siday u kala horreeyaan, waxaa laga xulayaa wadar ahaan {ns} arday xulasho qaybaysan. Marka fasal kasta (qaybta) loo qaybiyo saamiga tirada ardaydiisa ee ardayda guud, waa imisa arday oo laga xulayaa fasalka {i}aad? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Marka hore hel tirada ardayda guud $N$.
Tirada laga xulayo fasalka {i}aad waa (tirada ardayda guud ee la xulayo)$\times\dfrac{{ni}}{N}$.
stat_stratified.explanation: Tirada ardayda guud waa ${pop}$, sidaa darteed ${ns}\times\dfrac{{ni}}{{pop}}={ans}$ arday.

stat_tCiLower.prompt: Tiro-koob raacaya qaybinta caadiga ah waxaa si aan qorshe lahayn looga qaaday {cnt}. Celceliska muuqaalku waa $\bar{x}={xbar}$, leexashada heerka muuqaalkuna waa $s={sd}$. Maadaama leexashada heerka tiro-koobka aan la aqoon, waxaa la isticmaalayaa qaybinta $t$; miiska qaybinta $t$ ee xorriyadda ${df}$, $P(T\le {t0})=0.975$. Waa maxay xadka hoose ee u dhexeeya kalsoonida $95\%$ ee celceliska tiro-koobka $m$, $\bar{x}-t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}\le m\le\bar{x}+t_0\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$ ($t_0={t0}$)? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Xorriyaddu waa $n-1$, khaladka heerka waa $\dfrac{s}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Xadka hoose waa $\bar{x}-t_0\times$(khaladka heerka).
stat_tCiLower.explanation: Khaladka heerka waa $\frac{{sd}}{\sqrt{{cnt}}}={se}$, xadka khaladka waa ${t0}\times{se}={moe}$, sidaa darteed xadka hoose waa ${xbar}-{moe}={ans}$.

stat_zStat.prompt: Celceliska cimriga alaab gaar ah waxaa la yiraahdaa waa ${mu0}$ saac. Waxaa si aan qorshe lahayn loo qaaday {cnt} alaab oo lagu sameeyey habraac cusub, celceliska cimrigooduna wuxuu ahaa $\bar{x}={xbar}$ saac. Haddii cimrigu raaco qaybinta caadiga ah leeyahayna leexashada heerka tiro-koobka $\sigma={sig}$ saac oo aan is beddelin, waa maxay qiimaha tirada tijaabada $Z=\dfrac{\bar{x}-{mu0}}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}$ ee male-awaalka eber $H_0: m={mu0}$? (Qor lambar kaliya)
hints: Marka hore xisaabi $\dfrac{\sigma}{\sqrt{n}}$.
Farqiga celceliska muuqaalka iyo ${mu0}$ ku qaybi qiimahaas. Waxay noqon kartaa mid taban.
